title: The Book of Isaiah Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Isaiah — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
verses.decoded: This is the vision that Isaiah, son of Amoz, received about Judah and Jerusalem during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

verses.kjv: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth: for the Lord hath spoken, I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.
verses.decoded: Listen, heavens, and pay attention, earth, because the LORD has spoken: I raised and cared for children, but they have turned against me.

verses.kjv: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.
verses.decoded: Even an ox recognizes its owner, and a donkey knows where its master feeds it, but Israel does not recognize me; my people do not think about this.

verses.kjv: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evildoers, children that are corrupters: they have forsaken the Lord, they have provoked the Holy One of Israel unto anger, they are gone away backward.
verses.decoded: What a sinful nation you are, full of wrongdoing, descendants of evildoers, children who corrupt others. You have abandoned the LORD, angering the Holy One of Israel, and have turned away from Him.

verses.kjv: Why should ye be stricken any more? ye will revolt more and more: the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.
verses.decoded: Why continue to be punished? You only rebel more and more. Your entire leadership is sick, and your whole heart is weak.

verses.kjv: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and putrifying sores: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with ointment.
verses.decoded: From head to toe, there is no health in you—only wounds, bruises, and open sores that have not been treated or healed.

verses.kjv: Your country is desolate, your cities are burned with fire: your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.
verses.decoded: Your land is ruined, your cities are burned down, and foreigners are taking over your land right before your eyes, leaving it desolate as if destroyed by invaders.

verses.kjv: And the daughter of Zion is left as a cottage in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.
verses.decoded: The people of Jerusalem are like a small hut in a vineyard, a shelter in a cucumber field, or a city under siege.

verses.kjv: Except the Lord of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, and we should have been like unto Gomorrah.
verses.decoded: If the LORD of Heaven’s armies had not spared a small group of us, we would have been destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the Lord, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.
verses.decoded: Listen to the message from the LORD, you leaders like those of Sodom; pay attention to God’s law, you people like Gomorrah.

verses.kjv: To what purpose is the multitude of your sacrifices unto me? saith the Lord: I am full of the burnt offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he goats.
verses.decoded: What use are all your sacrifices to me? says the LORD. I am already full of burnt offerings of rams and the fat of fattened animals. I do not delight in the blood of bulls, lambs, or goats.

verses.kjv: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to tread my courts?
verses.decoded: When you come to worship me, who asked you to do this—trampling my courts?

verses.kjv: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; the new moons and sabbaths, the calling of assemblies, I cannot away with; it is iniquity, even the solemn meeting.
verses.decoded: Stop bringing worthless offerings; I hate your incense. I cannot stand your new moons, Sabbaths, and religious meetings—they are sinful and cause me grief.

verses.kjv: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth: they are a trouble unto me; I am weary to bear them.
verses.decoded: I hate your new moon celebrations and your appointed festivals; they trouble me, and I am tired of bearing them.

verses.kjv: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you: yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.
verses.decoded: When you lift your hands in prayer, I will look away; even if you pray a lot, I will not listen because your hands are covered with blood.

verses.kjv: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;
verses.decoded: Clean yourselves up; stop doing evil things that I see; stop doing wrong.

verses.kjv: Learn to do well; seek judgment, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.
verses.decoded: Learn to do what is right; seek justice, help those who are treated unfairly, defend orphans, and stand up for widows.

verses.kjv: Come now, and let us reason together, saith the Lord: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.
verses.decoded: Come, let’s talk this over, says the LORD. Even if your sins are as deep as bright red, they will become as clean as snow; even if they are as dark as crimson, they will become as white as wool.

verses.kjv: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:
verses.decoded: If you are willing and obey me, you will enjoy the good things of the land.

verses.kjv: But if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: But if you refuse and rebel, you will be destroyed by the sword, because the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: How is the faithful city become an harlot! it was full of judgment; righteousness lodged in it; but now murderers.
verses.decoded: How has the city that was once faithful become like a prostitute! It was full of justice and righteousness, but now it is full of murderers.

verses.kjv: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water:
verses.decoded: Your silver has become worthless, and your wine is watered down.

verses.kjv: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves: every one loveth gifts, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.
verses.decoded: Your leaders are rebellious and partners with thieves; everyone loves bribes and chases after rewards. They do not judge fairly for orphans, nor do they defend widows.

verses.kjv: Therefore saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts, the mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies:
verses.decoded: Therefore says the LORD Almighty, the powerful One of Israel, 'I will take action against my enemies and punish those who oppose me.'

verses.kjv: And I will turn my hand upon thee, and purely purge away thy dross, and take away all thy tin:
verses.decoded: I will act against you and completely remove your impurities, getting rid of all your worthless parts.

verses.kjv: And I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellers as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called, The city of righteousness, the faithful city.
verses.decoded: I will restore your judges and advisors like they were at first; then you will be called the city of righteousness, the faithful city.

verses.kjv: Zion shall be redeemed with judgment, and her converts with righteousness.
verses.decoded: Zion will be saved through justice, and those who return will be saved through righteousness.

verses.kjv: And the destruction of the transgressors and of the sinners shall be together, and they that forsake the Lord shall be consumed.
verses.decoded: Those who break the law and sinners will be destroyed together, and those who abandon the LORD will be completely destroyed.

verses.kjv: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.
verses.decoded: You will be ashamed of the false gods you have worshiped, and you will be embarrassed by the places you have chosen to honor them.

verses.kjv: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.
verses.decoded: You will be like an oak tree whose leaves wither, and like a garden without water.

verses.kjv: And the strong shall be as tow, and the maker of it as a spark, and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.
verses.decoded: The powerful will be like dry flax, and the one who sets it on fire like a spark; both will burn up completely, and no one will be able to put out the fire.

verses.kjv: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: This is the message that Isaiah, son of Amoz, received about Judah and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the last days, that the mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.
verses.decoded: In the future, the Lord’s temple will be firmly established on the highest mountain, rising above all others, and people from all nations will come to it.

verses.kjv: And many people shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of the Lord, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Many will say, 'Let’s go to the Lord’s mountain, to the temple of the God of Jacob. He will teach us His ways, and we will follow His paths.' The Lord’s law and word will come from Zion and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.
verses.decoded: God will judge the nations and correct many people. They will turn their weapons into farming tools; no nation will fight against another, and they will no longer prepare for war.

verses.kjv: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of the Lord.
verses.decoded: People of Jacob, come and live by following the Lord’s guidance and truth.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they be replenished from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they please themselves in the children of strangers.
verses.decoded: Because your people are filled with those who come from the east and practice fortune-telling like the Philistines, and they enjoy the company of foreigners, you have abandoned them.

verses.kjv: Their land also is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land is also full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots:
verses.decoded: Their land is rich with silver and gold, with endless treasures; it is also full of horses and chariots without limit.

verses.kjv: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made:
verses.decoded: Their land is full of idols—things made by their own hands that they worship.

verses.kjv: And the mean man boweth down, and the great man humbleth himself: therefore forgive them not.
verses.decoded: Both the lowly and the powerful bow down to idols; because of this, do not forgive them.

verses.kjv: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty.
verses.decoded: Hide yourself in the rocks and cover yourself with dust out of respect and fear for the Lord and His glorious majesty.

verses.kjv: The lofty looks of man shall be humbled, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.decoded: Prideful people will be brought low, and their arrogance will be humbled; only the Lord will be honored and lifted up on that day.

verses.kjv: For the day of the Lord of hosts shall be upon every one that is proud and lofty, and upon every one that is lifted up; and he shall be brought low:
verses.decoded: The day of the Lord Almighty will come against everyone who is proud and arrogant, and they will be humbled.

verses.kjv: And upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,
verses.decoded: This judgment will come upon the tall cedars of Lebanon and the mighty oaks of Bashan,

verses.kjv: And upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,
verses.decoded: And upon all the high mountains and elevated hills,

verses.kjv: And upon every high tower, and upon every fenced wall,
verses.decoded: And upon every tall tower and every fortified wall,

verses.kjv: And upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant pictures.
verses.decoded: And on all the ships from Tarshish, and on all the beautiful images made to be desired.

verses.kjv: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be made low: and the Lord alone shall be exalted in that day.
verses.decoded: The pride of people will be humbled, and their arrogance brought low; only the LORD will be lifted up on that day.

verses.kjv: And the idols he shall utterly abolish.
verses.decoded: He will completely destroy all idols.

verses.kjv: And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.decoded: People will hide in rock crevices and caves underground, afraid of the LORD and the glory of His majesty when He rises to shake the earth violently.

verses.kjv: In that day a man shall cast his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which they made each one for himself to worship, to the moles and to the bats;
verses.decoded: On that day, people will throw away their silver and gold idols, which they made for themselves to worship, and give them to the moles and bats.

verses.kjv: To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake terribly the earth.
verses.decoded: They will hide in rock crevices and on jagged cliffs, afraid of the LORD and the glory of His majesty when He rises to shake the earth violently.

verses.kjv: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils: for wherein is he to be accounted of?
verses.decoded: Stop trusting in mere humans, whose breath is in their nostrils; what value do they really have?

verses.kjv: For, behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah the stay and the staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water,
verses.decoded: Look, the Lord, the Commander of heavenly armies, is removing from Jerusalem and Judah their support and strength—their supply of food and water.

verses.kjv: The mighty man, and the man of war, the judge, and the prophet, and the prudent, and the ancient,
verses.decoded: He is taking away the strong warriors, soldiers, judges, prophets, wise leaders, and elders.

verses.kjv: The captain of fifty, and the honourable man, and the counseller, and the cunning artificer, and the eloquent orator.
verses.decoded: The commander of fifty men, the respected leader, the advisor, the skilled craftsman, and the persuasive speaker—all will be taken away.

verses.kjv: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.
verses.decoded: I will put children in charge, and inexperienced young people will rule over them.

verses.kjv: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbour: the child shall behave himself proudly against the ancient, and the base against the honourable.
verses.decoded: People will oppress each other, even neighbors will fight; children will act arrogantly toward their elders, and the lowly will disrespect the respected.

verses.kjv: When a man shall take hold of his brother of the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand:
verses.decoded: Someone will grab his own relative, saying, ‘You have clothes—be our leader and take responsibility for this disaster.’

verses.kjv: In that day shall he swear, saying, I will not be an healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: make me not a ruler of the people.
verses.decoded: But that person will refuse, saying, ‘I won’t help; I don’t even have enough food or clothes for my own family. Don’t make me a leader.’

verses.kjv: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen: because their tongue and their doings are against the Lord, to provoke the eyes of his glory.
verses.decoded: Jerusalem is destroyed and Judah has fallen because their words and actions have rebelled against the Lord and offended His glory.

verses.kjv: The shew of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have rewarded evil unto themselves.
verses.decoded: Their faces show their guilt; they openly admit their sins like the people of Sodom and don’t hide them. Trouble is coming to them because they have brought evil on themselves.

verses.kjv: Say ye to the righteous, that it shall be well with him: for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.
verses.decoded: Tell the righteous that they will be fine because they will enjoy the results of their good actions.

verses.kjv: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given him.
verses.decoded: But woe to the wicked! Things will go badly for them because they will receive the consequences of their own actions.

verses.kjv: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they which lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.
verses.decoded: My people are oppressed by children, and women have taken control. Oh my people, your leaders mislead you and ruin your path.

verses.kjv: The Lord standeth up to plead, and standeth to judge the people.
verses.decoded: The Lord rises to bring a case and stand as judge over the people.

verses.kjv: The Lord will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.
verses.decoded: The Lord will judge the elders and leaders of His people because you have destroyed the vineyard and kept the poor’s possessions in your homes.

verses.kjv: What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.decoded: Why do you crush my people and oppress the poor? says the Lord Almighty.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Lord saith, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with stretched forth necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet:
verses.decoded: The LORD says, because the women of Jerusalem are proud, walk with their heads held high and flirtatious eyes, strutting as they go and making noise with their feet,

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and the Lord will discover their secret parts.
verses.decoded: God will punish the proud women of Jerusalem by causing them shame and exposing their private parts.

verses.kjv: In that day the Lord will take away the bravery of their tinkling ornaments about their feet, and their cauls, and their round tires like the moon,
verses.decoded: On that day, God will remove their beautiful ankle bracelets, hairnets, and round headbands shaped like the moon,

verses.kjv: The chains, and the bracelets, and the mufflers,
verses.decoded: Their chains, bracelets, and decorative scarves will be taken away,

verses.kjv: The bonnets, and the ornaments of the legs, and the headbands, and the tablets, and the earrings,
verses.decoded: Their bonnets, leg ornaments, headbands, charms, and earrings will be removed,

verses.kjv: The rings, and nose jewels,
verses.decoded: Their rings and nose jewelry will be taken away,

verses.kjv: The changeable suits of apparel, and the mantles, and the wimples, and the crisping pins,
verses.decoded: Their fancy clothes, cloaks, veils, and hairpins will be taken from them,

verses.kjv: The glasses, and the fine linen, and the hoods, and the vails.
verses.decoded: Their mirrors, fine linen garments, hoods, and veils will be taken away,

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet smell there shall be stink; and instead of a girdle a rent; and instead of well set hair baldness; and instead of a stomacher a girding of sackcloth; and burning instead of beauty.
verses.decoded: Instead of pleasant fragrance, there will be a foul smell; instead of a belt, a torn garment; instead of well-kept hair, baldness; instead of a decorated dress, a sackcloth belt; and instead of beauty, burning shame.

verses.kjv: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.
verses.decoded: Your men will be killed by the sword, and your warriors will fall in battle.

verses.kjv: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.
verses.decoded: Her city gates will cry and mourn, and she, now deserted, will sit on the ground in sorrow.

verses.kjv: And in that day seven women shall take hold of one man, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name, to take away our reproach.
verses.decoded: At that time, seven women will seek to be married to one man, saying, 'We will provide our own food and clothes; just let us be called by your name to remove our shame.'

verses.kjv: In that day shall the branch of the Lord be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the earth shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.
verses.decoded: At that time, the Lord’s chosen one will be beautiful and glorious, and the land’s produce will be excellent and attractive for those who have survived from Israel.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem:
verses.decoded: Those who remain in Zion and Jerusalem will be called holy—everyone whose name is recorded among the living in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: When the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof by the spirit of judgment, and by the spirit of burning.
verses.decoded: When the Lord cleanses the sins of Jerusalem’s people and removes the guilt from the city through His judgment and refining fire.

verses.kjv: And the Lord will create upon every dwelling place of mount Zion, and upon her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night: for upon all the glory shall be a defence.
verses.decoded: The Lord will provide a protective cloud and smoke over every home and gathering on Mount Zion during the day, and a glowing fire at night; His glorious presence will be a shield for all.

verses.kjv: And there shall be a tabernacle for a shadow in the daytime from the heat, and for a place of refuge, and for a covert from storm and from rain.
verses.decoded: There will be a shelter that provides shade from the heat during the day, and a safe place to hide from storms and rain.

verses.kjv: Now will I sing to my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved hath a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:
verses.decoded: I will now sing a song about my beloved and his vineyard. My beloved has a vineyard on a very fertile hill.

verses.kjv: And he fenced it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also made a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.
verses.decoded: He protected it with a fence, removed the stones, planted the best vines, built a watchtower in the middle, and made a winepress. He expected good grapes, but it produced wild, sour grapes instead.

verses.kjv: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem, and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.
verses.decoded: Now, people of Jerusalem and Judah, please judge between me and my vineyard.

verses.kjv: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?
verses.decoded: What more could I have done for my vineyard that I haven’t done? Why then did it produce wild grapes when I expected good ones?

verses.kjv: And now go to; I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; and break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:
verses.decoded: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will remove its protection, so it will be destroyed and trampled.

verses.kjv: And I will lay it waste: it shall not be pruned, nor digged; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.
verses.decoded: I will abandon it; it won’t be cared for or cultivated, and thorns and weeds will grow. I will also stop the rain from watering it.

verses.kjv: For the vineyard of the Lord of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for judgment, but behold oppression; for righteousness, but behold a cry.
verses.decoded: The vineyard of the LORD Almighty is Israel and Judah, His special people. He expected justice, but found only injustice; He expected righteousness, but heard only cries of distress.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!
verses.decoded: Woe to those who keep buying houses and land until there is no space left, so they can live alone in the land!

verses.kjv: In mine ears said the Lord of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty says to me: Many large and beautiful houses will be left empty and desolate.

verses.kjv: Yea, ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and the seed of an homer shall yield an ephah.
verses.decoded: Ten acres of vineyard will produce only a small amount of wine, and a large amount of seed will produce only a small harvest.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that continue until night, till wine inflame them!
verses.decoded: Woe to those who get up early to chase after strong drink and keep drinking wine until late at night.

verses.kjv: And the harp, and the viol, the tabret, and pipe, and wine, are in their feasts: but they regard not the work of the Lord, neither consider the operation of his hands.
verses.decoded: At their parties there is music and wine, but they don’t pay attention to what the LORD is doing or consider His actions.

verses.kjv: Therefore my people are gone into captivity, because they have no knowledge: and their honourable men are famished, and their multitude dried up with thirst.
verses.decoded: Because they lack understanding, my people have been taken captive; their leaders are starving, and the masses are parched with thirst.

verses.kjv: Therefore hell hath enlarged herself, and opened her mouth without measure: and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth, shall descend into it.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the grave has opened wide to swallow them all—their pride, their crowds, their splendor, and those who celebrate will all go down into it.

verses.kjv: And the mean man shall be brought down, and the mighty man shall be humbled, and the eyes of the lofty shall be humbled:
verses.decoded: The lowly will be brought down, the powerful will be humbled, and the proud will be humbled.

verses.kjv: But the Lord of hosts shall be exalted in judgment, and God that is holy shall be sanctified in righteousness.
verses.decoded: The Lord Almighty will be honored through His righteous judgment, and the holy God will be recognized as perfectly just.

verses.kjv: Then shall the lambs feed after their manner, and the waste places of the fat ones shall strangers eat.
verses.decoded: Then the weak will graze as they normally do, but outsiders will consume the ruined lands that once belonged to the prosperous.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of vanity, and sin as it were with a cart rope:
verses.decoded: Woe to those who drag their sins along as if they were tied with flimsy ropes, treating wrongdoing carelessly and openly.

verses.kjv: That say, Let him make speed, and hasten his work, that we may see it: and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!
verses.decoded: They say, ‘Let God hurry His judgment so we can see it happen; let the plan of the Holy One of Israel come quickly so we can understand it.’

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!
verses.decoded: Woe to those who say evil is good and good is evil; who confuse darkness with light and light with darkness; who treat bitter things as sweet and sweet things as bitter!

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!
verses.decoded: Woe to those who think they are wise and clever by their own standards!

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:
verses.decoded: Woe to those who are powerful because they drink wine and strong drink!

verses.kjv: Which justify the wicked for reward, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!
verses.decoded: Who accept bribes to declare the wicked innocent and rob the righteous of their rights!

verses.kjv: Therefore as the fire devoureth the stubble, and the flame consumeth the chaff, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust: because they have cast away the law of the Lord of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: So just as fire burns dry grass and flames consume chaff, their foundations will rot and their growth will vanish like dust—because they have rejected the Lord’s law and scorned the words of the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore is the anger of the Lord kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them: and the hills did tremble, and their carcases were torn in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the Lord’s anger burns against His people; He reaches out and strikes them. The hills shake, and their bodies lie torn in the streets. Yet His anger is not over; His hand remains raised against them.

verses.kjv: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss unto them from the end of the earth: and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly:
verses.decoded: He will raise a signal to distant nations and call them from the ends of the earth; they will come quickly and eagerly.

verses.kjv: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:
verses.decoded: No one among them will grow tired or stumble; none will sleep or rest; their belts will not loosen, nor will their shoe straps break.

verses.kjv: Whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent, their horses’ hoofs shall be counted like flint, and their wheels like a whirlwind:
verses.decoded: Their arrows are sharp and their bows fully drawn; the sound of their horses’ hooves is like hard stones, and their chariots move like a whirlwind.

verses.kjv: Their roaring shall be like a lion, they shall roar like young lions: yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and shall carry it away safe, and none shall deliver it.
verses.decoded: They roar like lions, fierce and loud; they seize their prey and carry it off safely, and no one can rescue it.

verses.kjv: And in that day they shall roar against them like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold darkness and sorrow, and the light is darkened in the heavens thereof.
verses.decoded: On that day, they will roar against their enemies like the crashing sea; when you look at the land, you will see darkness and distress, and even the sky’s light will be dimmed.

verses.kjv: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw also the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up, and his train filled the temple.
verses.decoded: In the year King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a high and exalted throne, and the edges of His robe filled the temple.

verses.kjv: Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.
verses.decoded: Above the throne stood seraphim, each with six wings: two wings covered their faces, two covered their feet, and with two they flew.

verses.kjv: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.
verses.decoded: They called out to each other, saying, 'Holy, holy, holy is the LORD Almighty; the whole earth is full of His glory!'

verses.kjv: And the posts of the door moved at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.
verses.decoded: The doorposts shook at the sound of their voices, and the temple was filled with smoke.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: Then I said, 'Woe to me! I am ruined because I am a man with impure lips, living among a people with impure lips, and yet I have seen the King, the LORD Almighty.'

verses.kjv: Then flew one of the seraphims unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:
verses.decoded: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, holding a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with tongs from the altar.

verses.kjv: And he laid it upon my mouth, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin purged.
verses.decoded: He touched my mouth with it and said, 'See, this has touched your lips; your guilt is taken away and your sin is forgiven.'

verses.kjv: Also I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then said I, Here am I; send me.
verses.decoded: Then I heard the Lord asking, 'Whom shall I send? Who will go for us?' And I said, 'Here I am. Send me!'

verses.kjv: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.
verses.decoded: He said, 'Go and tell this people: Listen carefully, but do not understand; look closely, but do not perceive.'

verses.kjv: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed.
verses.decoded: Make the people's hearts callous, their ears dull, and their eyes blind, so they will not see, hear, understand, repent, and be healed.

verses.kjv: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until the cities be wasted without inhabitant, and the houses without man, and the land be utterly desolate,
verses.decoded: Then I asked, 'Lord, how long will this last?' He replied, 'Until the cities lie ruined without people, the houses empty, and the land completely desolate.'

verses.kjv: And the Lord have removed men far away, and there be a great forsaking in the midst of the land.
verses.decoded: The LORD will remove people far away, leaving the land greatly abandoned.

verses.kjv: But yet in it shall be a tenth, and it shall return, and shall be eaten: as a teil tree, and as an oak, whose substance is in them, when they cast their leaves: so the holy seed shall be the substance thereof.
verses.decoded: But a tenth of the people will remain; they will return and be like a terebinth or an oak tree that still has life even after its leaves fall—this holy remnant will be the foundation.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up toward Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
verses.decoded: During the reign of Ahaz, son of Jotham and grandson of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin, king of Syria, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, king of Israel, attacked Jerusalem but failed to capture it.

verses.kjv: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart was moved, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the wood are moved with the wind.
verses.decoded: The royal family of David was informed that Syria had joined forces with Ephraim (Israel). This news deeply unsettled Ahaz and his people, shaking them like trees swaying in the wind.

verses.kjv: Then said the Lord unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field;
verses.decoded: The LORD told Isaiah to go meet King Ahaz, accompanied by his son Shearjashub, at the end of the water channel near the upper pool on the road to the fuller's field.

verses.kjv: And say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither be fainthearted for the two tails of these smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin with Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
verses.decoded: Tell him to stay calm and not be afraid or discouraged by the threat of these two burning sticks—Rezin of Syria and Pekah, son of Remaliah.

verses.kjv: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have taken evil counsel against thee, saying,
verses.decoded: Because Syria, Ephraim, and Pekah, son of Remaliah, have planned evil against you, saying,

verses.kjv: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeal:
verses.decoded: ‘Let’s attack Judah, cause trouble there, break through its defenses, and install the son of Tabeal as king.’

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD says this plan will not succeed or happen.

verses.kjv: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken, that it be not a people.
verses.decoded: Damascus is the capital of Syria, led by Rezin; and within 65 years, Ephraim (Israel) will be destroyed and cease to exist as a nation.

verses.kjv: And the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.
verses.decoded: Samaria is the capital of Ephraim, led by Remaliah’s son (Pekah). If you refuse to trust God, you will not be secure.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Lord spake again unto Ahaz, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,

verses.kjv: Ask thee a sign of the Lord thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.
verses.decoded: Ask the LORD your God for a sign—anything you want, whether from the depths below or the heights above.

verses.kjv: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt the Lord.
verses.decoded: But Ahaz replied, 'I won’t ask for a sign, and I won’t test the LORD.'

verses.kjv: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David; Is it a small thing for you to weary men, but will ye weary my God also?
verses.decoded: Then God said, 'Listen, house of David: is it not enough to trouble people, but you also want to trouble my God?'

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord himself shall give you a sign; Behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
verses.decoded: So the Lord will give you a sign: a young woman will become pregnant, have a son, and name him Immanuel (meaning 'God with us').

verses.kjv: Butter and honey shall he eat, that he may know to refuse the evil, and choose the good.
verses.decoded: The child will eat butter and honey so that he learns to reject evil and choose what is right.

verses.kjv: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land that thou abhorrest shall be forsaken of both her kings.
verses.decoded: Before the child learns to reject evil and choose good, the land you hate will be abandoned by both its kings.

verses.kjv: The Lord shall bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah; even the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: The LORD will bring upon you, your people, and your family days unlike any before, starting from when Ephraim separated from Judah—the king of Assyria will come.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
verses.decoded: On that day, the LORD will call like a whistle for the flies from the farthest rivers of Egypt and the bees from Assyria.

verses.kjv: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the holes of the rocks, and upon all thorns, and upon all bushes.
verses.decoded: They will come and settle in the empty valleys, rocky caves, thorny places, and among all kinds of bushes.

verses.kjv: In the same day shall the Lord shave with a rasor that is hired, namely, by them beyond the river, by the king of Assyria, the head, and the hair of the feet: and it shall also consume the beard.
verses.decoded: That day, the LORD will use a hired razor—the king of Assyria from beyond the river—to shave off the head, feet hair, and beard.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall nourish a young cow, and two sheep;
verses.decoded: On that day, a man will care for a young cow and two sheep;

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, for the abundance of milk that they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the land.
verses.decoded: Because of the milk they produce, he will eat butter; everyone left in the land will eat butter and honey.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
verses.decoded: On that day, places that once had a thousand vines worth a thousand silver coins will be overgrown with briers and thorns.

verses.kjv: With arrows and with bows shall men come thither; because all the land shall become briers and thorns.
verses.decoded: People will come there with bows and arrows because the whole land will be covered with briers and thorns.

verses.kjv: And on all hills that shall be digged with the mattock, there shall not come thither the fear of briers and thorns: but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of lesser cattle.
verses.decoded: On all hills dug with a mattock, there will be no fear of briers and thorns; instead, they will be used to send out oxen and to trample smaller cattle.

verses.kjv: Moreover the Lord said unto me, Take thee a great roll, and write in it with a man’s pen concerning Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me, 'Get a large scroll and write on it clearly about Mahershalalhashbaz.'

verses.kjv: And I took unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.
verses.decoded: I brought reliable witnesses to record this: Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberechiah.

verses.kjv: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said the Lord to me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.
verses.decoded: I approached the prophetess, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Then the LORD told me to name him Mahershalalhashbaz.

verses.kjv: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and my mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be taken away before the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Before the child can even say 'My father' or 'My mother,' the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be taken by the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: The Lord spake also unto me again, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me again, saying,

verses.kjv: Forasmuch as this people refuseth the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
verses.decoded: Because these people reject the gentle waters of Shiloah and instead take comfort in Rezin and the son of Remaliah,

verses.kjv: Now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the river, strong and many, even the king of Assyria, and all his glory: and he shall come up over all his channels, and go over all his banks:
verses.decoded: Now the LORD will bring against them a powerful flood—the king of Assyria and all his forces. He will overflow all boundaries and flood the land.

verses.kjv: And he shall pass through Judah; he shall overflow and go over, he shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of his wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.
verses.decoded: He will invade Judah, flood through it up to the neck, and his power will spread across your whole land, O Immanuel.

verses.kjv: Associate yourselves, O ye people, and ye shall be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and ye shall be broken in pieces.
verses.decoded: Join forces, all you peoples, but you will be shattered; listen, distant nations! Prepare for battle, but you will be crushed; prepare again, but you will be broken.

verses.kjv: Take counsel together, and it shall come to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.
verses.decoded: Make your plans, but they will fail; say your words, but they will not succeed—because God is with us.

verses.kjv: For the Lord spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me that I should not walk in the way of this people, saying,
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke to me powerfully and told me not to follow the ways of these people, saying,

verses.kjv: Say ye not, A confederacy, to all them to whom this people shall say, A confederacy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be afraid.
verses.decoded: Do not say 'A conspiracy' when these people say it; do not fear what they fear or be terrified.

verses.kjv: Sanctify the Lord of hosts himself; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.
verses.decoded: Honor the LORD Almighty as holy; let Him be your source of reverence and awe.

verses.kjv: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He will be a place of safety for some, but a stone that causes others to stumble and fall, a trap for both Israel and Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And many among them shall stumble, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.
verses.decoded: Many will trip, fall, be shattered, caught in traps, and captured.

verses.kjv: Bind up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.
verses.decoded: Keep the message safe and preserve the teachings among my followers.

verses.kjv: And I will wait upon the Lord, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
verses.decoded: I will trust and wait patiently for the LORD, even though He seems to hide Himself from Israel, and I will continue to seek Him.

verses.kjv: Behold, I and the children whom the Lord hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the Lord of hosts, which dwelleth in mount Zion.
verses.decoded: Look, I and the children God has given me are symbols and miracles in Israel, from the LORD of armies who lives on Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits, and unto wizards that peep, and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? for the living to the dead?
verses.decoded: If people tell you to consult mediums and fortune-tellers who whisper and mutter, shouldn’t the people instead seek guidance from their God? Why ask the dead on behalf of the living?

verses.kjv: To the law and to the testimony: if they speak not according to this word, it is because there is no light in them.
verses.decoded: Turn to God's law and His message; if anyone does not speak according to these words, it is because they have no understanding or truth in them.

verses.kjv: And they shall pass through it, hardly bestead and hungry: and it shall come to pass, that when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse their king and their God, and look upward.
verses.decoded: They will go through difficult times, suffering and hunger; and when they are hungry, they will become angry, curse their king and their God, and look for help.

verses.kjv: And they shall look unto the earth; and behold trouble and darkness, dimness of anguish; and they shall be driven to darkness.
verses.decoded: They will look to the ground and see trouble, gloom, and deep distress; they will be overwhelmed by darkness.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the dimness shall not be such as was in her vexation, when at the first he lightly afflicted the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, and afterward did more grievously afflict her by the way of the sea, beyond Jordan, in Galilee of the nations.
verses.decoded: But the darkness will not be as severe as it was when he first lightly punished the land of Zebulun and Naphtali, and later more harshly afflicted the area by the sea, beyond the Jordan, in Galilee, a region full of many people.

verses.kjv: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
verses.decoded: The people who lived in darkness have seen a great light; those living in the land of deep darkness have been illuminated by this light.

verses.kjv: Thou hast multiplied the nation, and not increased the joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, and as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.
verses.decoded: You have grown the nation and increased their happiness; they rejoice before you like people celebrate during a harvest or when they share the spoils of victory.

verses.kjv: For thou hast broken the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, as in the day of Midian.
verses.decoded: You have broken the heavy yoke and the burden on their shoulders, the rod of their oppressor, just like you did on the day you defeated Midian.

verses.kjv: For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood; but this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.
verses.decoded: Usually, a warrior's battle is noisy and bloody, with clothes soaked in blood; but this victory will be like a blazing fire consuming everything.

verses.kjv: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counseller, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verses.decoded: A child is born to us, a son is given to us, and the government will rest on his shoulders. He will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

verses.kjv: Of the increase of his government and peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to order it, and to establish it with judgment and with justice from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of the Lord of hosts will perform this.
verses.decoded: His government and peace will grow without end, ruling on David’s throne and establishing his kingdom with fairness and justice forever. The LORD Almighty is determined to make this happen.

verses.kjv: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.
verses.decoded: The LORD sent a message to Jacob, and it has come to Israel.

verses.kjv: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in the pride and stoutness of heart,
verses.decoded: Everyone, including Ephraim and the people of Samaria, who speak proudly and arrogantly, will realize this.

verses.kjv: The bricks are fallen down, but we will build with hewn stones: the sycomores are cut down, but we will change them into cedars.
verses.decoded: The bricks have fallen, but we will rebuild with cut stones; the sycamore trees have been cut down, but we will replace them with cedars.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord shall set up the adversaries of Rezin against him, and join his enemies together;
verses.decoded: So the LORD will bring together Rezin’s enemies and unite his adversaries against him.

verses.kjv: The Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.decoded: The Syrians attack from the front and the Philistines from behind; they will consume Israel completely. Yet, despite this, God’s anger remains, and his hand is still extended against them.

verses.kjv: For the people turneth not unto him that smiteth them, neither do they seek the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: The people do not turn to the one who strikes them, nor do they seek the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord will cut off from Israel head and tail, branch and rush, in one day.
verses.decoded: Therefore, the LORD will remove both the leaders and the followers, the important and the insignificant, all at once.

verses.kjv: The ancient and honourable, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.
verses.decoded: The respected elders are the leaders, but the false prophets who teach lies are the followers.

verses.kjv: For the leaders of this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.
verses.decoded: The leaders of these people mislead them, and those who follow them are ruined.

verses.kjv: Therefore the Lord shall have no joy in their young men, neither shall have mercy on their fatherless and widows: for every one is an hypocrite and an evildoer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.decoded: Because of this, the Lord will not take pleasure in their young men, nor show mercy to their orphans and widows; everyone is a hypocrite and does evil, and all speak foolishly. Despite this, His anger remains, and His hand is still raised against them.

verses.kjv: For wickedness burneth as the fire: it shall devour the briers and thorns, and shall kindle in the thickets of the forest, and they shall mount up like the lifting up of smoke.
verses.decoded: Wickedness burns like a fire; it consumes the bushes and thorns, sets the forest on fire, and the smoke rises high.

verses.kjv: Through the wrath of the Lord of hosts is the land darkened, and the people shall be as the fuel of the fire: no man shall spare his brother.
verses.decoded: Because of the LORD Almighty’s anger, the land is darkened, and the people become like fuel for the fire; no one will show mercy to their own brother.

verses.kjv: And he shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:
verses.decoded: People will grab with their right hand but still be hungry; they will eat with their left hand but not be satisfied; they will even eat the flesh of their own arms.

verses.kjv: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh: and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.decoded: Manasseh and Ephraim will join forces against Judah. Despite this, God’s anger remains, and His hand is still raised against them.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and that write grievousness which they have prescribed;
verses.decoded: Trouble awaits those who make unfair laws and write down harsh rules they have decided on;

verses.kjv: To turn aside the needy from judgment, and to take away the right from the poor of my people, that widows may be their prey, and that they may rob the fatherless!
verses.decoded: Who deny justice to the poor and take away the rights of the needy, so widows and orphans become their victims and are robbed!

verses.kjv: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?
verses.decoded: What will you do on the day of punishment, when destruction comes from afar? Where will you run for help? What will happen to your pride?

verses.kjv: Without me they shall bow down under the prisoners, and they shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.
verses.decoded: Without my help, they will be captured and killed. Even so, my anger is not gone; my hand is still raised to punish.

verses.kjv: O Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, and the staff in their hand is mine indignation.
verses.decoded: Assyria is the instrument of my anger, the tool in their hands is my punishment.

verses.kjv: I will send him against an hypocritical nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
verses.decoded: I will send Assyria against a deceitful nation; I command them to loot, plunder, and crush them like mud in the streets.

verses.kjv: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy and cut off nations not a few.
verses.decoded: But Assyria does not intend this; they don’t think this way. Instead, they plan to destroy many nations completely.

verses.kjv: For he saith, Are not my princes altogether kings?
verses.decoded: Assyria says, “Aren’t all my officials like kings?”

verses.kjv: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?
verses.decoded: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?

verses.kjv: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, and whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;
verses.decoded: Just as I have conquered kingdoms with idols, whose carved images were even more impressive than those of Jerusalem and Samaria;

verses.kjv: Shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
verses.decoded: Won’t I do to Jerusalem and its idols what I did to Samaria and its idols?

verses.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.
verses.decoded: After the Lord finishes his work on Mount Zion and Jerusalem, he will punish the proud heart and arrogant pride of the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: For he saith, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I am prudent: and I have removed the bounds of the people, and have robbed their treasures, and I have put down the inhabitants like a valiant man:
verses.decoded: Assyria says, “I did this by my own strength and wisdom; I am clever. I have taken land, stolen treasures, and defeated people like a mighty warrior.”

verses.kjv: And my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the people: and as one gathereth eggs that are left, have I gathered all the earth; and there was none that moved the wing, or opened the mouth, or peeped.
verses.decoded: My hand found the people’s wealth like a nest; like someone gathering leftover eggs, I took all the land, and no one dared to move or make a sound.

verses.kjv: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? or shall the saw magnify itself against him that shaketh it? as if the rod should shake itself against them that lift it up, or as if the staff should lift up itself, as if it were no wood.
verses.decoded: Can the axe brag against the one who uses it? Can the saw praise the one who shakes it? Can the rod shake the person who lifts it? Or can the staff lift itself, as if it were not just wood?

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the Lord, the Lord of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory he shall kindle a burning like the burning of a fire.
verses.decoded: So the Lord Almighty will cause those who are proud and prosperous to suffer famine; beneath his majesty, he will ignite a fire that burns fiercely.

verses.kjv: And the light of Israel shall be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame: and it shall burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day;
verses.decoded: The glory of Israel, the Holy One, will be like a fire that quickly burns up and destroys all the thorns and briers.

verses.kjv: And shall consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and they shall be as when a standardbearer fainteth.
verses.decoded: It will destroy the beauty of the forest and fertile land completely, affecting everything inside, leaving them weak and defeated like a tired flag bearer.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the trees of his forest shall be few, that a child may write them.
verses.decoded: Only a few trees will remain in the forest—so few that even a child could count them all.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and such as are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again stay upon him that smote them; but shall stay upon the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
verses.decoded: At that time, the remaining people of Israel who survive will no longer rely on those who harmed them, but will trust in the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, sincerely.

verses.kjv: The remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.
verses.decoded: The survivors, the remnant of Jacob, will come back to the powerful God.

verses.kjv: For though thy people Israel be as the sand of the sea, yet a remnant of them shall return: the consumption decreed shall overflow with righteousness.
verses.decoded: Even if Israel’s population is as countless as the sand on the shore, only a remnant will return; the destruction planned will be overwhelmed by God’s justice.

verses.kjv: For the Lord God of hosts shall make a consumption, even determined, in the midst of all the land.
verses.decoded: The Lord Almighty will carry out a decisive destruction throughout the entire land.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian: he shall smite thee with a rod, and shall lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.
verses.decoded: So says the Lord Almighty: People living in Zion, don’t fear the Assyrian. He will strike you with a rod and raise his staff against you like Egypt did.

verses.kjv: For yet a very little while, and the indignation shall cease, and mine anger in their destruction.
verses.decoded: But soon my anger will end, and my punishment of them will be finished.

verses.kjv: And the Lord of hosts shall stir up a scourge for him according to the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and as his rod was upon the sea, so shall he lift it up after the manner of Egypt.
verses.decoded: The Lord Almighty will raise up a punishment against the Assyrian like the defeat of Midian at the rock of Oreb; just as his power was shown at the sea, he will act again as he did in Egypt.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing.
verses.decoded: On that day, the heavy burden and yoke placed on you will be removed and destroyed because of the Lord’s chosen one.

verses.kjv: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
verses.decoded: The enemy has reached Aiath, moved past Migron, and stationed his chariots at Michmash.

verses.kjv: They are gone over the passage: they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah is afraid; Gibeah of Saul is fled.
verses.decoded: They have crossed the passage and camped at Geba; Ramah is terrified, and Gibeah, the city of Saul, has been abandoned.

verses.kjv: Lift up thy voice, O daughter of Gallim: cause it to be heard unto Laish, O poor Anathoth.
verses.decoded: Raise your voice, people of Gallim; shout out to Laish and poor Anathoth.

verses.kjv: Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
verses.decoded: Madmenah has been captured; the people of Gebim are gathering to escape.

verses.kjv: As yet shall he remain at Nob that day: he shall shake his hand against the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He will still be at Nob that day, threatening the mountain of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord, the Lord of hosts, shall lop the bough with terror: and the high ones of stature shall be hewn down, and the haughty shall be humbled.
verses.decoded: Look, the Lord Almighty will cut down the proud like branches; the tall and arrogant will be brought low and humbled.

verses.kjv: And he shall cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.
verses.decoded: He will cut down the dense forests with iron tools, and even Lebanon’s great trees will fall by a powerful force.

verses.kjv: And there shall come forth a rod out of the stem of Jesse, and a Branch shall grow out of his roots:
verses.decoded: A new leader will come from Jesse's family line, like a shoot growing from a tree stump.

verses.kjv: And the spirit of the Lord shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of the Lord;
verses.decoded: God's Spirit will be with him, giving him wisdom, understanding, good advice, strength, knowledge, and reverence for God.

verses.kjv: And shall make him of quick understanding in the fear of the Lord: and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither reprove after the hearing of his ears:
verses.decoded: He will be quick to understand and respect God, and he won’t judge based only on what he sees or hears.

verses.kjv: But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.
verses.decoded: He will judge the poor fairly and defend the humble; with his words, he will punish the wicked.

verses.kjv: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his loins, and faithfulness the girdle of his reins.
verses.decoded: He will be surrounded and supported by righteousness and faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verses.decoded: Enemies will live peacefully together—wolves with lambs, leopards with goats, calves with lions—and even children will safely lead them.

verses.kjv: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together: and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.
verses.decoded: Cows and bears will graze together peacefully, their young resting side by side; lions will eat grass like cattle.

verses.kjv: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the cockatrice’ den.
verses.decoded: Even young children will safely play near dangerous snakes and poisonous creatures without harm.

verses.kjv: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain: for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.
verses.decoded: No one will harm others on God's holy mountain because the earth will be filled with the knowledge of God everywhere.

verses.kjv: And in that day there shall be a root of Jesse, which shall stand for an ensign of the people; to it shall the Gentiles seek: and his rest shall be glorious.
verses.decoded: At that time, a descendant of Jesse will become a banner for all people; even non-Jews will look to him, and he will have a glorious place of honor.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
verses.decoded: At that time, God will act again to bring back the remaining people of Israel from many distant lands and nations.

verses.kjv: And he shall set up an ensign for the nations, and shall assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
verses.decoded: He will raise a banner for all nations and gather Israel’s outcasts and Judah’s scattered people from all over the world.

verses.kjv: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and the adversaries of Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.
verses.decoded: Jealousy between Ephraim and Judah will end; they will no longer be enemies or cause trouble for each other.

verses.kjv: But they shall fly upon the shoulders of the Philistines toward the west; they shall spoil them of the east together: they shall lay their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.
verses.decoded: They will defeat the Philistines and take control of Edom, Moab, and Ammon, who will submit to them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his mighty wind shall he shake his hand over the river, and shall smite it in the seven streams, and make men go over dryshod.
verses.decoded: God will silence the power of the Red Sea; with a strong wind, he will divide the river into seven streams, allowing people to cross on dry ground.

verses.kjv: And there shall be an highway for the remnant of his people, which shall be left, from Assyria; like as it was to Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: There will be a clear path for the remaining people who survive from Assyria, just as there was for Israel when they left Egypt.

verses.kjv: And in that day thou shalt say, O Lord, I will praise thee: though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away, and thou comfortedst me.
verses.decoded: On that day you will say, 'O LORD, I will praise you. Even though you were angry with me, your anger has passed, and you have comforted me.'

verses.kjv: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord JEHOVAH is my strength and my song; he also is become my salvation.
verses.decoded: Look, God is my salvation; I will trust Him and not be afraid, because the LORD is my strength and my song; He has become my salvation.

verses.kjv: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.decoded: So with joy, you will draw water from the wells of salvation.

verses.kjv: And in that day shall ye say, Praise the Lord, call upon his name, declare his doings among the people, make mention that his name is exalted.
verses.decoded: On that day you will say, 'Praise the LORD! Call on His name, tell the people what He has done, and proclaim how great His name is.'

verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord; for he hath done excellent things: this is known in all the earth.
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD because He has done wonderful things; this is known throughout the whole earth.

verses.kjv: Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.
verses.decoded: Shout and rejoice, you people of Zion, because the Holy One of Israel is great and lives among you.

verses.kjv: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.
verses.decoded: This is a prophecy concerning Babylon, which Isaiah son of Amoz saw.

verses.kjv: Lift ye up a banner upon the high mountain, exalt the voice unto them, shake the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
verses.decoded: Raise a signal flag on the highest mountain, call out loudly to them, wave your hand to invite them to enter the city gates of the rulers.

verses.kjv: I have commanded my sanctified ones, I have also called my mighty ones for mine anger, even them that rejoice in my highness.
verses.decoded: I have summoned my chosen warriors, my powerful ones, to carry out my anger—those who take pride in my glory.

verses.kjv: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, like as of a great people; a tumultuous noise of the kingdoms of nations gathered together: the Lord of hosts mustereth the host of the battle.
verses.decoded: There is the sound of a vast crowd in the mountains, like many people gathered; the kingdoms of the world assemble noisily. The LORD of armies is organizing his battle forces.

verses.kjv: They come from a far country, from the end of heaven, even the Lord, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
verses.decoded: They come from a distant land, from the farthest place on earth—this is the LORD and the weapons of his anger, sent to destroy the entire land.

verses.kjv: Howl ye; for the day of the Lord is at hand; it shall come as a destruction from the Almighty.
verses.decoded: Cry out in fear, because the day of the LORD is near; it will come as a devastating destruction from the Almighty.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall all hands be faint, and every man’s heart shall melt:
verses.decoded: Because of this, everyone will grow weak, and their courage will fail.

verses.kjv: And they shall be afraid: pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman that travaileth: they shall be amazed one at another; their faces shall be as flames.
verses.decoded: They will be terrified; anguish and pain will grip them like a woman in labor. They will look at each other in shock, their faces glowing like fire.

verses.kjv: Behold, the day of the Lord cometh, cruel both with wrath and fierce anger, to lay the land desolate: and he shall destroy the sinners thereof out of it.
verses.decoded: Look, the day of the LORD is coming, full of cruel wrath and fierce anger, to leave the land in ruins and destroy its sinners.

verses.kjv: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light: the sun shall be darkened in his going forth, and the moon shall not cause her light to shine.
verses.decoded: The stars and constellations will stop shining; the sun will be darkened as it rises, and the moon will not give its light.

verses.kjv: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity; and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.
verses.decoded: I will punish the whole world for its evil and the wicked for their sins; I will stop the arrogance of the proud and humble the pride of the cruel.

verses.kjv: I will make a man more precious than fine gold; even a man than the golden wedge of Ophir.
verses.decoded: I will make people more valuable than pure gold, even more precious than the finest gold from Ophir.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will shake the heavens, and the earth shall remove out of her place, in the wrath of the Lord of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.
verses.decoded: So I will shake the heavens, and the earth will move from its place because of the LORD of armies’ anger and the day of his fierce wrath.

verses.kjv: And it shall be as the chased roe, and as a sheep that no man taketh up: they shall every man turn to his own people, and flee every one into his own land.
verses.decoded: People will scatter like a hunted deer or a sheep no one gathers; everyone will run back to their own people and flee to their own country.

verses.kjv: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is joined unto them shall fall by the sword.
verses.decoded: Anyone who is caught will be killed, and everyone who joins them will fall by the sword.

verses.kjv: Their children also shall be dashed to pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be spoiled, and their wives ravished.
verses.decoded: Their children will be killed right in front of them; their homes will be looted, and their wives will be violated.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, which shall not regard silver; and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.
verses.decoded: Look, I will bring the Medes against them; they will not care about silver or enjoy gold.

verses.kjv: Their bows also shall dash the young men to pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.
verses.decoded: Their bows will kill young men; they will show no mercy to children, not sparing even infants.

verses.kjv: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldees’ excellency, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.decoded: Babylon, the pride of kingdoms and the jewel of the Chaldeans, will be destroyed just like God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah.

verses.kjv: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall the shepherds make their fold there.
verses.decoded: No one will live there again, no one will settle there for many generations; nomads won’t camp there, and shepherds won’t keep their flocks there.

verses.kjv: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and owls shall dwell there, and satyrs shall dance there.
verses.decoded: Wild desert animals will live there; its buildings will be filled with sad creatures; owls will live there, and demons will roam about.

verses.kjv: And the wild beasts of the islands shall cry in their desolate houses, and dragons in their pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.
verses.decoded: Wild animals from distant lands will call out in the empty houses, and monsters will live in her grand palaces; her destruction is near and will not be delayed.
