verses.kjv: For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.
verses.decoded: The LORD will show compassion to Jacob and will still choose Israel, placing them back in their own land. Foreigners will join them, and they will unite with the family of Jacob.

verses.kjv: And the people shall take them, and bring them to their place: and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids: and they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
verses.decoded: Nations will bring the Israelites back to their land. Israel will have authority over those who once enslaved them, making former captors their servants.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve,
verses.decoded: The day will come when the LORD will give you relief from your pain, fear, and the harsh slavery you endured.

verses.kjv: That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!
verses.decoded: You will say this taunt against the king of Babylon: 'How the oppressor has ended! The wealthy city is no more!'

verses.kjv: The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.
verses.decoded: The LORD has broken the power of the wicked and the authority of the rulers.

verses.kjv: He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke, he that ruled the nations in anger, is persecuted, and none hindereth.
verses.decoded: The one who struck the people with constant anger and ruled nations harshly is now being punished, and no one stops it.

verses.kjv: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.
verses.decoded: The whole earth is peaceful and silent; then people burst into joyful singing.

verses.kjv: Yea, the fir trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid down, no feller is come up against us.
verses.decoded: Even the fir trees and cedars of Lebanon celebrate, saying, 'Since you have fallen, no one has come to cut us down.'

verses.kjv: Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming: it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
verses.decoded: The grave below is stirred to greet you; it raises the dead, including all the great leaders and kings who once ruled the nations.

verses.kjv: All they shall speak and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?
verses.decoded: They will all say to you, 'Have you become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?'

verses.kjv: Thy pomp is brought down to the grave, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.
verses.decoded: Your pride has been brought down to the grave along with the sound of your music; worms lie beneath you and cover you.

verses.kjv: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
verses.decoded: How you have fallen from heaven, O shining one, morning star! You have been cut down to the ground, you who once weakened nations!

verses.kjv: For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God: I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north:
verses.decoded: You said in your heart, 'I will climb to heaven, raise my throne above the stars of God, and sit on the highest mountain where the leaders meet.'

verses.kjv: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will be like the most High.
verses.decoded: I will rise above the clouds and be like the Most High God.

verses.kjv: Yet thou shalt be brought down to hell, to the sides of the pit.
verses.decoded: But you will be brought down to the grave, to the depths of the pit.

verses.kjv: They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;
verses.decoded: Those who see you will stare closely and wonder, saying, 'Is this the man who made the earth shake and kingdoms tremble?'

verses.kjv: That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners?
verses.decoded: The one who turned the world into a wasteland and destroyed its cities; who never freed his prisoners to return home.

verses.kjv: All the kings of the nations, even all of them, lie in glory, every one in his own house.
verses.decoded: All the kings of the nations rest in honor, each in their own tomb.

verses.kjv: But thou art cast out of thy grave like an abominable branch, and as the raiment of those that are slain, thrust through with a sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a carcase trodden under feet.
verses.decoded: But you will be thrown out of your grave like a disgusting branch, like the clothes of those killed by the sword, going down to the grave, trampled underfoot like a dead body.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, and slain thy people: the seed of evildoers shall never be renowned.
verses.decoded: You will not be buried with them because you destroyed your land and killed your people; the descendants of evildoers will never be honored.

verses.kjv: Prepare slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers; that they do not rise, nor possess the land, nor fill the face of the world with cities.
verses.decoded: Prepare to kill his children because of their fathers’ sins, so they will not rise, take the land, or fill the earth with cities.

verses.kjv: For I will rise up against them, saith the Lord of hosts, and cut off from Babylon the name, and remnant, and son, and nephew, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: For I will rise against them, says the LORD of hosts, and completely destroy Babylon’s name, survivors, children, and relatives.

verses.kjv: I will also make it a possession for the bittern, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: I will turn it into a home for desert birds and water pools; I will sweep it away with the broom of destruction, says the LORD of hosts.

verses.kjv: The Lord of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
verses.decoded: The LORD of hosts has sworn, saying, 'What I have planned will surely happen; what I have decided will stand.'

verses.kjv: That I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulders.
verses.decoded: I will defeat the Assyrian in my land and trample him on my mountains; then his oppression will be removed from them.

verses.kjv: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth: and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.
verses.decoded: This is the plan made for the whole earth; this is the power extended over all nations.

verses.kjv: For the Lord of hosts hath purposed, and who shall disannul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?
verses.decoded: The LORD of hosts has made this plan—who can cancel it? His hand is stretched out—who can stop it?

verses.kjv: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.
verses.decoded: This message was given in the year King Ahaz died.

verses.kjv: Rejoice not thou, whole Palestina, because the rod of him that smote thee is broken: for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth a cockatrice, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.
verses.decoded: Don’t celebrate, whole Philistia, just because the one who struck you is broken; from the serpent’s root will come a poisonous snake, and its offspring will be a fiery flying serpent.

verses.kjv: And the firstborn of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety: and I will kill thy root with famine, and he shall slay thy remnant.
verses.decoded: The poor’s firstborn will eat and the needy will rest safely; I will destroy your root with famine and kill your survivors.

verses.kjv: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou, whole Palestina, art dissolved: for there shall come from the north a smoke, and none shall be alone in his appointed times.
verses.decoded: Wail, O gate! Shout, O city! All of Palestine is destroyed, because smoke will come from the north, and no one will be safe at the times set for gatherings.

verses.kjv: What shall one then answer the messengers of the nation? That the Lord hath founded Zion, and the poor of his people shall trust in it.
verses.decoded: What will be the reply to the envoys from the nations? That the LORD has established Zion, and the humble among His people will rely on it.

verses.kjv: The burden of Moab. Because in the night Ar of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence; because in the night Kir of Moab is laid waste, and brought to silence;
verses.decoded: A message of judgment against Moab: during the night, the city of Ar in Moab is destroyed and silenced; similarly, the city of Kir in Moab is destroyed and silenced at night.

verses.kjv: He is gone up to Bajith, and to Dibon, the high places, to weep: Moab shall howl over Nebo, and over Medeba: on all their heads shall be baldness, and every beard cut off.
verses.decoded: Someone has gone to Bajith and Dibon, the sacred places, to mourn; Moab will wail loudly over Nebo and Medeba, with everyone showing signs of mourning by shaving their heads and cutting off their beards.

verses.kjv: In their streets they shall gird themselves with sackcloth: on the tops of their houses, and in their streets, every one shall howl, weeping abundantly.
verses.decoded: In the streets, people will wear sackcloth as a sign of mourning; on rooftops and in the streets, everyone will cry out loudly and weep deeply.

verses.kjv: And Heshbon shall cry, and Elealeh: their voice shall be heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed soldiers of Moab shall cry out; his life shall be grievous unto him.
verses.decoded: The cities of Heshbon and Elealeh will cry out, their voices reaching as far as Jahaz; even Moab’s soldiers will cry out in distress, feeling deep suffering.

verses.kjv: My heart shall cry out for Moab; his fugitives shall flee unto Zoar, an heifer of three years old: for by the mounting up of Luhith with weeping shall they go it up; for in the way of Horonaim they shall raise up a cry of destruction.
verses.decoded: I feel deep sorrow for Moab; its refugees will flee to Zoar, which is like a young heifer. They will climb the hill of Luhith weeping, and along the road to Horonaim, they will raise a loud cry of ruin.

verses.kjv: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate: for the hay is withered away, the grass faileth, there is no green thing.
verses.decoded: The waters of Nimrim will dry up; the hay will wither, the grass will die, and nothing green will remain.

verses.kjv: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away to the brook of the willows.
verses.decoded: All the wealth and possessions they have gathered will be taken away to the brook of the willows.

verses.kjv: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the howling thereof unto Eglaim, and the howling thereof unto Beer-elim.
verses.decoded: The sound of mourning has spread all around Moab’s borders, with loud wailing reaching the towns of Eglaim and Beerelim.

verses.kjv: For the waters of Dimon shall be full of blood: for I will bring more upon Dimon, lions upon him that escapeth of Moab, and upon the remnant of the land.
verses.decoded: The waters of Dimon will run red with blood; I will bring even more punishment there, like lions attacking those who escape from Moab and the survivors in the land.

verses.kjv: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.decoded: Send a tribute or message to the ruler of the land from Sela (Petra) to the wilderness, reaching the mountain of Zion's daughter.

verses.kjv: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.decoded: Just like a bird forced out of its nest, the women of Moab will gather at the river crossings of Arnon, displaced and vulnerable.

verses.kjv: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.decoded: Make wise plans and carry out justice; be a protective shade like night at noon; shelter the outcasts and do not expose those who are wandering.

verses.kjv: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.decoded: Let my exiles live with you, Moab; protect them from their enemies, because the oppressors and plunderers have been destroyed and driven out.

verses.kjv: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.decoded: The throne will be established with mercy; the ruler will sit in truth in David’s tent, judging fairly, seeking justice, and quickly doing what is right.

verses.kjv: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.decoded: We have heard about Moab’s great pride, arrogance, and anger, but their false boasts will not come true.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.decoded: Moab will cry out in grief for itself; everyone will mourn because the stronghold of Kirhareseth has been destroyed; it is seriously damaged.

verses.kjv: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.decoded: The fields of Heshbon are failing, and the vineyards of Sibmah are ruined; foreign rulers have destroyed the best crops, reaching as far as Jazer and wandering through the wilderness; the vines are uprooted and have spread across the sea.

verses.kjv: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.decoded: I will mourn deeply like the people of Jazer for the ruined vineyards of Sibmah; I will weep for Heshbon and Elealeh because the joyful cries over your summer fruits and harvest have stopped.

verses.kjv: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.decoded: Happiness and joy are gone from the fertile fields; there will be no singing or shouting in the vineyards; no one will press grapes to make wine because I have stopped their celebrations.

verses.kjv: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.
verses.decoded: My heart will ache like a harp for Moab, and my deepest feelings will grieve for Kirhareseth.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.decoded: When Moab is exhausted and desperate on the mountain, it will go to its temple to pray, but its prayers will not be answered.

verses.kjv: This is the word that the Lord hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.decoded: This is the message the LORD has declared about Moab from that time onward.

verses.kjv: But now the Lord hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.decoded: But now the LORD says: Within three years, like the short term of a hired worker, Moab’s pride will be despised along with its large population; only a small and weak remnant will remain.

verses.kjv: The burden of Damascus. Behold, Damascus is taken away from being a city, and it shall be a ruinous heap.
verses.decoded: A prophecy against Damascus: Look, Damascus will no longer be a city; it will become a ruined pile of rubble.

verses.kjv: The cities of Aroer are forsaken: they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.
verses.decoded: The towns of Aroer will be deserted and become places where sheep rest peacefully without fear.

verses.kjv: The fortress also shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria: they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: The stronghold in Ephraim will disappear, and the kingdoms of Damascus and the remaining Syrians will vanish, just as the glory of Israel has faded, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: And in that day it shall come to pass, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.
verses.decoded: On that day, the pride and prosperity of Jacob (Israel) will diminish, and their strength will weaken.

verses.kjv: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the corn, and reapeth the ears with his arm; and it shall be as he that gathereth ears in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.decoded: It will be like a harvest worker gathering grain with his arm, or like someone collecting leftover ears of grain in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: Yet gleaning grapes shall be left in it, as the shaking of an olive tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost fruitful branches thereof, saith the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Still, some grapes will remain, like a few olives left shaking on the top branches—two or three here, four or five there—says the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: At that day shall a man look to his Maker, and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: At that time, people will turn their eyes to their Creator and honor the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he shall not look to the altars, the work of his hands, neither shall respect that which his fingers have made, either the groves, or the images.
verses.decoded: They will no longer trust the altars they made with their own hands, nor respect the idols, groves, or sun images they created.

verses.kjv: In that day shall his strong cities be as a forsaken bough, and an uppermost branch, which they left because of the children of Israel: and there shall be desolation.
verses.decoded: On that day, their fortified cities will be like a broken branch abandoned because of Israel, and the land will be desolate.

verses.kjv: Because thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength, therefore shalt thou plant pleasant plants, and shalt set it with strange slips:
verses.decoded: Because you have forgotten the God who saved you and ignored the source of your strength, you will plant beautiful crops but use foreign seeds.

verses.kjv: In the day shalt thou make thy plant to grow, and in the morning shalt thou make thy seed to flourish: but the harvest shall be a heap in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
verses.decoded: You will plant and nurture your crops during the day and morning, but when harvest comes, it will be gathered into a pile of ruin during a time of grief and deep sorrow.

verses.kjv: Woe to the multitude of many people, which make a noise like the noise of the seas; and to the rushing of nations, that make a rushing like the rushing of mighty waters!
verses.decoded: Woe to the large crowds that roar like the sound of the sea, and to the rushing nations that surge like powerful waters!

verses.kjv: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but God shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like a rolling thing before the whirlwind.
verses.decoded: The nations will rush forward like a flood, but God will rebuke them; they will flee far away, scattered like chaff on the mountains before the wind, or like thistledown blown by a storm.

verses.kjv: And behold at eveningtide trouble; and before the morning he is not. This is the portion of them that spoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.
verses.decoded: Look, trouble comes at evening, but by morning it is gone. This is the fate of those who plunder us and steal from us.

verses.kjv: Woe to the land shadowing with wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia:
verses.decoded: Woe to the land covered with wings, located beyond the rivers of Ethiopia.

verses.kjv: That sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of bulrushes upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation scattered and peeled, to a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden down, whose land the rivers have spoiled!
verses.decoded: They send envoys by sea in boats made of reeds, saying, 'Go quickly to a nation that is spread out and exposed, a people feared from the start until now; a nation divided and oppressed, whose land has been damaged by rivers.'

verses.kjv: All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.
verses.decoded: Everyone in the world, all who live on the earth, watch carefully when a banner is raised on the mountains and listen when a trumpet sounds.

verses.kjv: For so the Lord said unto me, I will take my rest, and I will consider in my dwelling place like a clear heat upon herbs, and like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me, 'I will rest and watch from my dwelling place, like the warm sun on plants or like a refreshing dew cloud during harvest time.'

verses.kjv: For afore the harvest, when the bud is perfect, and the sour grape is ripening in the flower, he shall both cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and take away and cut down the branches.
verses.decoded: Before the harvest, when the buds are fully formed and the sour grapes are ripening, he will prune the shoots with pruning hooks and cut down the branches.

verses.kjv: They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth: and the fowls shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.
verses.decoded: The cut branches will be left for the birds of the mountains and the animals of the earth; birds will feed on them in summer, and animals will feed on them in winter.

verses.kjv: In that time shall the present be brought unto the Lord of hosts of a people scattered and peeled, and from a people terrible from their beginning hitherto; a nation meted out and trodden under foot, whose land the rivers have spoiled, to the place of the name of the Lord of hosts, the mount Zion.
verses.decoded: At that time, gifts will be brought to the LORD of hosts from a people spread out and exposed, a people feared from the beginning until now; a nation divided and oppressed, whose land has been damaged by rivers, to the place named after the LORD of hosts, Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: The burden of Egypt. Behold, the Lord rideth upon a swift cloud, and shall come into Egypt: and the idols of Egypt shall be moved at his presence, and the heart of Egypt shall melt in the midst of it.
verses.decoded: This is a prophecy about Egypt. Look, the LORD is coming quickly like a storm cloud into Egypt; the idols there will tremble before Him, and the people of Egypt will be terrified and confused.

verses.kjv: And I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
verses.decoded: I will cause Egyptians to turn against each other; brothers will fight brothers, neighbors will fight neighbors, cities will fight cities, and kingdoms will fight kingdoms.

verses.kjv: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst thereof; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek to the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.
verses.decoded: The spirit and strength of Egypt will disappear; I will ruin their plans. They will turn to idols, sorcerers, mediums, and magicians for help.

verses.kjv: And the Egyptians will I give over into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: I will hand the Egyptians over to a harsh ruler, and a cruel king will govern them, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and dried up.
verses.decoded: The waters from the sea will dry up, and the Nile River will shrink and dry out.

verses.kjv: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
verses.decoded: The rivers will be diverted away, the canals and irrigation channels will dry up, and the plants like reeds and rushes will die.

verses.kjv: The paper reeds by the brooks, by the mouth of the brooks, and every thing sown by the brooks, shall wither, be driven away, and be no more.
verses.decoded: The papyrus reeds along the streams and everything planted near the water will wither, be swept away, and cease to exist.

verses.kjv: The fishers also shall mourn, and all they that cast angle into the brooks shall lament, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.
verses.decoded: Fishermen will grieve, those who fish with hooks will mourn, and those who spread nets over the water will grow weak and discouraged.

verses.kjv: Moreover they that work in fine flax, and they that weave networks, shall be confounded.
verses.decoded: Those who spin fine flax and those who weave cloth will be ashamed and confused.

verses.kjv: And they shall be broken in the purposes thereof, all that make sluices and ponds for fish.
verses.decoded: All who build irrigation channels and fish ponds will fail in their work.

verses.kjv: Surely the princes of Zoan are fools, the counsel of the wise counsellers of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?
verses.decoded: The leaders of Zoan are foolish, and Pharaoh’s wise advisors have become senseless. How can you claim to be wise, descendants of ancient kings?

verses.kjv: Where are they? where are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now, and let them know what the Lord of hosts hath purposed upon Egypt.
verses.decoded: Where are your wise men now? Let them explain and understand what the LORD Almighty has planned for Egypt.

verses.kjv: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Noph are deceived; they have also seduced Egypt, even they that are the stay of the tribes thereof.
verses.decoded: The leaders of Zoan are foolish, the leaders of Noph are deceived; even those who support the tribes of Egypt have led the nation astray.

verses.kjv: The Lord hath mingled a perverse spirit in the midst thereof: and they have caused Egypt to err in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.
verses.decoded: The LORD has caused a spirit of confusion and perversity to spread among them, making Egypt stumble in everything it does, like a drunkard staggering in his own vomit.

verses.kjv: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which the head or tail, branch or rush, may do.
verses.decoded: No work will succeed in Egypt, whether by the leaders or the common people, the important or the insignificant.

verses.kjv: In that day shall Egypt be like unto women: and it shall be afraid and fear because of the shaking of the hand of the Lord of hosts, which he shaketh over it.
verses.decoded: On that day, Egypt will be vulnerable and frightened, trembling because of the powerful hand of the LORD Almighty shaking against it.

verses.kjv: And the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt, every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts, which he hath determined against it.
verses.decoded: The land of Judah will become a source of fear for Egypt; anyone who talks about Judah will be afraid because of the LORD Almighty’s plan against Egypt.

verses.kjv: In that day shall five cities in the land of Egypt speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the Lord of hosts; one shall be called, The city of destruction.
verses.decoded: At that time, five cities in Egypt will speak the language of Canaan and pledge allegiance to the LORD Almighty; one city will be called 'The City of Destruction.'

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be an altar to the Lord in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to the Lord.
verses.decoded: There will be an altar to the LORD in the center of Egypt and a pillar marking the border dedicated to the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto the Lord of hosts in the land of Egypt: for they shall cry unto the Lord because of the oppressors, and he shall send them a saviour, and a great one, and he shall deliver them.
verses.decoded: This will serve as a sign and testimony to the LORD in Egypt: when the people cry out to Him because of their oppressors, He will send a savior, a mighty deliverer, to rescue them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know the Lord in that day, and shall do sacrifice and oblation; yea, they shall vow a vow unto the Lord, and perform it.
verses.decoded: The LORD will be recognized by Egypt, and the Egyptians will worship Him with sacrifices and offerings; they will make vows to the LORD and keep them.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall smite Egypt: he shall smite and heal it: and they shall return even to the Lord, and he shall be intreated of them, and shall heal them.
verses.decoded: The LORD will strike Egypt, but He will also heal it; they will turn back to the LORD, seek His favor, and He will heal them.

verses.kjv: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria, and the Egyptians shall serve with the Assyrians.
verses.decoded: At that time, there will be a direct road between Egypt and Assyria; people from Assyria will enter Egypt, and Egyptians will go into Assyria, and they will cooperate and serve together.

verses.kjv: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, even a blessing in the midst of the land:
verses.decoded: On that day, Israel will be a third partner along with Egypt and Assyria, a blessing in the land.

verses.kjv: Whom the Lord of hosts shall bless, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty will bless them, saying, 'Blessed be Egypt, my people; Assyria, the work of my hands; and Israel, my special possession.'

verses.kjv: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, (when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him,) and fought against Ashdod, and took it;
verses.decoded: In the year when the commander Tartan came to Ashdod, sent by King Sargon of Assyria, and attacked and captured Ashdod;

verses.kjv: At the same time spake the Lord by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put off thy shoe from thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.
verses.decoded: At that time, the LORD spoke through Isaiah, son of Amoz, saying, 'Go, remove your sackcloth and take off your shoes.' So Isaiah did this, walking naked and barefoot.

verses.kjv: And the Lord said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and wonder upon Egypt and upon Ethiopia;
verses.decoded: The LORD said, 'Just as my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot for three years, this will be a sign and a warning concerning Egypt and Cush (Ethiopia).'

verses.kjv: So shall the king of Assyria lead away the Egyptians prisoners, and the Ethiopians captives, young and old, naked and barefoot, even with their buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria will capture Egyptians and Cushites—young and old—leading them away naked and barefoot, with their backsides exposed, bringing shame upon Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
verses.decoded: They will be terrified and ashamed of Cush, whom they trusted, and of Egypt, their source of pride.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitant of this isle shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we flee for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and how shall we escape?
verses.decoded: On that day, the people of this land will say, 'This is the very help we trusted in to escape the king of Assyria—how can we possibly be saved?'

verses.kjv: The burden of the desert of the sea. As whirlwinds in the south pass through; so it cometh from the desert, from a terrible land.
verses.decoded: This is a prophecy concerning the desert near the sea. Like strong winds blowing from the south, it comes from the desert, from a dreadful land.

verses.kjv: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous dealer dealeth treacherously, and the spoiler spoileth. Go up, O Elam: besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.
verses.decoded: I have received a troubling vision: the dishonest trader acts deceitfully, and the plunderer takes everything. Attack, Elam! Lay siege, Media! I have ended all their suffering.

verses.kjv: Therefore are my loins filled with pain: pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman that travaileth: I was bowed down at the hearing of it; I was dismayed at the seeing of it.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I am filled with anguish; I feel the pain like a woman in labor. I was overwhelmed when I heard it and terrified when I saw it.

verses.kjv: My heart panted, fearfulness affrighted me: the night of my pleasure hath he turned into fear unto me.
verses.decoded: My heart raced and fear overwhelmed me; the night that once brought me joy has been turned into a night of terror.

verses.kjv: Prepare the table, watch in the watchtower, eat, drink: arise, ye princes, and anoint the shield.
verses.decoded: Get the table ready, keep watch from the tower, eat and drink; rise up, leaders, and prepare your shields.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman, let him declare what he seeth.
verses.decoded: The Lord told me, 'Go and appoint a watchman to report whatever he sees.'

verses.kjv: And he saw a chariot with a couple of horsemen, a chariot of asses, and a chariot of camels; and he hearkened diligently with much heed:
verses.decoded: The watchman saw a chariot with two horsemen, a donkey-drawn chariot, and a camel caravan; he listened carefully and attentively.

verses.kjv: And he cried, A lion: My lord, I stand continually upon the watchtower in the daytime, and I am set in my ward whole nights:
verses.decoded: He shouted, 'A lion!' My lord, I stand watch day and night without rest.

verses.kjv: And, behold, here cometh a chariot of men, with a couple of horsemen. And he answered and said, Babylon is fallen, is fallen; and all the graven images of her gods he hath broken unto the ground.
verses.decoded: Then another chariot with two horsemen appeared. The watchman said, 'Babylon has fallen! It has fallen! All the idols of her gods have been smashed to the ground.'

verses.kjv: O my threshing, and the corn of my floor: that which I have heard of the Lord of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.
verses.decoded: My harvest and the grain from my threshing floor—what I have heard from the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, the God of Israel—I have told you.

verses.kjv: The burden of Dumah. He calleth to me out of Seir, Watchman, what of the night? Watchman, what of the night?
verses.decoded: This is a prophecy about Dumah. Someone from Seir calls out to me, 'Watchman, what time is the night? Watchman, what time is the night?'

verses.kjv: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: return, come.
verses.decoded: The watchman replies, 'Morning is coming, but night is also near. If you want to ask, ask; then go back and come again.'

verses.kjv: The burden upon Arabia. In the forest in Arabia shall ye lodge, O ye travelling companies of Dedanim.
verses.decoded: This is a prophecy against Arabia: You caravans from Dedan will camp in the Arabian forests.

verses.kjv: The inhabitants of the land of Tema brought water to him that was thirsty, they prevented with their bread him that fled.
verses.decoded: The people of Tema gave water to the thirsty and provided bread to those fleeing for safety.

verses.kjv: For they fled from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.
verses.decoded: They fled from swords, drawn weapons, bent bows, and the terrible horrors of war.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of an hireling, and all the glory of Kedar shall fail:
verses.decoded: The Lord told me that within a year—just like a hired worker’s yearly contract—all the pride and honor of Kedar will come to an end.

verses.kjv: And the residue of the number of archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be diminished: for the Lord God of Israel hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: The remaining skilled archers and warriors of Kedar will be greatly reduced, because the LORD God of Israel has declared it.

verses.kjv: The burden of the valley of vision. What aileth thee now, that thou art wholly gone up to the housetops?
verses.decoded: A message concerning the Valley of Vision: What is troubling you now that you have climbed up to the rooftops?

verses.kjv: Thou that art full of stirs, a tumultuous city, a joyous city: thy slain men are not slain with the sword, nor dead in battle.
verses.decoded: You are a city full of commotion, noisy and lively, but your dead were not killed by the sword or in battle.

verses.kjv: All thy rulers are fled together, they are bound by the archers: all that are found in thee are bound together, which have fled from far.
verses.decoded: All your leaders have fled together; they are captured by the archers. Everyone found in the city is captured, even those who fled from far away.

verses.kjv: Therefore said I, Look away from me; I will weep bitterly, labour not to comfort me, because of the spoiling of the daughter of my people.
verses.decoded: So I said, 'Don’t try to comfort me; I will weep deeply because my people’s daughter has been destroyed.'

verses.kjv: For it is a day of trouble, and of treading down, and of perplexity by the Lord God of hosts in the valley of vision, breaking down the walls, and of crying to the mountains.
verses.decoded: This is a day of distress, oppression, and confusion caused by the Lord of Heaven’s Armies in the Valley of Vision, breaking down walls and crying out to the mountains.

verses.kjv: And Elam bare the quiver with chariots of men and horsemen, and Kir uncovered the shield.
verses.decoded: Elam carries the quiver with chariots and horsemen, and Kir exposes its shield.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that thy choicest valleys shall be full of chariots, and the horsemen shall set themselves in array at the gate.
verses.decoded: Your best valleys will be filled with chariots, and horsemen will line up at the city gates.

verses.kjv: And he discovered the covering of Judah, and thou didst look in that day to the armour of the house of the forest.
verses.decoded: He exposed Judah’s defenses, and on that day you looked to the armor stored in the Forest of Lebanon.

verses.kjv: Ye have seen also the breaches of the city of David, that they are many: and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
verses.decoded: You have noticed many breaches in the city of David’s walls and have collected water from the lower pool.

verses.kjv: And ye have numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and the houses have ye broken down to fortify the wall.
verses.decoded: You counted the houses in Jerusalem and tore some down to strengthen the city walls.

verses.kjv: Ye made also a ditch between the two walls for the water of the old pool: but ye have not looked unto the maker thereof, neither had respect unto him that fashioned it long ago.
verses.decoded: You dug a trench between the two walls to bring water from the old pool, but you did not consider or honor the one who made it long ago.

verses.kjv: And in that day did the Lord God of hosts call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
verses.decoded: On that day, the Lord of Heaven’s Armies called for weeping, mourning, shaving heads, and wearing sackcloth.

verses.kjv: And behold joy and gladness, slaying oxen, and killing sheep, eating flesh, and drinking wine: let us eat and drink; for to morrow we shall die.
verses.decoded: But instead, there was joy and celebration—slaughtering oxen and sheep, eating meat, and drinking wine, saying, 'Let’s eat and drink because tomorrow we die.'

verses.kjv: And it was revealed in mine ears by the Lord of hosts, Surely this iniquity shall not be purged from you till ye die, saith the Lord God of hosts.
verses.decoded: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies told me, 'This sin will not be forgiven until you die,' says the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, which is over the house, and say,
verses.decoded: The Lord of Heaven’s Armies says, 'Go to Shebna, the palace treasurer, and say to him,'

verses.kjv: What hast thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out a sepulchre here, as he that heweth him out a sepulchre on high, and that graveth an habitation for himself in a rock?
verses.decoded: What are you doing here? And who is here with you, that you have carved out a tomb for yourself here, like someone who cuts a tomb high up and digs a dwelling for himself in the rock?

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord will carry thee away with a mighty captivity, and will surely cover thee.
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD will take you away into a powerful captivity and will certainly cover you.

verses.kjv: He will surely violently turn and toss thee like a ball into a large country: there shalt thou die, and there the chariots of thy glory shall be the shame of thy lord’s house.
verses.decoded: He will violently throw you like a ball into a distant land; there you will die, and the pride of your lord’s house will become a disgrace there.

verses.kjv: And I will drive thee from thy station, and from thy state shall he pull thee down.
verses.decoded: I will remove you from your position, and someone else will take your place.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:
verses.decoded: On that day, I will appoint my servant Eliakim son of Hilkiah.

verses.kjv: And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
verses.decoded: I will dress him in your robe and strengthen him with your belt; I will give him your authority, and he will be a father to the people of Jerusalem and Judah.

verses.kjv: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; so he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.
verses.decoded: I will place the key to the house of David on his shoulder; he will open doors that no one can close and close doors that no one can open.

verses.kjv: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a glorious throne to his father’s house.
verses.decoded: I will secure him like a nail firmly fixed in a safe place; he will be a glorious throne for his family.

verses.kjv: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, all vessels of small quantity, from the vessels of cups, even to all the vessels of flagons.
verses.decoded: All the honor of his family, including descendants and possessions, from small cups to large flagons, will depend on him.

verses.kjv: In that day, saith the Lord of hosts, shall the nail that is fastened in the sure place be removed, and be cut down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: On that day, says the LORD of hosts, the nail firmly fixed in the secure place will be removed, cut down, and fall; the burden it carried will be taken away, because the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: The burden of Tyre. Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for it is laid waste, so that there is no house, no entering in: from the land of Chittim it is revealed to them.
verses.decoded: A prophecy against Tyre: Ships from Tarshish, wail, because Tyre has been destroyed; there are no homes left, no place to enter. This news has come from the land of Chittim.

verses.kjv: Be still, ye inhabitants of the isle; thou whom the merchants of Zidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.
verses.decoded: Be silent, people living on the island, you who have been enriched by the merchants of Sidon who travel across the sea.

verses.kjv: And by great waters the seed of Sihor, the harvest of the river, is her revenue; and she is a mart of nations.
verses.decoded: By the vast seas, the produce of the Nile (Sihor) and the river’s harvest are her income; she is a marketplace for many nations.

verses.kjv: Be thou ashamed, O Zidon: for the sea hath spoken, even the strength of the sea, saying, I travail not, nor bring forth children, neither do I nourish up young men, nor bring up virgins.
verses.decoded: Be ashamed, Sidon, because the sea itself declares it will no longer produce or support new life or young people.

verses.kjv: As at the report concerning Egypt, so shall they be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.
verses.decoded: Just as people were deeply troubled by news about Egypt, they will be greatly distressed by news about Tyre.

verses.kjv: Pass ye over to Tarshish; howl, ye inhabitants of the isle.
verses.decoded: Sail to Tarshish and wail, island dwellers.

verses.kjv: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days? her own feet shall carry her afar off to sojourn.
verses.decoded: Is this the city you once celebrated, with a long history? She will be forced to leave and live far away.

verses.kjv: Who hath taken this counsel against Tyre, the crowning city, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honourable of the earth?
verses.decoded: Who planned this against Tyre, the proud city whose merchants are like princes and whose traders are respected worldwide?

verses.kjv: The Lord of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, and to bring into contempt all the honourable of the earth.
verses.decoded: The Lord Almighty has planned this to humble all proud glory and disgrace the most respected people on earth.

verses.kjv: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: there is no more strength.
verses.decoded: Flow through your land like a river, daughter of Tarshish, but you have no more power or support.

verses.kjv: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the Lord hath given a commandment against the merchant city, to destroy the strong holds thereof.
verses.decoded: God reached out over the sea and shook the kingdoms; He has commanded the destruction of the merchant city and its fortresses.

verses.kjv: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.
verses.decoded: He said, you oppressed virgin, daughter of Sidon, you will no longer be happy; get up and go to Chittim, but even there you will find no peace.

verses.kjv: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, till the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; and he brought it to ruin.
verses.decoded: Look at the land of the Chaldeans; this nation did not exist until the Assyrians established it for desert dwellers. They built towers and palaces, but it was later destroyed.

verses.kjv: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish: for your strength is laid waste.
verses.decoded: Wail, ships of Tarshish, because your power has been destroyed.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.
verses.decoded: In that time, Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years, the length of one king’s reign; after those seventy years, Tyre will return and behave like a prostitute.

verses.kjv: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.
verses.decoded: Take a harp and walk through the city, you prostitute who has been forgotten; play beautiful music and sing many songs so that you will be remembered.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the Lord will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: After seventy years, the LORD will come to restore Tyre, and she will resume her trading and form relationships with all the nations of the world.

verses.kjv: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the Lord: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the Lord, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
verses.decoded: Her goods and earnings will be dedicated to the LORD; they will not be stored away but will be used by those who live in God's presence for food and lasting clothing.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD is making the earth empty and desolate; He is overturning it and scattering its people everywhere.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
verses.decoded: The same fate will come to everyone: common people and priests, servants and masters, maids and their mistresses, buyers and sellers, lenders and borrowers, those who charge interest and those who pay it.

verses.kjv: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.
verses.decoded: The land will be completely emptied and ruined because the LORD has declared it.

verses.kjv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
verses.decoded: The earth mourns and wastes away; the whole world weakens and fades; even the proud people of the earth grow weak.

verses.kjv: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
verses.decoded: The earth is polluted because its people have broken God's laws, changed His commands, and violated the eternal covenant.

verses.kjv: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
verses.decoded: Because of this, a curse has consumed the earth, its people are left in ruin, many are destroyed, and only a few remain.

verses.kjv: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
verses.decoded: The new wine mourns, the grapevines wither, and those who are usually joyful now sigh in sorrow.

verses.kjv: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
verses.decoded: The sound of tambourines stops, the noise of those celebrating ends, and the joy from harps fades away.

verses.kjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
verses.decoded: People will no longer drink wine with singing; even strong drinks will taste bitter to those who drink them.

verses.kjv: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
verses.decoded: The city of chaos is destroyed; every house is closed so no one can enter.

verses.kjv: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
verses.decoded: People cry out for wine in the streets, but all joy is gone and happiness has disappeared from the land.

verses.kjv: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
verses.decoded: The city is left in ruins, and its gates are broken down.

verses.kjv: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
verses.decoded: When this happens in the land among the people, it will be like shaking an olive tree or gathering the last grapes after the harvest.

verses.kjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
verses.decoded: People will raise their voices and sing about the LORD's greatness; they will shout loudly from the coast.

verses.kjv: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
verses.decoded: Therefore, praise the LORD in the valleys and everywhere, even in distant islands; honor the name of the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
verses.decoded: From the farthest corners of the earth, we have heard songs praising the righteous. But I said, 'I am weak, I am weak, woe to me! The deceitful have acted deceitfully; yes, the deceitful have acted very deceitfully.'

verses.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
verses.decoded: Fear, danger, and traps are all around you, people living on the earth.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
verses.decoded: Those who try to escape the sound of fear will fall into a trap; those who climb out of the trap will be caught in another. The heavens above are open, and the earth’s foundations are shaking.

verses.kjv: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
verses.decoded: The earth is completely shattered, totally destroyed, and shaken violently.

verses.kjv: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
verses.decoded: The earth will sway back and forth like a drunk person and be tossed around like a small hut. Its sins weigh heavily on it, and it will collapse and never recover.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
verses.decoded: On that day, the LORD will punish the powerful angels in the heavens and the kings ruling on the earth.

verses.kjv: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
verses.decoded: They will be gathered like prisoners in a dungeon and locked up. After many days, they will be judged.

verses.kjv: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
verses.decoded: Then the moon will be ashamed, and the sun will be embarrassed when the LORD of heavenly armies rules on Mount Zion in Jerusalem, showing his glory before the elders.

verses.kjv: O LORD, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things; thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.
verses.decoded: Lord, you are my God; I will honor you and praise your name because you have done amazing things. Your plans from long ago are reliable and true.

verses.kjv: For thou hast made of a city an heap; of a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.
verses.decoded: You have turned a city into ruins, a fortified city into a heap of rubble; a palace for foreigners will no longer be a city and will never be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.
verses.decoded: Because of this, powerful nations will honor you, and even the most fearsome cities will respect you.

verses.kjv: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.
verses.decoded: You have been a source of strength for the poor and needy during their troubles, a safe shelter from storms and shade from the heat when powerful enemies attack like a storm against a wall.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; even the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.
verses.decoded: You will silence the loud threats of foreigners like a hot dry wind cooled by a passing cloud; the power of the cruel will be humbled.

verses.kjv: And in this mountain shall the Lord of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
verses.decoded: On this mountain, the Lord Almighty will prepare a rich feast for all people, with the best foods and the finest wines.

verses.kjv: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.
verses.decoded: He will remove the covering that hides the truth from all people and take away the veil that blinds all nations.

verses.kjv: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord God will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: He will completely defeat death; the Lord will wipe away all tears and remove the shame and disgrace of his people everywhere, because the Lord has promised it.

verses.kjv: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is the Lord; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
verses.decoded: On that day people will say, 'Look, this is our God! We waited for him, and he saved us. This is the Lord—we waited for him, and now we are joyful and celebrate his salvation.'

verses.kjv: For in this mountain shall the hand of the Lord rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.
verses.decoded: The Lord’s power will rest on this mountain, and Moab will be crushed beneath him like straw trampled into a dung heap.

verses.kjv: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst of them, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim: and he shall bring down their pride together with the spoils of their hands.
verses.decoded: He will stretch out his hands among them like a swimmer pushing through water and will humble their pride along with everything they have gained.

verses.kjv: And the fortress of the high fort of thy walls shall he bring down, lay low, and bring to the ground, even to the dust.
verses.decoded: He will destroy the strong fortress and high walls, leveling them completely to the ground.

verses.kjv: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will God appoint for walls and bulwarks.
verses.decoded: On that day, this song will be sung throughout Judah: 'We have a strong city; God will provide salvation as its walls and defenses.'

verses.kjv: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in.
verses.decoded: Open the gates so that the righteous nation who live by truth can enter.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
verses.decoded: You will keep in complete peace those whose thoughts are focused on you, because they trust in you.

verses.kjv: Trust ye in the Lord for ever: for in the Lord JEHOVAH is everlasting strength:
verses.decoded: Trust in the LORD forever, for the LORD GOD is eternal strength.

verses.kjv: For he bringeth down them that dwell on high; the lofty city, he layeth it low; he layeth it low, even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.
verses.decoded: He brings down the proud who live in high places; he humbles the lofty city to the ground and reduces it to dust.

verses.kjv: The foot shall tread it down, even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.
verses.decoded: The city will be trampled by the feet of the poor and the steps of the needy.

verses.kjv: The way of the just is uprightness: thou, most upright, dost weigh the path of the just.
verses.decoded: The way of the righteous is right; you, who are perfectly just, examine their path.

verses.kjv: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Lord, have we waited for thee; the desire of our soul is to thy name, and to the remembrance of thee.
verses.decoded: We have waited for you, LORD, following your judgments; our souls long for your name and your remembrance.

verses.kjv: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee early: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world will learn righteousness.
verses.decoded: I have longed for you with all my soul during the night; I will seek you early with my spirit, because when your judgments are on the earth, people everywhere will learn what is right.

verses.kjv: Let favour be shewed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness: in the land of uprightness will he deal unjustly, and will not behold the majesty of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Even if the wicked are shown kindness, they will not learn to do right; in a land of fairness, they act unjustly and refuse to acknowledge the LORD's greatness.

verses.kjv: Lord, when thy hand is lifted up, they will not see: but they shall see, and be ashamed for their envy at the people; yea, the fire of thine enemies shall devour them.
verses.decoded: When you raise your hand, they will not notice at first; but eventually they will see and be ashamed for envying your people. Indeed, your enemies will be consumed like fire.

verses.kjv: Lord, thou wilt ordain peace for us: for thou also hast wrought all our works in us.
verses.decoded: LORD, you will establish peace for us because you have done all our work within us.

verses.kjv: O Lord our God, other lords beside thee have had dominion over us: but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.
verses.decoded: O LORD our God, other rulers have ruled over us, but we will only honor your name.

verses.kjv: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all their memory to perish.
verses.decoded: They are dead and will not live again; they have perished and will not rise. You have judged and destroyed them, wiping out all memory of them.

verses.kjv: Thou hast increased the nation, O Lord, thou hast increased the nation: thou art glorified: thou hadst removed it far unto all the ends of the earth.
verses.decoded: You have grown the nation, O LORD; you have made it great and glorified yourself by spreading it to the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: Lord, in trouble have they visited thee, they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.
verses.decoded: Lord, when they were in trouble, they sought you and earnestly prayed while you disciplined them.

verses.kjv: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain, and crieth out in her pangs; so have we been in thy sight, O Lord.
verses.decoded: Just like a pregnant woman nearing childbirth who experiences pain and cries out, we have felt intense distress before you, Lord.

verses.kjv: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.
verses.decoded: We have been expecting something to happen and have suffered, but it has been like giving birth to nothing; no real salvation has come, and the people remain unchanged.

verses.kjv: Thy dead men shall live, together with my dead body shall they arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in dust: for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast out the dead.
verses.decoded: Your dead people will live again; my own body will rise. Wake up and sing, those who live in the grave, because your life-giving power is like the refreshing dew, and the earth will release the dead.

verses.kjv: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself as it were for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.
verses.decoded: Come, my people, go into your rooms and close the doors behind you; hide yourselves for a short time until the anger has passed.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the Lord cometh out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.
verses.decoded: For the Lord is coming from His place to punish the people of the earth for their sins; the earth will reveal the blood of the slain and will no longer hide those who have been killed.

verses.kjv: In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent; and he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea.
verses.decoded: On that day, the LORD will punish Leviathan, the fierce and twisting serpent, with His powerful and mighty sword; He will kill the sea monster.

verses.kjv: In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.
verses.decoded: On that day, sing a song to her, the vineyard producing red wine.

verses.kjv: I the Lord do keep it; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, take care of it; I will constantly water it to protect it from harm, guarding it day and night.

verses.kjv: Fury is not in me: who would set the briers and thorns against me in battle? I would go through them, I would burn them together.
verses.decoded: I am not angry; who would dare challenge me with thorns and briers in battle? I would easily destroy them all.

verses.kjv: Or let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; and he shall make peace with me.
verses.decoded: If someone relies on my strength, they will find peace with me; they will make peace with me.

verses.kjv: He shall cause them that come of Jacob to take root: Israel shall blossom and bud, and fill the face of the world with fruit.
verses.decoded: He will help the descendants of Jacob to grow strong; Israel will flourish and spread its influence everywhere.

verses.kjv: Hath he smitten him, as he smote those that smote him? or is he slain according to the slaughter of them that are slain by him?
verses.decoded: Has he been struck down like those who struck him? Has he been killed like those he killed?

verses.kjv: In measure, when it shooteth forth, thou wilt debate with it: he stayeth his rough wind in the day of the east wind.
verses.decoded: When it grows, you argue with it; but he controls the harsh east wind on its day.

verses.kjv: By this therefore shall the iniquity of Jacob be purged; and this is all the fruit to take away his sin; when he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, the groves and images shall not stand up.
verses.decoded: This will cleanse Jacob’s sin completely; he will destroy the altars, idols, and sacred trees so they cannot stand.

verses.kjv: Yet the defenced city shall be desolate, and the habitation forsaken, and left like a wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.
verses.decoded: The fortified city will become empty and abandoned, like a desert; calves will graze there and rest, eating the plants.

verses.kjv: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off: the women come, and set them on fire: for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have mercy on them, and he that formed them will shew them no favour.
verses.decoded: When its branches are dry, they will be cut off; women will come and burn them because the people lack understanding. Therefore, the Creator will show them no mercy.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall beat off from the channel of the river unto the stream of Egypt, and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.
verses.decoded: On that day, the LORD will remove obstacles from the river’s path to the Nile, and you, the children of Israel, will be gathered one by one.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the great trumpet shall be blown, and they shall come which were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and the outcasts in the land of Egypt, and shall worship the Lord in the holy mount at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: On that day, a loud trumpet will sound, and those who were near death in Assyria and the outcasts in Egypt will come to worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Woe to the crown of pride, to the drunkards of Ephraim, whose glorious beauty is a fading flower, which are on the head of the fat valleys of them that are overcome with wine!
verses.decoded: Woe to the proud leaders, the drunkards of Ephraim, whose once beautiful splendor is fading like a wilting flower on the fertile hills, overwhelmed by wine!

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one, which as a tempest of hail and a destroying storm, as a flood of mighty waters overflowing, shall cast down to the earth with the hand.
verses.decoded: Look, the Lord has a powerful agent like a hailstorm, a destructive tempest, or an overflowing flood who will bring destruction by His hand.

verses.kjv: The crown of pride, the drunkards of Ephraim, shall be trodden under feet:
verses.decoded: The proud leaders and drunkards of Ephraim will be trampled underfoot.

verses.kjv: And the glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be a fading flower, and as the hasty fruit before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.
verses.decoded: The once glorious beauty on the fertile hills will fade like early fruit that is quickly eaten before summer arrives.

verses.kjv: In that day shall the Lord of hosts be for a crown of glory, and for a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people,
verses.decoded: On that day, the Lord Almighty will be a glorious crown and beautiful diadem for the remnant of His people.

verses.kjv: And for a spirit of judgment to him that sitteth in judgment, and for strength to them that turn the battle to the gate.
verses.decoded: He will give a spirit of wisdom to those who judge and strength to those who defend the city gates.

verses.kjv: But they also have erred through wine, and through strong drink are out of the way; the priest and the prophet have erred through strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they are out of the way through strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.
verses.decoded: But they have also gone astray because of wine; priests and prophets are confused and make mistakes due to strong drink; they lose their way, misinterpret visions, and fail in judgment.

verses.kjv: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.
verses.decoded: Every table is covered with vomit and filth; there is no clean place.

verses.kjv: Whom shall he teach knowledge? and whom shall he make to understand doctrine? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts.
verses.decoded: Who can God teach knowledge to? Who can He make understand? Only those who are mature, no longer infants dependent on milk.

verses.kjv: For precept must be upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little:
verses.decoded: Teaching must be done step by step, line by line, little by little.

verses.kjv: For with stammering lips and another tongue will he speak to this people.
verses.decoded: Because this people will not listen, God will speak to them with confusing words and a foreign language.

verses.kjv: To whom he said, This is the rest wherewith ye may cause the weary to rest; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.
verses.decoded: God said, 'This is the rest and refreshment for the weary,' but they refused to listen.

verses.kjv: But the word of the Lord was unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, and there a little; that they might go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.
verses.decoded: God’s message was given step by step, but they stumbled, fell, were broken, trapped, and captured because they refused to obey.

verses.kjv: Wherefore hear the word of the Lord, ye scornful men, that rule this people which is in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: So listen to the word of the Lord, you arrogant leaders who govern the people in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with hell are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us: for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
verses.decoded: Because you say, 'We have made a pact with death and agreed with the grave; when disaster strikes, it won’t harm us,' and because you rely on lies and falsehood for protection,

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner stone, a sure foundation: he that believeth shall not make haste.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am placing a tested and precious cornerstone in Zion as a firm foundation. Whoever trusts in it will not be in a hurry or confused.

verses.kjv: Judgment also will I lay to the line, and righteousness to the plummet: and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding place.
verses.decoded: I will bring judgment measured with fairness and righteousness. False shelters will be destroyed like hail, and hiding places will be flooded and overwhelmed.

verses.kjv: And your covenant with death shall be disannulled, and your agreement with hell shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
verses.decoded: Your agreement with death will be canceled, and your deal with the grave will fail. When the destructive flood passes, it will crush you completely.

verses.kjv: From the time that it goeth forth it shall take you: for morning by morning shall it pass over, by day and by night: and it shall be a vexation only to understand the report.
verses.decoded: From the moment it begins, it will capture you; it will come over you morning and evening, day and night. The news will be confusing and troubling to understand.

verses.kjv: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it: and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.
verses.decoded: The bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap around you.

verses.kjv: For the Lord shall rise up as in mount Perazim, he shall be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon, that he may do his work, his strange work; and bring to pass his act, his strange act.
verses.decoded: The LORD will rise up like He did at Mount Perazim and become angry like at the Valley of Gibeon to carry out His unusual and surprising work.

verses.kjv: Now therefore be ye not mockers, lest your bands be made strong: for I have heard from the Lord God of hosts a consumption, even determined upon the whole earth.
verses.decoded: So don’t be scoffers, or your chains will become stronger. I have heard from the Lord GOD of armies that destruction is planned for the whole earth.

verses.kjv: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.
verses.decoded: Listen carefully and pay attention to what I say.

verses.kjv: Doth the plowman plow all day to sow? doth he open and break the clods of his ground?
verses.decoded: Does the farmer plow all day just to plant seeds? Does he break up the soil all at once?

verses.kjv: When he hath made plain the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and cast in the principal wheat and the appointed barley and the rie in their place?
verses.decoded: After preparing the soil, doesn’t he spread the vetch seeds, scatter the cumin, and plant the best wheat, the designated barley, and spelt in their proper places?

verses.kjv: For his God doth instruct him to discretion, and doth teach him.
verses.decoded: Because God guides the farmer’s decisions and teaches him what to do.

verses.kjv: For the fitches are not threshed with a threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.
verses.decoded: Vetch seeds aren’t threshed with heavy tools, nor is cumin crushed by a cart wheel; instead, vetch is beaten with a stick and cumin with a rod.
