verses.kjv: Bread corn is bruised; because he will not ever be threshing it, nor break it with the wheel of his cart, nor bruise it with his horsemen.
verses.decoded: Grain is crushed gently because the farmer won’t keep threshing it or breaking it with heavy wheels or horses.

verses.kjv: This also cometh forth from the Lord of hosts, which is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in working.
verses.decoded: This teaching comes from the LORD of armies, who is wise in planning and excellent in action.

verses.kjv: Woe to Ariel, to Ariel, the city where David dwelt! add ye year to year; let them kill sacrifices.
verses.decoded: Woe to Ariel, Ariel, the city where David lived! Keep adding year after year; let them continue offering sacrifices.

verses.kjv: Yet I will distress Ariel, and there shall be heaviness and sorrow: and it shall be unto me as Ariel.
verses.decoded: But I will bring trouble to Ariel; there will be sadness and grief. To me, Ariel will be like a place of sacrifice.

verses.kjv: And I will camp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with a mount, and I will raise forts against thee.
verses.decoded: I will surround you with armies, set up siege works, and build fortifications against you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust, and thy voice shall be, as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.
verses.decoded: You will be humbled and speak from the dust; your voice will be faint, like someone communicating with spirits from the grave, whispering from the earth.

verses.kjv: Moreover the multitude of thy strangers shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones shall be as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be at an instant suddenly.
verses.decoded: The many foreigners among you will be like fine dust, and the powerful enemies will be like chaff blown away quickly and suddenly.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be visited of the Lord of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with storm and tempest, and the flame of devouring fire.
verses.decoded: The LORD Almighty will come against you with thunder, earthquake, loud noise, storm, tempest, and consuming fire.

verses.kjv: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her munition, and that distress her, shall be as a dream of a night vision.
verses.decoded: All the nations attacking Ariel and her defenses will be like a fleeting dream or a passing vision at night.

verses.kjv: It shall even be as when an hungry man dreameth, and, behold, he eateth; but he awaketh, and his soul is empty: or as when a thirsty man dreameth, and, behold, he drinketh; but he awaketh, and, behold, he is faint, and his soul hath appetite: so shall the multitude of all the nations be, that fight against mount Zion.
verses.decoded: It will be like a hungry man dreaming he is eating, but when he wakes, he is still hungry; or like a thirsty man dreaming he drinks, but when he wakes, he is faint and still thirsty. So will be all the nations fighting against Mount Zion.

verses.kjv: Stay yourselves, and wonder; cry ye out, and cry: they are drunken, but not with wine; they stagger, but not with strong drink.
verses.decoded: Stop and be amazed; shout and cry out. They are confused and staggering, but not because of wine or strong drink.

verses.kjv: For the Lord hath poured out upon you the spirit of deep sleep, and hath closed your eyes: the prophets and your rulers, the seers hath he covered.
verses.decoded: The LORD has caused you to fall into a deep sleep and closed your eyes; He has covered the prophets, leaders, and seers.

verses.kjv: And the vision of all is become unto you as the words of a book that is sealed, which men deliver to one that is learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I cannot; for it is sealed:
verses.decoded: The visions are like a sealed book given to someone educated, who is asked to read it but says, 'I cannot, because it is sealed.'

verses.kjv: And the book is delivered to him that is not learned, saying, Read this, I pray thee: and he saith, I am not learned.
verses.decoded: Then the book is given to someone uneducated, who is told to read it but replies, 'I am not educated.'

verses.kjv: Wherefore the Lord said, Forasmuch as this people draw near me with their mouth, and with their lips do honour me, but have removed their heart far from me, and their fear toward me is taught by the precept of men:
verses.decoded: The LORD said, 'This people honor me with their words and lips, but their hearts are far from me. Their reverence is taught by human rules.'

verses.kjv: Therefore, behold, I will proceed to do a marvellous work among this people, even a marvellous work and a wonder: for the wisdom of their wise men shall perish, and the understanding of their prudent men shall be hid.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will do an amazing and wonderful thing among this people: the wisdom of their wise men will disappear, and the understanding of their clever men will be hidden.

verses.kjv: Woe unto them that seek deep to hide their counsel from the Lord, and their works are in the dark, and they say, Who seeth us? and who knoweth us?
verses.decoded: Woe to those who try to hide their plans from the LORD, working in darkness and saying, 'No one sees us; no one knows what we are doing.'

verses.kjv: Surely your turning of things upside down shall be esteemed as the potter’s clay: for shall the work say of him that made it, He made me not? or shall the thing framed say of him that framed it, He had no understanding?
verses.decoded: You who twist things around will be treated like clay in the potter's hands. Can the pot say to the potter, 'You didn’t make me'? Or can what is made say to its maker, 'You don’t know what you’re doing'?

verses.kjv: Is it not yet a very little while, and Lebanon shall be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field shall be esteemed as a forest?
verses.decoded: Isn’t it soon that Lebanon will become a fertile field, and that fertile field will be seen as a forest?

verses.kjv: And in that day shall the deaf hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind shall see out of obscurity, and out of darkness.
verses.decoded: At that time, the deaf will hear the words of the Scriptures, and the blind will see clearly, coming out of darkness and confusion.

verses.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the Lord, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: The humble will find greater joy in the Lord, and the poor will celebrate the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: For the terrible one is brought to nought, and the scorner is consumed, and all that watch for iniquity are cut off:
verses.decoded: The ruthless will be destroyed, the mockers will vanish, and those who plan evil will be wiped out.

verses.kjv: That make a man an offender for a word, and lay a snare for him that reproveth in the gate, and turn aside the just for a thing of nought.
verses.decoded: Those who accuse others unfairly over words, trap those who speak truth at the city gate, and punish the innocent for no reason.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord, who redeemed Abraham, concerning the house of Jacob, Jacob shall not now be ashamed, neither shall his face now wax pale.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord, who saved Abraham, says about Jacob’s family: they will no longer be ashamed or afraid.

verses.kjv: But when he seeth his children, the work of mine hands, in the midst of him, they shall sanctify my name, and sanctify the Holy One of Jacob, and shall fear the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: When God sees His people, the work of His hands, living among them, they will honor His name, respect the Holy One of Jacob, and revere the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: They also that erred in spirit shall come to understanding, and they that murmured shall learn doctrine.
verses.decoded: Those who were confused or rebellious will gain understanding, and those who complained will learn God’s teachings.

verses.kjv: Woe to the rebellious children, saith the Lord, that take counsel, but not of me; and that cover with a covering, but not of my spirit, that they may add sin to sin:
verses.decoded: Trouble awaits the rebellious children, says the LORD, who make plans without consulting me and try to protect themselves without my guidance, only adding sin upon sin.

verses.kjv: That walk to go down into Egypt, and have not asked at my mouth; to strengthen themselves in the strength of Pharaoh, and to trust in the shadow of Egypt!
verses.decoded: They go down to Egypt without asking for my advice, trying to make themselves strong by relying on Pharaoh’s power and trusting in Egypt’s protection.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall the strength of Pharaoh be your shame, and the trust in the shadow of Egypt your confusion.
verses.decoded: So Pharaoh’s power will become your disgrace, and trusting in Egypt’s protection will bring you confusion and failure.

verses.kjv: For his princes were at Zoan, and his ambassadors came to Hanes.
verses.decoded: Pharaoh’s officials were at Zoan, and his messengers came to Hanes.

verses.kjv: They were all ashamed of a people that could not profit them, nor be an help nor profit, but a shame, and also a reproach.
verses.decoded: They were all ashamed of a people who could neither help nor benefit them, but only bring shame and disgrace.

verses.kjv: The burden of the beasts of the south: into the land of trouble and anguish, from whence come the young and old lion, the viper and fiery flying serpent, they will carry their riches upon the shoulders of young asses, and their treasures upon the bunches of camels, to a people that shall not profit them.
verses.decoded: The animals of the south carry their loads into a land of trouble and distress, where lions, snakes, and venomous serpents live. They bring their wealth on donkeys and camels to a people who will not benefit them.

verses.kjv: For the Egyptians shall help in vain, and to no purpose: therefore have I cried concerning this, Their strength is to sit still.
verses.decoded: Egypt will offer useless help that accomplishes nothing. That’s why I have said, ‘Their strength is in doing nothing.’

verses.kjv: Now go, write it before them in a table, and note it in a book, that it may be for the time to come for ever and ever:
verses.decoded: Now go and write this down clearly on a tablet and record it in a book, so it will last forever for future generations.

verses.kjv: That this is a rebellious people, lying children, children that will not hear the law of the Lord:
verses.decoded: This is a rebellious people, dishonest children who refuse to listen to the LORD’s teaching.

verses.kjv: Which say to the seers, See not; and to the prophets, Prophesy not unto us right things, speak unto us smooth things, prophesy deceits:
verses.decoded: They tell the visionaries, ‘Don’t see anything,’ and to the prophets, ‘Don’t tell us the truth. Tell us pleasant lies and false hopes.’

verses.kjv: Get you out of the way, turn aside out of the path, cause the Holy One of Israel to cease from before us.
verses.decoded: Go away, get off the path, and stop the Holy One of Israel from acting among us.

verses.kjv: Wherefore thus saith the Holy One of Israel, Because ye despise this word, and trust in oppression and perverseness, and stay thereon:
verses.decoded: Therefore, says the Holy One of Israel, because you reject my message and rely on injustice and wrongdoing, and continue in it,

verses.kjv: Therefore this iniquity shall be to you as a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking cometh suddenly at an instant.
verses.decoded: This sin will be like a wall about to collapse, bulging and unstable, which will suddenly break apart all at once.

verses.kjv: And he shall break it as the breaking of the potters’ vessel that is broken in pieces; he shall not spare: so that there shall not be found in the bursting of it a sherd to take fire from the hearth, or to take water withal out of the pit.
verses.decoded: God will shatter it like a potter’s fragile jar, breaking it completely without mercy, so that not even a piece will remain to carry fire or draw water.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God, the Holy One of Israel; In returning and rest shall ye be saved; in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength: and ye would not.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD, the Holy One of Israel, says: You will be saved by turning back to me and finding rest. Your strength will come from calmness and trust, but you refused.

verses.kjv: But ye said, No; for we will flee upon horses; therefore shall ye flee: and, We will ride upon the swift; therefore shall they that pursue you be swift.
verses.decoded: But you said, 'No, we will escape on horses,' so you will flee; and 'We will ride on swift horses,' so those chasing you will be even faster.

verses.kjv: One thousand shall flee at the rebuke of one; at the rebuke of five shall ye flee: till ye be left as a beacon upon the top of a mountain, and as an ensign on an hill.
verses.decoded: A thousand will run away at the command of one; at the command of five, you will flee, until you are left alone like a lone tree on a mountain top or a flag on a hill.

verses.kjv: And therefore will the Lord wait, that he may be gracious unto you, and therefore will he be exalted, that he may have mercy upon you: for the Lord is a God of judgment: blessed are all they that wait for him.
verses.decoded: So the LORD will wait patiently to show you kindness and be honored by showing you mercy. The LORD is a God who judges fairly; blessed are those who patiently wait for him.

verses.kjv: For the people shall dwell in Zion at Jerusalem: thou shalt weep no more: he will be very gracious unto thee at the voice of thy cry; when he shall hear it, he will answer thee.
verses.decoded: The people will live in Zion, in Jerusalem; you will no longer cry. God will be very kind to you when you call out to Him, and He will answer you.

verses.kjv: And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction, yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more, but thine eyes shall see thy teachers:
verses.decoded: Even if the Lord gives you difficult times and hardship, your teachers will no longer be hidden away; you will clearly see and learn from them.

verses.kjv: And thine ears shall hear a word behind thee, saying, This is the way, walk ye in it, when ye turn to the right hand, and when ye turn to the left.
verses.decoded: You will hear a voice behind you saying, 'This is the way; follow it,' whether you turn right or left.

verses.kjv: Ye shall defile also the covering of thy graven images of silver, and the ornament of thy molten images of gold: thou shalt cast them away as a menstruous cloth; thou shalt say unto it, Get thee hence.
verses.decoded: You will disgrace the silver coverings of your carved idols and the gold decorations of your molten images; you will throw them away like dirty cloth and say to them, 'Get out of here!'

verses.kjv: Then shall he give the rain of thy seed, that thou shalt sow the ground withal; and bread of the increase of the earth, and it shall be fat and plenteous: in that day shall thy cattle feed in large pastures.
verses.decoded: Then God will send rain for your seeds so you can plant the land; the crops will be abundant and rich, and your cattle will graze in wide pastures.

verses.kjv: The oxen likewise and the young asses that ear the ground shall eat clean provender, which hath been winnowed with the shovel and with the fan.
verses.decoded: The oxen and young donkeys that work the land will eat good, clean grain that has been carefully separated and prepared.

verses.kjv: And there shall be upon every high mountain, and upon every high hill, rivers and streams of waters in the day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
verses.decoded: On every high mountain and hill, there will be rivers and streams of water on the day of great destruction when the towers collapse.

verses.kjv: Moreover the light of the moon shall be as the light of the sun, and the light of the sun shall be sevenfold, as the light of seven days, in the day that the Lord bindeth up the breach of his people, and healeth the stroke of their wound.
verses.decoded: The moon’s light will be as bright as the sun, and the sun’s light will be seven times brighter, like the light of a whole week, on the day the LORD heals His people and repairs their wounds.

verses.kjv: Behold, the name of the Lord cometh from far, burning with his anger, and the burden thereof is heavy: his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue as a devouring fire:
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD’s name comes from far away, burning with anger; His punishment is severe. His lips are full of anger, and His words are like a consuming fire.

verses.kjv: And his breath, as an overflowing stream, shall reach to the midst of the neck, to sift the nations with the sieve of vanity: and there shall be a bridle in the jaws of the people, causing them to err.
verses.decoded: His breath will be like a flood reaching up to the neck, sifting the nations like grain with a sieve. There will be a bridle in the mouths of the people, causing them to stumble and go astray.

verses.kjv: Ye shall have a song, as in the night when a holy solemnity is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one goeth with a pipe to come into the mountain of the Lord, to the mighty One of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will have a joyful song, like during a sacred festival at night, and happiness in your heart, like someone playing a pipe as they go to the mountain of the LORD, the mighty Rock of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall cause his glorious voice to be heard, and shall shew the lighting down of his arm, with the indignation of his anger, and with the flame of a devouring fire, with scattering, and tempest, and hailstones.
verses.decoded: The LORD will make His glorious voice heard and show His powerful arm coming down in anger, with flames of fire, causing destruction with storms, hail, and scattering.

verses.kjv: For through the voice of the Lord shall the Assyrian be beaten down, which smote with a rod.
verses.decoded: The Assyrian, who struck with a rod, will be defeated by the power of the LORD's command.

verses.kjv: And in every place where the grounded staff shall pass, which the Lord shall lay upon him, it shall be with tabrets and harps: and in battles of shaking will he fight with it.
verses.decoded: Wherever the LORD directs His rod against him, there will be music of tambourines and harps; and He will fight fiercely in battle.

verses.kjv: For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of the Lord, like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.
verses.decoded: Tophet (a place of burning) was established long ago, prepared especially for the king; it is deep and wide, filled with fire and wood, and the LORD's breath, like burning sulfur, ignites it.

verses.kjv: Woe to them that go down to Egypt for help; and stay on horses, and trust in chariots, because they are many; and in horsemen, because they are very strong; but they look not unto the Holy One of Israel, neither seek the Lord!
verses.decoded: Trouble awaits those who turn to Egypt for help, relying on horses, chariots, and strong horsemen because of their numbers and power, but who do not look to the Holy One of Israel or seek the LORD.

verses.kjv: Yet he also is wise, and will bring evil, and will not call back his words: but will arise against the house of the evildoers, and against the help of them that work iniquity.
verses.decoded: But the LORD is wise and will bring disaster; he will not take back his words. He will rise up against the house of evildoers and those who support wickedness.

verses.kjv: Now the Egyptians are men, and not God; and their horses flesh, and not spirit. When the Lord shall stretch out his hand, both he that helpeth shall fall, and he that is holpen shall fall down, and they all shall fail together.
verses.decoded: The Egyptians are only humans, not gods; their horses are just animals, not spirits. When the LORD reaches out his hand, both those who help and those who are helped will fall, and all will fail together.

verses.kjv: For thus hath the Lord spoken unto me, Like as the lion and the young lion roaring on his prey, when a multitude of shepherds is called forth against him, he will not be afraid of their voice, nor abase himself for the noise of them: so shall the Lord of hosts come down to fight for mount Zion, and for the hill thereof.
verses.decoded: The LORD told me this: Like a lion and its cubs roaring over their prey, not afraid or intimidated by many shepherds coming against it, so the LORD of hosts will come to fight for Mount Zion and its hill.

verses.kjv: As birds flying, so will the Lord of hosts defend Jerusalem; defending also he will deliver it; and passing over he will preserve it.
verses.decoded: Just as birds fly, the LORD of hosts will protect Jerusalem; He will defend it, rescue it, and watch over it.

verses.kjv: Turn ye unto him from whom the children of Israel have deeply revolted.
verses.decoded: Turn back to the LORD, from whom the people of Israel have deeply rebelled.

verses.kjv: For in that day every man shall cast away his idols of silver, and his idols of gold, which your own hands have made unto you for a sin.
verses.decoded: On that day, everyone will throw away their silver and gold idols, which their own hands made and which have caused them to sin.

verses.kjv: Then shall the Assyrian fall with the sword, not of a mighty man; and the sword, not of a mean man, shall devour him: but he shall flee from the sword, and his young men shall be discomfited.
verses.decoded: Then the Assyrian will be defeated by the sword—not by a great warrior—and destroyed by a sword—not by an ordinary man. He will run away from the sword, and his young soldiers will be defeated.

verses.kjv: And he shall pass over to his strong hold for fear, and his princes shall be afraid of the ensign, saith the Lord, whose fire is in Zion, and his furnace in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He will retreat to his fortress in fear, and his leaders will be terrified of the battle flag, says the LORD, whose fire burns in Zion and whose furnace is in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Behold, a king shall reign in righteousness, and princes shall rule in judgment.
verses.decoded: Look, a king will rule with fairness, and his leaders will govern with justice.

verses.kjv: And a man shall be as an hiding place from the wind, and a covert from the tempest; as rivers of water in a dry place, as the shadow of a great rock in a weary land.
verses.decoded: A person will be like a shelter from the wind and a refuge from the storm; like streams of water in a dry desert, or shade from a large rock in a tired, thirsty land.

verses.kjv: And the eyes of them that see shall not be dim, and the ears of them that hear shall hearken.
verses.decoded: Those who see will have clear vision, and those who hear will listen carefully.

verses.kjv: The heart also of the rash shall understand knowledge, and the tongue of the stammerers shall be ready to speak plainly.
verses.decoded: Even those who are quick to act without thinking will gain understanding, and those who struggle to speak will speak clearly and confidently.

verses.kjv: The vile person shall be no more called liberal, nor the churl said to be bountiful.
verses.decoded: A wicked person will no longer be praised as generous, nor will a rude person be called kind.

verses.kjv: For the vile person will speak villany, and his heart will work iniquity, to practise hypocrisy, and to utter error against the Lord, to make empty the soul of the hungry, and he will cause the drink of the thirsty to fail.
verses.decoded: Because wicked people speak evil, plan wrongdoing, act deceitfully, and spread lies against God, they leave the hungry empty and deny drink to the thirsty.

verses.kjv: The instruments also of the churl are evil: he deviseth wicked devices to destroy the poor with lying words, even when the needy speaketh right.
verses.decoded: The tools of a rude person are evil; he plans harmful schemes to ruin the poor with lies, even when the needy are honest.

verses.kjv: But the liberal deviseth liberal things; and by liberal things shall he stand.
verses.decoded: But a generous person plans generous acts, and through generosity he will be established.

verses.kjv: Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.
verses.decoded: Wake up, women who live comfortably; listen carefully, careless daughters; pay attention to what I say.

verses.kjv: Many days and years shall ye be troubled, ye careless women: for the vintage shall fail, the gathering shall not come.
verses.decoded: You careless women will face many days and years of trouble because the grape harvest will fail and the crops will not be gathered.

verses.kjv: Tremble, ye women that are at ease; be troubled, ye careless ones: strip you, and make you bare, and gird sackcloth upon your loins.
verses.decoded: Shake with fear, women who live comfortably; be upset, careless ones; take off your fine clothes, expose yourselves, and put on sackcloth as a sign of mourning.

verses.kjv: They shall lament for the teats, for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
verses.decoded: They will mourn for the breasts that once fed them, for the fertile fields, and for the fruitful vineyards.

verses.kjv: Upon the land of my people shall come up thorns and briers; yea, upon all the houses of joy in the joyous city:
verses.decoded: Thorns and weeds will grow over my people's land, even on all the joyful homes in the happy city.

verses.kjv: Because the palaces shall be forsaken; the multitude of the city shall be left; the forts and towers shall be for dens for ever, a joy of wild asses, a pasture of flocks;
verses.decoded: Because the palaces will be abandoned; the city will be deserted; forts and watchtowers will become animal dens forever, enjoyed by wild donkeys and used as grazing land for sheep.

verses.kjv: Until the spirit be poured upon us from on high, and the wilderness be a fruitful field, and the fruitful field be counted for a forest.
verses.decoded: Until the Spirit is poured out on us from heaven, turning the desert into fertile land and making the fertile land like a forest.

verses.kjv: Then judgment shall dwell in the wilderness, and righteousness remain in the fruitful field.
verses.decoded: Justice will be established even in the most desolate places, and righteousness will continue in the fertile lands.

verses.kjv: And the work of righteousness shall be peace; and the effect of righteousness quietness and assurance for ever.
verses.decoded: Doing what is right will bring peace, and the result of living righteously will be lasting calm and security.

verses.kjv: And my people shall dwell in a peaceable habitation, and in sure dwellings, and in quiet resting places;
verses.decoded: My people will live in peaceful homes, safe houses, and calm places of rest.

verses.kjv: When it shall hail, coming down on the forest; and the city shall be low in a low place.
verses.decoded: When hail falls heavily on the forest, the city will be humbled and brought low.

verses.kjv: Blessed are ye that sow beside all waters, that send forth thither the feet of the ox and the ass.
verses.decoded: You are blessed if you plant your crops near water, where oxen and donkeys can freely walk and work.

verses.kjv: Woe to thee that spoilest, and thou wast not spoiled; and dealest treacherously, and they dealt not treacherously with thee! when thou shalt cease to spoil, thou shalt be spoiled; and when thou shalt make an end to deal treacherously, they shall deal treacherously with thee.
verses.decoded: Trouble awaits you who plunder others without being plundered yourselves, and who act deceitfully when no one has deceived you! But when you stop plundering, you will be plundered; when you stop being deceitful, others will be deceitful to you.

verses.kjv: O Lord, be gracious unto us; we have waited for thee: be thou their arm every morning, our salvation also in the time of trouble.
verses.decoded: Lord, be merciful to us; we have been waiting for you. Be their strength each morning and be our salvation in times of trouble.

verses.kjv: At the noise of the tumult the people fled; at the lifting up of thyself the nations were scattered.
verses.decoded: When the commotion started, the people ran away; when you revealed your power, the nations were scattered.

verses.kjv: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run upon them.
verses.decoded: Your plunder will be collected like caterpillars gathering; like swarms of locusts, he will rush upon them.

verses.kjv: The Lord is exalted; for he dwelleth on high: he hath filled Zion with judgment and righteousness.
verses.decoded: The Lord is exalted because he lives on high; he has filled Jerusalem with justice and fairness.

verses.kjv: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the Lord is his treasure.
verses.decoded: Wisdom and knowledge will be the foundation of your times and the source of your salvation; reverence for the Lord is his greatest treasure.

verses.kjv: Behold, their valiant ones shall cry without: the ambassadors of peace shall weep bitterly.
verses.decoded: Look, their warriors will shout outside; the messengers of peace will cry bitterly.

verses.kjv: The highways lie waste, the wayfaring man ceaseth: he hath broken the covenant, he hath despised the cities, he regardeth no man.
verses.decoded: The roads are deserted, travelers stop coming; he has broken his promises, scorned the cities, and shows no respect for anyone.

verses.kjv: The earth mourneth and languisheth: Lebanon is ashamed and hewn down: Sharon is like a wilderness; and Bashan and Carmel shake off their fruits.
verses.decoded: The land mourns and fades away; Lebanon is ashamed and cut down; Sharon is like a desert; Bashan and Carmel lose their crops.

verses.kjv: Now will I rise, saith the Lord; now will I be exalted; now will I lift up myself.
verses.decoded: Now I will rise, says the Lord; now I will be honored; now I will lift myself up.

verses.kjv: Ye shall conceive chaff, ye shall bring forth stubble: your breath, as fire, shall devour you.
verses.decoded: You will produce only worthless things like chaff and stubble; your own breath, like fire, will consume you.

verses.kjv: And the people shall be as the burnings of lime: as thorns cut up shall they be burned in the fire.
verses.decoded: The people will be like burning lime; like chopped thorns, they will be burned in the fire.

verses.kjv: Hear, ye that are far off, what I have done; and, ye that are near, acknowledge my might.
verses.decoded: Listen, you who are far away, to what I have done; and you who are close, recognize my power.

verses.kjv: The sinners in Zion are afraid; fearfulness hath surprised the hypocrites. Who among us shall dwell with the devouring fire? who among us shall dwell with everlasting burnings?
verses.decoded: Sinners in Jerusalem are terrified; fear has caught hypocrites off guard. Who can live with consuming fire? Who can live with eternal flames?

verses.kjv: He that walketh righteously, and speaketh uprightly; he that despiseth the gain of oppressions, that shaketh his hands from holding of bribes, that stoppeth his ears from hearing of blood, and shutteth his eyes from seeing evil;
verses.decoded: The one who lives rightly and speaks honestly; who rejects dishonest gain, refuses bribes, stops his ears from hearing about violence, and closes his eyes to evil;

verses.kjv: He shall dwell on high: his place of defence shall be the munitions of rocks: bread shall be given him; his waters shall be sure.
verses.decoded: He will live in a safe, elevated place, protected by strong rocky defenses; he will have enough food and reliable water.

verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall see the king in his beauty: they shall behold the land that is very far off.
verses.decoded: You will see the king in all his glory; your eyes will look out over distant lands.

verses.kjv: Thine heart shall meditate terror. Where is the scribe? where is the receiver? where is he that counted the towers?
verses.decoded: Your heart will think about fear and danger. Where are the record keeper, the tax collector, and the one who counted the towers?

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not see a fierce people, a people of a deeper speech than thou canst perceive; of a stammering tongue, that thou canst not understand.
verses.decoded: You will no longer see a fierce nation speaking a strange language that you cannot understand.

verses.kjv: Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities: thine eyes shall see Jerusalem a quiet habitation, a tabernacle that shall not be taken down; not one of the stakes thereof shall ever be removed, neither shall any of the cords thereof be broken.
verses.decoded: Look at Zion, the city of our festivals; you will see Jerusalem as a peaceful home, like a tent that will never be taken down or disturbed.

verses.kjv: But there the glorious Lord will be unto us a place of broad rivers and streams; wherein shall go no galley with oars, neither shall gallant ship pass thereby.
verses.decoded: There, the glorious LORD will be like wide rivers and streams where no warships or large boats can pass.

verses.kjv: For the Lord is our judge, the Lord is our lawgiver, the Lord is our king; he will save us.
verses.decoded: The LORD is our judge, our lawgiver, and our king; he will save us.

verses.kjv: Thy tacklings are loosed; they could not well strengthen their mast, they could not spread the sail: then is the prey of a great spoil divided; the lame take the prey.
verses.decoded: Their ropes are broken; they cannot secure their mast or set their sail properly; as a result, the spoils are divided even by the weak and lame.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitant shall not say, I am sick: the people that dwell therein shall be forgiven their iniquity.
verses.decoded: No one living there will say, 'I am sick,' because the people will have their sins forgiven.

verses.kjv: Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people: let the earth hear, and all that is therein; the world, and all things that come forth of it.
verses.decoded: Nations, come close and listen; people, pay attention! Let the whole earth and everything in it hear this message.

verses.kjv: For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.
verses.decoded: God’s anger is against all nations, and His fierce wrath is against their armies. He has completely destroyed them and handed them over to be killed.

verses.kjv: Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.
verses.decoded: Their dead bodies will be left unburied, and the stench will rise from their corpses. Their blood will flow so much it will cause the mountains to melt.

verses.kjv: And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.
verses.decoded: The entire army of heaven will disappear; the sky will be rolled up like a scroll. All their forces will fall away like leaves falling from a vine or figs dropping from a tree.

verses.kjv: For my sword shall be bathed in heaven: behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.
verses.decoded: My sword will be soaked in the heavens; it will come down against Edom, the people I have cursed, to bring judgment.

verses.kjv: The sword of the Lord is filled with blood, it is made fat with fatness, and with the blood of lambs and goats, with the fat of the kidneys of rams: for the Lord hath a sacrifice in Bozrah, and a great slaughter in the land of Idumea.
verses.decoded: The LORD’s sword is covered in blood, heavy with the fat of lambs, goats, and rams. The LORD has a sacrifice prepared in Bozrah, and a massive slaughter in Edom.

verses.kjv: And the unicorns shall come down with them, and the bullocks with the bulls; and their land shall be soaked with blood, and their dust made fat with fatness.
verses.decoded: Wild animals like unicorns (or possibly rhinoceroses) and cattle will go down with them; their land will be drenched with blood, and the soil enriched with fat.

verses.kjv: For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.
verses.decoded: This is the day when the LORD takes revenge, the year when He repays for the disputes involving Zion.

verses.kjv: And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.
verses.decoded: Its rivers will turn to thick tar, its soil into burning sulfur, and the land will become like burning pitch.

verses.kjv: It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste; none shall pass through it for ever and ever.
verses.decoded: The fire will never be put out, day or night; its smoke will rise forever. The land will remain desolate for all generations, with no one passing through it ever again.

verses.kjv: But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it; the owl also and the raven shall dwell in it: and he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion, and the stones of emptiness.
verses.decoded: Instead, wild birds like cormorants, bitterns, owls, and ravens will inhabit it. The land will be marked by chaos and emptiness.

verses.kjv: They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom, but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.
verses.decoded: People will try to summon its leaders to rule, but no one will be there; all its princes will be gone.

verses.kjv: And thorns shall come up in her palaces, nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons, and a court for owls.
verses.decoded: Thorns will grow in its palaces, nettles and brambles in its fortresses. It will become a home for wild creatures like dragons and owls.

verses.kjv: The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island, and the satyr shall cry to his fellow; the screech owl also shall rest there, and find for herself a place of rest.
verses.decoded: Desert animals will gather with animals from the islands; wild creatures will call to each other. Even the screech owl will find a place to rest there.

verses.kjv: There shall the great owl make her nest, and lay, and hatch, and gather under her shadow: there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.
verses.decoded: The great owl will build her nest there, lay eggs, hatch them, and gather her young under her protection. Vultures will also gather there, each with its mate.

verses.kjv: Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail, none shall want her mate: for my mouth it hath commanded, and his spirit it hath gathered them.
verses.decoded: Look in the book of the LORD and read it carefully: none of these will be missing, and none will be without its partner, because my words have commanded it, and his Spirit has gathered them together.

verses.kjv: And he hath cast the lot for them, and his hand hath divided it unto them by line: they shall possess it for ever, from generation to generation shall they dwell therein.
verses.decoded: He has assigned their portion by casting lots, and his hand has measured it out with a line; they will possess it forever and live there from generation to generation.

verses.kjv: The wilderness and the solitary place shall be glad for them; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.
verses.decoded: The wilderness and lonely places will be joyful for them; the desert will celebrate and bloom like a rose.

verses.kjv: It shall blossom abundantly, and rejoice even with joy and singing: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon, they shall see the glory of the Lord, and the excellency of our God.
verses.decoded: It will bloom richly and celebrate with joy and singing; it will have the beauty of Lebanon’s forests and the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will witness the glory of the LORD and the greatness of our God.

verses.kjv: Strengthen ye the weak hands, and confirm the feeble knees.
verses.decoded: Encourage those who are weak and steady those who are trembling.

verses.kjv: Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save you.
verses.decoded: Tell those who are afraid, ‘Be strong and don’t be afraid. Look, your God is coming with justice; He will come to save you.’

verses.kjv: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf shall be unstopped.
verses.decoded: Then the blind will see, and the deaf will hear.

verses.kjv: Then shall the lame man leap as an hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and streams in the desert.
verses.decoded: Then the lame will jump like a deer, and those who cannot speak will sing, because water will flow in the wilderness and streams will run through the desert.

verses.kjv: And the parched ground shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of dragons, where each lay, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.
verses.decoded: Dry, thirsty land will become pools of water; even the home of desert creatures will be covered with grass, reeds, and rushes.

verses.kjv: And an highway shall be there, and a way, and it shall be called The way of holiness; the unclean shall not pass over it; but it shall be for those: the wayfaring men, though fools, shall not err therein.
verses.decoded: There will be a highway called the Way of Holiness. Unclean people will not travel on it, but it will be for those who walk in it; even simple travelers will not lose their way.

verses.kjv: No lion shall be there, nor any ravenous beast shall go up thereon, it shall not be found there; but the redeemed shall walk there:
verses.decoded: No dangerous animals like lions or wild beasts will be there; they won’t be found on that path. Only the redeemed will walk there.

verses.kjv: And the ransomed of the Lord shall return, and come to Zion with songs and everlasting joy upon their heads: they shall obtain joy and gladness, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
verses.decoded: Those whom the LORD has rescued will return to Zion singing with eternal joy; they will be filled with happiness, and all sadness and pain will disappear.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass in the fourteenth year of king Hezekiah, that Sennacherib king of Assyria came up against all the defenced cities of Judah, and took them.
verses.decoded: In the fourteenth year of King Hezekiah's reign, Sennacherib, the king of Assyria, attacked and captured all the fortified cities of Judah.

verses.kjv: And the king of Assyria sent Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem unto king Hezekiah with a great army. And he stood by the conduit of the upper pool in the highway of the fuller’s field.
verses.decoded: The king of Assyria sent his official Rabshakeh from Lachish to Jerusalem with a large army. Rabshakeh stood by the water channel near the upper pool on the road to the fuller's field.

verses.kjv: Then came forth unto him Eliakim, Hilkiah’s son, which was over the house, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, Asaph’s son, the recorder.
verses.decoded: Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the secretary, and Joah, son of Asaph, the official recorder, came out to meet him.

verses.kjv: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
verses.decoded: Rabshakeh told them, "Tell Hezekiah, ‘This is what the great king of Assyria says: What are you trusting in?’"

verses.kjv: I say, sayest thou, (but they are but vain words) I have counsel and strength for war: now on whom dost thou trust, that thou rebellest against me?
verses.decoded: He said, ‘You say you have plans and strength for war, but those are empty words. Who are you trusting in to rebel against me?’

verses.kjv: Lo, thou trustest in the staff of this broken reed, on Egypt; whereon if a man lean, it will go into his hand, and pierce it: so is Pharaoh king of Egypt to all that trust in him.
verses.decoded: You are relying on Egypt, which is like a broken stick. If someone leans on it, it will break and hurt their hand. That is how Pharaoh, king of Egypt, is to everyone who trusts him.

verses.kjv: But if thou say to me, We trust in the Lord our God: is it not he, whose high places and whose altars Hezekiah hath taken away, and said to Judah and to Jerusalem, Ye shall worship before this altar?
verses.decoded: If you say, ‘We trust in the LORD our God,’ isn’t it the same LORD whose altars and sacred places Hezekiah has destroyed and told Judah and Jerusalem to worship only at this one altar?

verses.kjv: Now therefore give pledges, I pray thee, to my master the king of Assyria, and I will give thee two thousand horses, if thou be able on thy part to set riders upon them.
verses.decoded: Now, give hostages to my master, the king of Assyria, and I will give you two thousand horses if you can provide riders for them.

verses.kjv: How then wilt thou turn away the face of one captain of the least of my master’s servants, and put thy trust on Egypt for chariots and for horsemen?
verses.decoded: How can you refuse even one officer of my master’s servants and instead trust Egypt for chariots and horsemen?

verses.kjv: And am I now come up without the Lord against this land to destroy it? the Lord said unto me, Go up against this land, and destroy it.
verses.decoded: Do you think I have come up against this land without the LORD’s permission? The LORD told me to attack and destroy this land.

verses.kjv: Then said Eliakim and Shebna and Joah unto Rabshakeh, Speak, I pray thee, unto thy servants in the Syrian language; for we understand it: and speak not to us in the Jews’ language, in the ears of the people that are on the wall.
verses.decoded: Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah said to Rabshakeh, ‘Please speak to your servants in Aramaic, since we understand it, but don’t speak to us in Hebrew where the people on the wall can hear.’

verses.kjv: But Rabshakeh said, Hath my master sent me to thy master and to thee to speak these words? hath he not sent me to the men that sit upon the wall, that they may eat their own dung, and drink their own piss with you?
verses.decoded: Rabshakeh replied, ‘Did my master send me to you and your master to speak quietly? Didn’t he send me to the people on the wall so they can eat their own waste and drink their own urine with you?’

verses.kjv: Then Rabshakeh stood, and cried with a loud voice in the Jews’ language, and said, Hear ye the words of the great king, the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Rabshakeh stood and shouted loudly in Hebrew, ‘Listen to the words of the great king, the king of Assyria!’

verses.kjv: Thus saith the king, Let not Hezekiah deceive you: for he shall not be able to deliver you.
verses.decoded: The king says, ‘Don’t let Hezekiah fool you; he cannot save you.’

verses.kjv: Neither let Hezekiah make you trust in the Lord, saying, The Lord will surely deliver us: this city shall not be delivered into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Don’t let Hezekiah make you trust in the LORD by saying, ‘The LORD will definitely save us and this city won’t be handed over to the king of Assyria.’

verses.kjv: Hearken not to Hezekiah: for thus saith the king of Assyria, Make an agreement with me by a present, and come out to me: and eat ye every one of his vine, and every one of his fig tree, and drink ye every one the waters of his own cistern;
verses.decoded: Do not listen to Hezekiah. This is what the king of Assyria says: Make a deal with me by giving a gift, then come out to me. You can eat from your own vineyards and fig trees and drink water from your own wells.

verses.kjv: Until I come and take you away to a land like your own land, a land of corn and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.
verses.decoded: I will come and take you away to a land similar to your own—a land of grain and wine, a land of bread and vineyards.

verses.kjv: Beware lest Hezekiah persuade you, saying, The Lord will deliver us. Hath any of the gods of the nations delivered his land out of the hand of the king of Assyria?
verses.decoded: Be careful not to be convinced by Hezekiah when he says, 'The LORD will save us.' Have any gods of other nations ever saved their lands from the king of Assyria?

verses.kjv: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? where are the gods of Sepharvaim? and have they delivered Samaria out of my hand?
verses.decoded: Where are the gods of Hamath and Arphad? Where are the gods of Sepharvaim? Did they save Samaria from me?

verses.kjv: Who are they among all the gods of these lands, that have delivered their land out of my hand, that the Lord should deliver Jerusalem out of my hand?
verses.decoded: Which of all the gods of these lands has saved their land from me? So why should the LORD save Jerusalem from me?

verses.kjv: But they held their peace, and answered him not a word: for the king’s commandment was, saying, Answer him not.
verses.decoded: But they remained silent and did not answer him, because the king had commanded them not to respond.

verses.kjv: Then came Eliakim, the son of Hilkiah, that was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah, the son of Asaph, the recorder, to Hezekiah with their clothes rent, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
verses.decoded: Then Eliakim, son of Hilkiah, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the secretary, and Joah, son of Asaph, the recorder, came to Hezekiah wearing torn clothes and reported Rabshakeh’s message to him.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when king Hezekiah heard it, that he rent his clothes, and covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: When King Hezekiah heard this, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and went to the temple of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests covered with sackcloth, unto Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz.
verses.decoded: He sent Eliakim, who was in charge of the palace, Shebna the secretary, and the leading priests wearing sackcloth to the prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz.

verses.kjv: And they said unto him, Thus saith Hezekiah, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of blasphemy: for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.
verses.decoded: They told Isaiah, 'This is a day of distress, shame, and insult. It’s like a woman in labor who has no strength to give birth.'

verses.kjv: It may be the Lord thy God will hear the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Assyria his master hath sent to reproach the living God, and will reprove the words which the Lord thy God hath heard: wherefore lift up thy prayer for the remnant that is left.
verses.decoded: Maybe the LORD your God will hear what Rabshakeh says—Rabshakeh was sent by the king of Assyria to insult the living God—and will correct what the LORD has heard. So please pray for the people who remain.

verses.kjv: So the servants of king Hezekiah came to Isaiah.
verses.decoded: So the king’s servants went to see Isaiah.

verses.kjv: And Isaiah said unto them, Thus shall ye say unto your master, Thus saith the Lord, Be not afraid of the words that thou hast heard, wherewith the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed me.
verses.decoded: Isaiah told them, 'Tell your master: This is what the LORD says: Don’t be afraid of the insults you heard from the king of Assyria’s servants.'

verses.kjv: Behold, I will send a blast upon him, and he shall hear a rumour, and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
verses.decoded: I will send a spirit against him, and he will hear a rumor and go back to his own country. There, he will be killed by the sword.

verses.kjv: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah: for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.
verses.decoded: Rabshakeh returned and found the Assyrian king attacking Libnah because he had left Lachish.

verses.kjv: And he heard say concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, He is come forth to make war with thee. And when he heard it, he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,
verses.decoded: He heard that Tirhakah, the king of Ethiopia, was coming to fight against him. When he heard this, he sent messengers to Hezekiah saying,

verses.kjv: Thus shall ye speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying, Let not thy God, in whom thou trustest, deceive thee, saying, Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria.
verses.decoded: Tell King Hezekiah of Judah: Don’t let your God mislead you by saying Jerusalem won’t be captured by the king of Assyria.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou hast heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by destroying them utterly; and shalt thou be delivered?
verses.decoded: You’ve heard how the Assyrian kings have completely destroyed all these lands. Do you think you will escape?

verses.kjv: Have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed, as Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden which were in Telassar?
verses.decoded: Have the gods of the nations rescued those my ancestors destroyed—places like Gozan, Haran, Rezeph, and the people of Eden in Telassar?

verses.kjv: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arphad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?
verses.decoded: Where are the kings of Hamath, Arphad, Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah now?

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up unto the house of the Lord, and spread it before the Lord.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah received the letter from the messengers and read it. Then he went to the temple and laid the letter before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah prayed unto the Lord, saying,
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying,

verses.kjv: O Lord of hosts, God of Israel, that dwellest between the cherubims, thou art the God, even thou alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth: thou hast made heaven and earth.
verses.decoded: Lord Almighty, God of Israel, who lives between the cherubim, you alone are God over all the kingdoms of the earth; you created heaven and earth.

verses.kjv: Incline thine ear, O Lord, and hear; open thine eyes, O Lord, and see: and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which hath sent to reproach the living God.
verses.decoded: Lord, please listen and pay attention; see and hear all the insults Sennacherib has sent against the living God.

verses.kjv: Of a truth, Lord, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations, and their countries,
verses.decoded: Truly, Lord, the Assyrian kings have destroyed many nations and their lands.

verses.kjv: And have cast their gods into the fire: for they were no gods, but the work of men’s hands, wood and stone: therefore they have destroyed them.
verses.decoded: They have burned their gods because they are not real gods, just things made by people from wood and stone; so they destroyed them.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, O Lord our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that thou art the Lord, even thou only.
verses.decoded: So now, Lord our God, save us from his power, so all the kingdoms on earth will know that you alone are the Lord.

verses.kjv: Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent unto Hezekiah, saying, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel, Whereas thou hast prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Assyria:
verses.decoded: Then Isaiah, son of Amoz, sent a message to Hezekiah saying, 'This is what the Lord God of Israel says, since you prayed to me about Sennacherib king of Assyria:'

verses.kjv: This is the word which the Lord hath spoken concerning him; The virgin, the daughter of Zion, hath despised thee, and laughed thee to scorn; the daughter of Jerusalem hath shaken her head at thee.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord says about him: The virgin daughter of Zion has mocked you and laughed at you; the daughter of Jerusalem has turned her head in scorn.

verses.kjv: Whom hast thou reproached and blasphemed? and against whom hast thou exalted thy voice, and lifted up thine eyes on high? even against the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Who are you insulting and blaspheming? Against whom are you raising your voice and looking proudly? Against the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: By thy servants hast thou reproached the Lord, and hast said, By the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the sides of Lebanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars thereof, and the choice fir trees thereof: and I will enter into the height of his border, and the forest of his Carmel.
verses.decoded: You have insulted the Lord through your servants, saying, 'With my many chariots I have climbed the mountains and reached Lebanon’s forests; I will cut down its tall cedars and best fir trees; I will enter its borders and the forest of Carmel.'

verses.kjv: I have digged, and drunk water; and with the sole of my feet have I dried up all the rivers of the besieged places.
verses.decoded: I have dug wells and drunk their water; with my feet I have dried up all the rivers in the fortified cities.

verses.kjv: Hast thou not heard long ago, how I have done it; and of ancient times, that I have formed it? now have I brought it to pass, that thou shouldest be to lay waste defenced cities into ruinous heaps.
verses.decoded: Have you not heard from long ago how I did this? From ancient times I planned it. Now I have made you destroy fortified cities and turn them into ruins.

verses.kjv: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded: they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as corn blasted before it be grown up.
verses.decoded: So their people were weak and terrified; they were like grass in a field, like green plants, like grass on rooftops, or like crops destroyed before they could grow.

verses.kjv: But I know thy abode, and thy going out, and thy coming in, and thy rage against me.
verses.decoded: But I know where you live, when you come and go, and your anger against me.

verses.kjv: Because thy rage against me, and thy tumult, is come up into mine ears, therefore will I put my hook in thy nose, and my bridle in thy lips, and I will turn thee back by the way by which thou camest.
verses.decoded: Because I have heard your anger and uproar, I will put a hook in your nose and a bit in your mouth, and I will make you turn back the way you came.

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee, Ye shall eat this year such as groweth of itself; and the second year that which springeth of the same: and in the third year sow ye, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit thereof.
verses.decoded: Here is a sign for you: this year you will eat what grows naturally; the next year you will eat what grows from that; but in the third year you will plant and harvest crops and vineyards and enjoy their fruit.

verses.kjv: And the remnant that is escaped of the house of Judah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward:
verses.decoded: The survivors from the house of Judah will grow strong roots and produce fruit again.

verses.kjv: For out of Jerusalem shall go forth a remnant, and they that escape out of mount Zion: the zeal of the Lord of hosts shall do this.
verses.decoded: A group of survivors will come out of Jerusalem and Mount Zion; the LORD’s passionate commitment will make this happen.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord concerning the king of Assyria, He shall not come into this city, nor shoot an arrow there, nor come before it with shields, nor cast a bank against it.
verses.decoded: The LORD declares that the king of Assyria will not enter this city, shoot an arrow there, approach with shields, or build a siege ramp against it.

verses.kjv: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and shall not come into this city, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: He will return the same way he came and will not enter the city, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For I will defend this city to save it for mine own sake, and for my servant David’s sake.
verses.decoded: I will protect this city to preserve it for my own honor and because of my servant David.

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the Lord went forth, and smote in the camp of the Assyrians a hundred and fourscore and five thousand: and when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses.
verses.decoded: Then the angel of the LORD went out and struck down 185,000 soldiers in the Assyrian camp; when the army woke up the next morning, they were all dead.

verses.kjv: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed, and went and returned, and dwelt at Nineveh.
verses.decoded: So King Sennacherib of Assyria left, went back, and lived in Nineveh.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as he was worshipping in the house of Nisroch his god, that Adrammelech and Sharezer his sons smote him with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Armenia: and Esar-haddon his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: While he was worshiping in the temple of his god Nisroch, his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer killed him with a sword; they fled to Armenia, and his son Esarhaddon became king.

verses.kjv: In those days was Hezekiah sick unto death. And Isaiah the prophet the son of Amoz came unto him, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Set thine house in order: for thou shalt die, and not live.
verses.decoded: At that time, Hezekiah was very ill and near death. The prophet Isaiah, son of Amoz, came to him and said, 'This is what the LORD says: Put your affairs in order, because you will die and not recover.'

verses.kjv: Then Hezekiah turned his face toward the wall, and prayed unto the Lord,
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah turned toward the wall and prayed to the LORD,

verses.kjv: And said, Remember now, O Lord, I beseech thee, how I have walked before thee in truth and with a perfect heart, and have done that which is good in thy sight. And Hezekiah wept sore.
verses.decoded: and said, 'Remember, LORD, please remember how I have lived faithfully and with a sincere heart, doing what is good in your eyes.' Then Hezekiah wept bitterly.

verses.kjv: Then came the word of the Lord to Isaiah, saying,
verses.decoded: Then the LORD spoke to Isaiah, saying,

verses.kjv: Go, and say to Hezekiah, Thus saith the Lord, the God of David thy father, I have heard thy prayer, I have seen thy tears: behold, I will add unto thy days fifteen years.
verses.decoded: Go and tell Hezekiah, 'This is what the LORD, the God of David your ancestor, says: I have heard your prayer and seen your tears. I will add fifteen years to your life.'

verses.kjv: And I will deliver thee and this city out of the hand of the king of Assyria: and I will defend this city.
verses.decoded: I will rescue you and this city from the king of Assyria’s control, and I will protect this city.

verses.kjv: And this shall be a sign unto thee from the Lord, that the Lord will do this thing that he hath spoken;
verses.decoded: This will be a sign from the LORD to you that He will do what He has promised:

verses.kjv: Behold, I will bring again the shadow of the degrees, which is gone down in the sun dial of Ahaz, ten degrees backward. So the sun returned ten degrees, by which degrees it was gone down.
verses.decoded: I will cause the shadow on the steps of Ahaz’s sundial to move backward ten steps. So the sun’s shadow went back the ten steps it had moved down.

verses.kjv: The writing of Hezekiah king of Judah, when he had been sick, and was recovered of his sickness:
verses.decoded: This is the record of King Hezekiah of Judah when he was sick and then recovered:

verses.kjv: I said in the cutting off of my days, I shall go to the gates of the grave: I am deprived of the residue of my years.
verses.decoded: I thought, 'My life is ending; I will go to the gates of death. I have been cut off from the rest of my years.'

verses.kjv: I said, I shall not see the Lord, even the Lord, in the land of the living: I shall behold man no more with the inhabitants of the world.
verses.decoded: I said, 'I will no longer see the LORD, the LORD, while I live; I will no longer look upon people among the living.'

verses.kjv: Mine age is departed, and is removed from me as a shepherd’s tent: I have cut off like a weaver my life: he will cut me off with pining sickness: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.decoded: My life is gone, taken from me like a shepherd’s tent being folded up. Like a weaver cutting thread, my life is cut off. You will end me with illness, from morning until night.

verses.kjv: I reckoned till morning, that, as a lion, so will he break all my bones: from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
verses.decoded: I thought, 'Until morning, like a lion, he will crush all my bones. From morning until night, you will destroy me.'

verses.kjv: Like a crane or a swallow, so did I chatter: I did mourn as a dove: mine eyes fail with looking upward: O Lord, I am oppressed; undertake for me.
verses.decoded: I made sounds like a crane or swallow; I mourned like a dove. My eyes grow weak as I look up. LORD, I am overwhelmed; please help me.

verses.kjv: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done it: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
verses.decoded: What can I say? He has spoken to me and done it. I will live quietly the rest of my years, carrying the bitterness in my soul.

verses.kjv: O Lord, by these things men live, and in all these things is the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
verses.decoded: Lord, people live by these things, and my spirit lives through all of them. Please heal me and let me live.

verses.kjv: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul delivered it from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
verses.decoded: I experienced deep bitterness instead of peace, but in your love you saved my soul from the grave. You have forgiven all my sins and forgotten them.

verses.kjv: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can not celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
verses.decoded: Those who are dead cannot praise you, and those in the grave have no hope in your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I do this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
verses.decoded: The living will praise you, just as I do today. Fathers will teach their children about your faithfulness.

verses.kjv: The Lord was ready to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The LORD was ready to save me, so we will sing songs of praise with instruments in God's temple all our lives.

verses.kjv: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay it for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.
verses.decoded: Isaiah said to take a lump of figs and apply it to the sore, and he will get better.

verses.kjv: Hezekiah also had said, What is the sign that I shall go up to the house of the Lord?
verses.decoded: Hezekiah asked, 'What will be the sign that I will be able to go up to the LORD’s temple?'

verses.kjv: At that time Merodach-baladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.
verses.decoded: At that time, Merodach-Baladan, son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a gift to Hezekiah because he heard that Hezekiah had been ill but had recovered.

verses.kjv: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.
verses.decoded: Hezekiah was pleased with their visit and showed them all his valuable possessions—the silver, gold, spices, fine perfumes, his weapons, and everything stored in his treasury. There was nothing in his palace or kingdom that he did not show them.

verses.kjv: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, even from Babylon.
verses.decoded: Then the prophet Isaiah came to King Hezekiah and asked, 'What did those men say? Where did they come from?' Hezekiah answered, 'They came to me from a distant land—Babylon.'

verses.kjv: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that is in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.
verses.decoded: Isaiah asked, 'What did they see in your palace?' Hezekiah replied, 'They saw everything in my palace; I showed them all my treasures.'

verses.kjv: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the Lord of hosts:
verses.decoded: Then Isaiah said to Hezekiah, 'Listen to the message from the LORD Almighty:'

verses.kjv: Behold, the days come, that all that is in thine house, and that which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Look, a time will come when everything in your palace and all the treasures your ancestors have stored up will be taken to Babylon. Nothing will be left, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
verses.decoded: They will also take away your descendants—your own sons—and make them eunuchs serving in the palace of the king of Babylon.

verses.kjv: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good is the word of the Lord which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.
verses.decoded: Then Hezekiah said to Isaiah, 'The LORD’s message you have spoken is good.' He added, 'Because there will be peace and security during my lifetime.'

verses.kjv: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
verses.decoded: Speak words of comfort to my people, says your God.

verses.kjv: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord’s hand double for all her sins.
verses.decoded: Speak kindly to Jerusalem and tell her that her time of punishment is over, her sins are forgiven, because she has suffered twice as much as she deserved from the Lord.

verses.kjv: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
verses.decoded: A voice is calling out in the wilderness: Prepare the way for the Lord; make a clear path in the desert for our God.

verses.kjv: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
verses.decoded: Every valley will be raised up, every mountain and hill will be lowered; the uneven places will be made level, and the rough ground will become smooth.

verses.kjv: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: The glory of the Lord will be revealed, and everyone will see it together, because the Lord has promised it.

verses.kjv: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
verses.decoded: A voice said, 'Cry out.' I asked, 'What should I say?' The answer was: 'All people are like grass, and all their beauty is like a flower in the field.'

verses.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
verses.decoded: The grass dries up and the flowers fade because the Lord’s breath blows on them; truly, people are like grass.

verses.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verses.decoded: Grass withers and flowers fade, but God’s word lasts forever.

verses.kjv: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
verses.decoded: You who bring good news to Zion, climb to a high mountain; you who bring good news to Jerusalem, shout loudly and don’t be afraid; tell the cities of Judah, 'Look, your God is coming!'

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.decoded: Look, the Lord God is coming with power, and his strong arm will rule for him; he brings his reward with him and his work goes before him.

verses.kjv: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
verses.decoded: He will care for his people like a shepherd: he will gather the young lambs in his arms, carry them close to his heart, and gently lead the mothers with their young.

verses.kjv: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
verses.decoded: Who has measured the waters in the palm of his hand, marked off the heavens with a span, weighed the dust of the earth in a measuring unit, and balanced the mountains and hills on scales?

verses.kjv: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counseller hath taught him?
verses.decoded: Who has guided the Spirit of the Lord, or acted as his advisor to teach him?

verses.kjv: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
verses.decoded: Who has given God advice, taught him what is right, shown him the way of justice, knowledge, and understanding?

verses.kjv: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verses.decoded: Look, the nations are like a drop of water in a bucket, like tiny dust on a scale; he treats the islands as if they were nothing at all.

verses.kjv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
verses.decoded: Even all the trees of Lebanon are not enough for fuel, and the animals there are not enough for a burnt offering.

verses.kjv: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
verses.decoded: All nations are like nothing compared to Him; they are worthless and meaningless to Him.

verses.kjv: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
verses.decoded: So who can you compare God to? What image can you use to represent Him?

verses.kjv: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
verses.decoded: A craftsman melts a carved idol, a goldsmith covers it with gold, and silver chains are added.

verses.kjv: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
verses.decoded: Someone too poor to offer a sacrifice picks a tree that won’t decay and hires a skilled craftsman to make an idol that won’t fall over.

verses.kjv: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
verses.decoded: Haven’t you known or heard? Hasn’t this been told to you from the start? Haven’t you understood since the world was created?

verses.kjv: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
verses.decoded: He is the one who sits above the earth’s round surface, and its people are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the sky like a curtain and spreads it out like a tent to live in.

verses.kjv: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
verses.decoded: He reduces rulers to nothing and makes judges on earth worthless.

verses.kjv: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
verses.decoded: They will not be planted or sown; their roots won’t grow in the ground. God will blow on them, and they will wither away, swept away like dry grass in the wind.

verses.kjv: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
verses.decoded: So who can you compare me to? Who is equal to me? says the Holy One.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
verses.decoded: Look up to the sky and see who created all these stars, calling each by name because of His great power. He is strong and none of them are missing.

verses.kjv: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
verses.decoded: Why do you say, O Jacob, and speak, O Israel, 'The LORD doesn’t see my path, and my case is ignored by my God'?

verses.kjv: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
verses.decoded: Don’t you know? Haven’t you heard? The eternal God, the LORD, who created the ends of the earth, never grows tired or weary, and His understanding is beyond measure.
