verses.kjv: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
verses.decoded: He gives strength to those who are weak and increases the power of those who have no energy.

verses.kjv: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
verses.decoded: Even young people will become tired and weak, and young men will fall completely.

verses.kjv: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
verses.decoded: But those who trust in the LORD will find their strength renewed; they will soar like eagles, run without getting tired, and walk without becoming weak.

verses.kjv: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew their strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
verses.decoded: Be silent before me, you distant lands; let the people gather their strength. Let them come close and then speak. Let us come together for judgment.

verses.kjv: Who raised up the righteous man from the east, called him to his foot, gave the nations before him, and made him rule over kings? he gave them as the dust to his sword, and as driven stubble to his bow.
verses.decoded: Who brought up a righteous man from the east, called him to follow, gave nations to him, and made him rule over kings? He defeated them like dust before his sword and like chaff driven by his bow.

verses.kjv: He pursued them, and passed safely; even by the way that he had not gone with his feet.
verses.decoded: He chased them and passed safely through places where no one had traveled before.

verses.kjv: Who hath wrought and done it, calling the generations from the beginning? I the Lord, the first, and with the last; I am he.
verses.decoded: Who has done this and called the generations from the start? I am the LORD, the first and the last; I am the one.

verses.kjv: The isles saw it, and feared; the ends of the earth were afraid, drew near, and came.
verses.decoded: The islands saw this and were afraid; the farthest parts of the earth were terrified, came close, and approached.

verses.kjv: They helped every one his neighbour; and every one said to his brother, Be of good courage.
verses.decoded: Each helped their neighbor, and everyone encouraged their brother, saying, 'Be strong!'

verses.kjv: So the carpenter encouraged the goldsmith, and he that smootheth with the hammer him that smote the anvil, saying, It is ready for the sodering: and he fastened it with nails, that it should not be moved.
verses.decoded: The carpenter encouraged the metalworker, and the one using the hammer encouraged the one striking the anvil, saying, 'It is ready for soldering.' They fastened it with nails so it would not move.

verses.kjv: But thou, Israel, art my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the seed of Abraham my friend.
verses.decoded: But you, Israel, are my servant, Jacob whom I have chosen, the descendant of Abraham, my close friend.

verses.kjv: Thou whom I have taken from the ends of the earth, and called thee from the chief men thereof, and said unto thee, Thou art my servant; I have chosen thee, and not cast thee away.
verses.decoded: I have brought you from the ends of the earth and called you from its important leaders. I said to you, 'You are my servant; I have chosen you and will not reject you.'

verses.kjv: Fear thou not; for I am with thee: be not dismayed; for I am thy God: I will strengthen thee; yea, I will help thee; yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of my righteousness.
verses.decoded: Do not be afraid, for I am with you. Do not be discouraged, for I am your God. I will strengthen you, help you, and hold you up with my righteous right hand.

verses.kjv: Behold, all they that were incensed against thee shall be ashamed and confounded: they shall be as nothing; and they that strive with thee shall perish.
verses.decoded: Look, all who were angry with you will be ashamed and confused; they will be like nothing, and those who oppose you will disappear.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt seek them, and shalt not find them, even them that contended with thee: they that war against thee shall be as nothing, and as a thing of nought.
verses.decoded: You will look for those who opposed you but will not find them; those who fought against you will be gone, like something that never existed.

verses.kjv: For I the Lord thy God will hold thy right hand, saying unto thee, Fear not; I will help thee.
verses.decoded: For I, the LORD your God, will hold your right hand and say to you, 'Do not be afraid; I will help you.'

verses.kjv: Fear not, thou worm Jacob, and ye men of Israel; I will help thee, saith the Lord, and thy redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Do not be afraid, Jacob, you who feel weak, and all you people of Israel; I will help you, says the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will make thee a new sharp threshing instrument having teeth: thou shalt thresh the mountains, and beat them small, and shalt make the hills as chaff.
verses.decoded: Look, I will make you a new, sharp threshing tool with teeth; you will crush mountains and grind hills into chaff.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fan them, and the wind shall carry them away, and the whirlwind shall scatter them: and thou shalt rejoice in the Lord, and shalt glory in the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: You will blow them away like chaff, and the wind will carry them off; a whirlwind will scatter them. But you will rejoice in the LORD and take pride in the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: When the poor and needy seek water, and there is none, and their tongue faileth for thirst, I the Lord will hear them, I the God of Israel will not forsake them.
verses.decoded: When the poor and needy search for water but find none, and their tongues are parched with thirst, I the LORD will hear them; I, the God of Israel, will never abandon them.

verses.kjv: I will open rivers in high places, and fountains in the midst of the valleys: I will make the wilderness a pool of water, and the dry land springs of water.
verses.decoded: I will create rivers on the mountains and springs in the valleys. I will turn the desert into pools of water and the dry land into flowing springs.

verses.kjv: I will plant in the wilderness the cedar, the shittah tree, and the myrtle, and the oil tree; I will set in the desert the fir tree, and the pine, and the box tree together:
verses.decoded: I will plant cedars, acacias, myrtles, and olive trees in the wilderness; I will place firs, pines, and cypress trees together in the desert.

verses.kjv: That they may see, and know, and consider, and understand together, that the hand of the Lord hath done this, and the Holy One of Israel hath created it.
verses.decoded: So that people may see, recognize, think about, and understand that the LORD’s hand has done this and that the Holy One of Israel created it.

verses.kjv: Produce your cause, saith the Lord; bring forth your strong reasons, saith the King of Jacob.
verses.decoded: Present your case, says the LORD; bring your strongest arguments, says the King of Israel.

verses.kjv: Let them bring them forth, and shew us what shall happen: let them shew the former things, what they be, that we may consider them, and know the latter end of them; or declare us things for to come.
verses.decoded: Let them come forward and tell us what will happen; let them reveal the past so we can think it over and understand the outcome, or announce what is yet to come.

verses.kjv: Shew the things that are to come hereafter, that we may know that ye are gods: yea, do good, or do evil, that we may be dismayed, and behold it together.
verses.decoded: Show us what will happen in the future so we can know you are gods. Do something good or bad so we may be amazed and watch it happen.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye are of nothing, and your work of nought: an abomination is he that chooseth you.
verses.decoded: Look, you are nothing, and your work is worthless; anyone who chooses you is detestable.

verses.kjv: I have raised up one from the north, and he shall come: from the rising of the sun shall he call upon my name: and he shall come upon princes as upon morter, and as the potter treadeth clay.
verses.decoded: I have raised up someone from the north, and he will come; from the east he will call on my name. He will crush rulers like mortar and shape them like clay in a potter’s hands.

verses.kjv: Who hath declared from the beginning, that we may know? and beforetime, that we may say, He is righteous? yea, there is none that sheweth, yea, there is none that declareth, yea, there is none that heareth your words.
verses.decoded: Who has announced things from the start so we could know? Who predicted them beforehand so we could say they are right? No one has revealed or declared your words, and no one listens to you.

verses.kjv: The first shall say to Zion, Behold, behold them: and I will give to Jerusalem one that bringeth good tidings.
verses.decoded: The first will say to Zion, 'Look, look at them!' I will send someone to Jerusalem who brings good news.

verses.kjv: For I beheld, and there was no man; even among them, and there was no counseller, that, when I asked of them, could answer a word.
verses.decoded: I looked and there was no one—no one among them, no counselor—who could answer when I asked.

verses.kjv: Behold, they are all vanity; their works are nothing: their molten images are wind and confusion.
verses.decoded: Look, they are all worthless; their actions mean nothing. Their idols made of metal are just empty wind and confusion.

verses.kjv: Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: Look at my chosen servant, the one I support and delight in; I have given him my Spirit. He will bring justice to the nations.

verses.kjv: He shall not cry, nor lift up, nor cause his voice to be heard in the street.
verses.decoded: He will not shout or raise his voice in public.

verses.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and the smoking flax shall he not quench: he shall bring forth judgment unto truth.
verses.decoded: He will not crush a weak reed or put out a faintly burning wick; instead, he will bring true justice.

verses.kjv: He shall not fail nor be discouraged, till he have set judgment in the earth: and the isles shall wait for his law.
verses.decoded: He will not give up or be discouraged until he establishes justice throughout the earth, and distant lands will eagerly await his teaching.

verses.kjv: Thus saith God the Lord, he that created the heavens, and stretched them out; he that spread forth the earth, and that which cometh out of it; he that giveth breath unto the people upon it, and spirit to them that walk therein:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says—the God who created the heavens and stretched them out, who spread out the earth and everything in it, who gives breath and life to all people living on it:

verses.kjv: I the Lord have called thee in righteousness, and will hold thine hand, and will keep thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, for a light of the Gentiles;
verses.decoded: I, the LORD, have called you in righteousness. I will hold your hand, protect you, and make you a covenant for the people—a light to the nations.

verses.kjv: To open the blind eyes, to bring out the prisoners from the prison, and them that sit in darkness out of the prison house.
verses.decoded: To open the eyes of the blind, to free prisoners from jail, and to bring those who live in darkness out of their confinement.

verses.kjv: I am the Lord: that is my name: and my glory will I not give to another, neither my praise to graven images.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD—that is my name—and I will not share my glory with anyone else or give my praise to idols.

verses.kjv: Behold, the former things are come to pass, and new things do I declare: before they spring forth I tell you of them.
verses.decoded: Look, the things I predicted before have happened, and now I announce new things before they happen.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise from the end of the earth, ye that go down to the sea, and all that is therein; the isles, and the inhabitants thereof.
verses.decoded: Sing a new song to the LORD and praise him from the farthest parts of the earth—those who live by the sea and everything in it, including the islands and their people.

verses.kjv: Let the wilderness and the cities thereof lift up their voice, the villages that Kedar doth inhabit: let the inhabitants of the rock sing, let them shout from the top of the mountains.
verses.decoded: Let the wilderness and its towns raise their voices; let the villages where Kedar lives shout; let those who live in rocky places sing and shout from the mountaintops.

verses.kjv: Let them give glory unto the Lord, and declare his praise in the islands.
verses.decoded: Let them honor the LORD and proclaim his praise on the islands.

verses.kjv: The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.
verses.decoded: The LORD will come out like a strong warrior; he will stir up passion like a soldier in battle. He will shout and roar and will triumph over his enemies.

verses.kjv: I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself: now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.
verses.decoded: For a long time I have kept silent and held back, but now I will cry out like a woman in labor; I will destroy and consume quickly.

verses.kjv: I will make waste mountains and hills, and dry up all their herbs; and I will make the rivers islands, and I will dry up the pools.
verses.decoded: I will ruin mountains and hills, dry up all plants, turn rivers into islands, and dry up pools of water.

verses.kjv: And I will bring the blind by a way that they knew not; I will lead them in paths that they have not known: I will make darkness light before them, and crooked things straight. These things will I do unto them, and not forsake them.
verses.decoded: I will guide those who cannot see along paths they have never known. I will lead them on unfamiliar roads. I will turn darkness into light for them and make rough places smooth. I will do this for them and will not abandon them.

verses.kjv: They shall be turned back, they shall be greatly ashamed, that trust in graven images, that say to the molten images, Ye are our gods.
verses.decoded: Those who trust in carved idols and say to molten images, 'You are our gods,' will be turned away and deeply ashamed.

verses.kjv: Hear, ye deaf; and look, ye blind, that ye may see.
verses.decoded: Listen, you who cannot hear; look, you who cannot see, so that you may understand.

verses.kjv: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I sent? who is blind as he that is perfect, and blind as the Lord’s servant?
verses.decoded: Who is blind except my servant? Who is deaf like the messenger I send? Who is as blind as the one who is perfect, as blind as the Lord’s servant?

verses.kjv: Seeing many things, but thou observest not; opening the ears, but he heareth not.
verses.decoded: They see many things but do not pay attention; their ears are open but they do not listen.

verses.kjv: The Lord is well pleased for his righteousness’ sake; he will magnify the law, and make it honourable.
verses.decoded: The Lord is pleased because of his righteousness; he will make the law great and honorable.

verses.kjv: But this is a people robbed and spoiled; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.
verses.decoded: But this people has been robbed and plundered; they are trapped in pits and locked in prisons. They are victims with no one to rescue them, taken as spoil with no one to say, 'Give it back.'

verses.kjv: Who among you will give ear to this? who will hearken and hear for the time to come?
verses.decoded: Who among you will listen to this? Who will pay attention and understand what will happen in the future?

verses.kjv: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not the Lord, he against whom we have sinned? for they would not walk in his ways, neither were they obedient unto his law.
verses.decoded: Who allowed Jacob to be taken as plunder and Israel to be robbed? Was it not the Lord, the one we have sinned against? They refused to follow his ways and obey his law.

verses.kjv: Therefore he hath poured upon him the fury of his anger, and the strength of battle: and it hath set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.
verses.decoded: Because of this, God has unleashed his fierce anger and power in battle against them. It surrounds them like fire, but they do not realize it; it burns them, yet they do not take it seriously.

verses.kjv: But now thus saith the Lord that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel, Fear not: for I have redeemed thee, I have called thee by thy name; thou art mine.
verses.decoded: But now, this is what the LORD who created you, Jacob, and formed you, Israel, says: Do not be afraid, for I have saved you. I have called you by your name; you belong to me.

verses.kjv: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned; neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.
verses.decoded: When you go through deep waters, I will be with you; when you cross rivers, they will not overwhelm you. When you walk through fire, you will not be burned, and the flames will not harm you.

verses.kjv: For I am the Lord thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour: I gave Egypt for thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba for thee.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, your Savior. I gave Egypt, Ethiopia, and Seba as a ransom to save you.

verses.kjv: Since thou wast precious in my sight, thou hast been honourable, and I have loved thee: therefore will I give men for thee, and people for thy life.
verses.decoded: You are precious to me and honored, and I love you. So I will give people to protect you and nations to save your life.

verses.kjv: Fear not: for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;
verses.decoded: Do not be afraid, for I am with you. I will bring your descendants from the east and gather you from the west.

verses.kjv: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back: bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the ends of the earth;
verses.decoded: I will command the north to release them and say to the south, ‘Do not hold them back.’ Bring my sons from distant lands and my daughters from the farthest places on earth.

verses.kjv: Even every one that is called by my name: for I have created him for my glory, I have formed him; yea, I have made him.
verses.decoded: Everyone who is called by my name, for I created them for my glory. I formed them and made them.

verses.kjv: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.
verses.decoded: Bring out the blind who have eyes and the deaf who have ears.

verses.kjv: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the people be assembled: who among them can declare this, and shew us former things? let them bring forth their witnesses, that they may be justified: or let them hear, and say, It is truth.
verses.decoded: Let all the nations gather and the peoples assemble. Who among them can predict this or show us what happened before? Let them present their witnesses to prove they are right, or let them listen and admit, ‘This is true.’

verses.kjv: Ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, and my servant whom I have chosen: that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.
verses.decoded: You are my witnesses, says the LORD, my chosen servant, so that you may know and believe me and understand that I am God. Before me no god was formed, and there will be none after me.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am the Lord; and beside me there is no saviour.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD, and there is no savior besides me.

verses.kjv: I have declared, and have saved, and I have shewed, when there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith the Lord, that I am God.
verses.decoded: I have told you, saved you, and shown you, even when no foreign god was among you. So you are my witnesses, says the LORD, that I am God.

verses.kjv: Yea, before the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who shall let it?
verses.decoded: Yes, I am God, even before the beginning of time. No one can rescue anyone from my power. I do what I please, and who can stop me?

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, your redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and have brought down all their nobles, and the Chaldeans, whose cry is in the ships.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel, says: For your sake, I sent a message to Babylon and brought down all their leaders and the Chaldeans, whose shouting is heard on the ships.

verses.kjv: I am the Lord, your Holy One, the creator of Israel, your King.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, which maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says—he who made a way through the sea and a path through the powerful waters;

verses.kjv: Which bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the power; they shall lie down together, they shall not rise: they are extinct, they are quenched as tow.
verses.decoded: who brought out the chariot and horse, the army and its strength; they will lie down together and not get up—they are extinguished, completely burned like dry flax.

verses.kjv: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.
verses.decoded: Don’t remember the past events or think about what happened long ago.

verses.kjv: Behold, I will do a new thing; now it shall spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
verses.decoded: Look, I am doing something new; it is already starting—don’t you recognize it? I will make a path through the wilderness and rivers flow in the desert.

verses.kjv: The beast of the field shall honour me, the dragons and the owls: because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen.
verses.decoded: Wild animals will honor me—jackals and ostriches too—because I provide water in the wilderness and rivers in the desert to refresh my chosen people.

verses.kjv: This people have I formed for myself; they shall shew forth my praise.
verses.decoded: I have created this people for myself, and they will proclaim my praise.

verses.kjv: But thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.
verses.decoded: But you have not called on me, Jacob; you have grown tired of me, Israel.

verses.kjv: Thou hast not brought me the small cattle of thy burnt offerings; neither hast thou honoured me with thy sacrifices. I have not caused thee to serve with an offering, nor wearied thee with incense.
verses.decoded: You have not offered me your lambs as burnt offerings, nor honored me with your sacrifices. I have not burdened you with offerings or wearied you with incense.

verses.kjv: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices: but thou hast made me to serve with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.
verses.decoded: You have not brought me fragrant incense or satisfied me with the fat from your sacrifices; instead, you have burdened me with your sins and wearied me with your wrongdoing.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.
verses.decoded: I—yes, I—am the one who wipes away your sins for my own sake and will not remember your wrongdoings.

verses.kjv: Put me in remembrance: let us plead together: declare thou, that thou mayest be justified.
verses.decoded: Remind me—let’s argue this out together. Present your case so you can be declared innocent.

verses.kjv: Thy first father hath sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.
verses.decoded: Your ancestors sinned, and your leaders rebelled against me.

verses.kjv: Therefore I have profaned the princes of the sanctuary, and have given Jacob to the curse, and Israel to reproaches.
verses.decoded: Because of this, I have defiled the leaders of the sanctuary and handed Jacob over to curses and Israel to disgrace.

verses.kjv: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant; and Israel, whom I have chosen:
verses.decoded: Listen now, Jacob my servant, Israel whom I have chosen.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, which will help thee; Fear not, O Jacob, my servant; and thou, Jesurun, whom I have chosen.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, who made you and formed you from the womb and will help you: Do not be afraid, Jacob my servant, Jeshurun whom I have chosen.

verses.kjv: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
verses.decoded: I will give water to the thirsty and flood the dry land. I will pour out my Spirit on your descendants and my blessing on your children.

verses.kjv: And they shall spring up as among the grass, as willows by the water courses.
verses.decoded: They will grow strong and flourish like grass and willows beside streams of water.

verses.kjv: One shall say, I am the Lord’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto the Lord, and surname himself by the name of Israel.
verses.decoded: Some will say, 'I belong to the LORD,' others will call themselves by the name Jacob, and others will write their names as followers of the LORD and identify themselves as Israelites.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord the King of Israel, and his redeemer the Lord of hosts; I am the first, and I am the last; and beside me there is no God.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel and his Redeemer, the LORD Almighty, says: I am the first and I am the last; apart from me there is no God.

verses.kjv: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I appointed the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and shall come, let them shew unto them.
verses.decoded: Who else can announce what will happen and make it clear, since I declared the ancient people and predicted the future events?

verses.kjv: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have not I told thee from that time, and have declared it? ye are even my witnesses. Is there a God beside me? yea, there is no God; I know not any.
verses.decoded: Do not be afraid or terrified. Haven’t I told you before and declared it? You are my witnesses. Is there any God besides me? No, there isn’t; I do not know any.

verses.kjv: They that make a graven image are all of them vanity; and their delectable things shall not profit; and they are their own witnesses; they see not, nor know; that they may be ashamed.
verses.decoded: Those who make idols are all worthless; their favorite things are useless. They are their own witnesses because they neither see nor understand, and so they will be ashamed.

verses.kjv: Who hath formed a god, or molten a graven image that is profitable for nothing?
verses.decoded: Who has made a god or cast an idol that is good for nothing?

verses.kjv: Behold, all his fellows shall be ashamed: and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; yet they shall fear, and they shall be ashamed together.
verses.decoded: Look, all the idols will be ashamed, and the craftsmen who made them—who are just humans—will be gathered together. They will be afraid and ashamed.

verses.kjv: The smith with the tongs both worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with the strength of his arms: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth: he drinketh no water, and is faint.
verses.decoded: The blacksmith works with tongs in the fire, shaping the metal with hammers using all his strength. He becomes hungry and weak, drinks no water, and grows faint.

verses.kjv: The carpenter stretcheth out his rule; he marketh it out with a line; he fitteth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compass, and maketh it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man; that it may remain in the house.
verses.decoded: The carpenter measures with a ruler and marks it with a line. He shapes it with planes and marks it with a compass, making it in the form of a man, designed to look like a beautiful human figure to keep in the house.

verses.kjv: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the cypress and the oak, which he strengtheneth for himself among the trees of the forest: he planteth an ash, and the rain doth nourish it.
verses.decoded: He cuts down cedars, takes cypress and oak trees, which give him confidence among the forest trees. He plants an ash tree, which is nourished by the rain.

verses.kjv: Then shall it be for a man to burn: for he will take thereof, and warm himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread; yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.
verses.decoded: Then the man uses some of the wood to burn for warmth, lights a fire, and bakes bread. But he also makes a god from the same wood, worships it, and falls down to it.

verses.kjv: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied: yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire:
verses.decoded: He burns part of the wood in the fire; with some of it he cooks meat and eats it. He roasts his food and feels satisfied. He even warms himself and says, 'Ah, I am warm; I have seen the fire.'

verses.kjv: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image: he falleth down unto it, and worshippeth it, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.
verses.decoded: But from the remaining wood, he makes an idol, a carved image. He bows down to it, worships it, prays to it, and says, 'Save me, because you are my god.'

verses.kjv: They have not known nor understood: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.
verses.decoded: They do not know or understand because God has blinded their eyes so they cannot see, and their hearts so they cannot understand.

verses.kjv: And none considereth in his heart, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh, and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?
verses.decoded: No one thinks carefully or has the knowledge to say, 'I burned part of the wood in the fire; I also baked bread on the coals and roasted meat and ate it. Should I then make the rest of it an object of worship? Should I bow down to a piece of wood?'

verses.kjv: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
verses.decoded: He feeds on ashes; his heart has been led astray and deceived so he cannot save himself or even say, 'Isn't there a lie in my right hand?'

verses.kjv: Remember these, O Jacob and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.
verses.decoded: Remember this, Jacob and Israel, because you are my servant. I created you; you belong to me. Israel, you will not be forgotten by me.

verses.kjv: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.
verses.decoded: I have wiped away your sins like a thick cloud disappears; I have forgiven your wrongdoings. Come back to me, for I have saved you.

verses.kjv: Sing, O ye heavens; for the Lord hath done it: shout, ye lower parts of the earth: break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for the Lord hath redeemed Jacob, and glorified himself in Israel.
verses.decoded: Sing, heavens, because the LORD has done this! Shout, earth below! Mountains, forests, and every tree, burst into song! The LORD has saved Jacob and shown his glory through Israel.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, thy redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb, I am the Lord that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth by myself;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, your redeemer, the one who formed you in your mother's womb: I am the LORD who made everything, who alone stretched out the heavens and spread out the earth by myself.

verses.kjv: That frustrateth the tokens of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;
verses.decoded: I frustrate the signs of false prophets, confuse fortune-tellers, turn wise men backward, and make their knowledge foolish.

verses.kjv: That confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be inhabited; and to the cities of Judah, Ye shall be built, and I will raise up the decayed places thereof:
verses.decoded: I confirm the words of my servants and carry out the plans of my messengers. I say to Jerusalem, 'You will be lived in,' and to the cities of Judah, 'You will be rebuilt.' I will restore their ruined places.

verses.kjv: That saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers:
verses.decoded: I say to the deep waters, 'Be dry!' and I will dry up your rivers.

verses.kjv: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure: even saying to Jerusalem, Thou shalt be built; and to the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.
verses.decoded: I say about Cyrus, 'He is my shepherd who will carry out all my plans.' I tell Jerusalem, 'You will be rebuilt,' and to the temple, 'Your foundation will be laid.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him; and I will loose the loins of kings, to open before him the two leaved gates; and the gates shall not be shut;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says to his chosen one, Cyrus, whose right hand I have supported to conquer nations ahead of him. I will weaken the strength of kings and open the double gates for him; these gates will never be closed.

verses.kjv: I will go before thee, and make the crooked places straight: I will break in pieces the gates of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron:
verses.decoded: I will go ahead of you and make difficult paths smooth. I will smash bronze gates and cut through iron bars.

verses.kjv: And I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that I, the Lord, which call thee by thy name, am the God of Israel.
verses.decoded: I will give you hidden treasures and secret riches so you will know that I, the LORD, who called you by name, am the God of Israel.

verses.kjv: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel mine elect, I have even called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.
verses.decoded: I have called you by name for the sake of my servant Jacob and my chosen Israel. I have given you a title even though you do not know me.

verses.kjv: I am the Lord, and there is none else, there is no God beside me: I girded thee, though thou hast not known me:
verses.decoded: I am the LORD, and there is no other; no God exists besides me. I have equipped you, even though you did not recognize me.

verses.kjv: That they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none beside me. I am the Lord, and there is none else.
verses.decoded: So that people everywhere—from east to west—will know that there is no one besides me. I am the LORD, and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I form the light, and create darkness: I make peace, and create evil: I the Lord do all these things.
verses.decoded: I create light and darkness; I bring peace and create disaster. I, the LORD, do all these things.

verses.kjv: Drop down, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, and let them bring forth salvation, and let righteousness spring up together; I the Lord have created it.
verses.decoded: Heavens, pour down from above; skies, let righteousness rain down. Let the earth open and bring forth salvation, and let righteousness grow together. I, the LORD, have made this happen.

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! Let the potsherd strive with the potsherds of the earth. Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?
verses.decoded: How terrible for anyone who argues with their Creator! Can a piece of pottery argue with the potter? Can clay say to the one who shapes it, 'What are you making?' or 'You have no hands'?

verses.kjv: Woe unto him that saith unto his father, What begettest thou? or to the woman, What hast thou brought forth?
verses.decoded: How terrible for anyone who questions their parents by saying, 'What did you bring me into the world for?'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker, Ask me of things to come concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands command ye me.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, the Holy One of Israel and its Creator, says: Ask me about the future concerning my people, and give me commands about the work of my hands.

verses.kjv: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens, and all their host have I commanded.
verses.decoded: I made the earth and created humanity on it. It was I—my own hands—that stretched out the heavens and commanded all their stars.

verses.kjv: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will direct all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let go my captives, not for price nor reward, saith the Lord of hosts.
verses.decoded: I have chosen him to do what is right, and I will guide his every step. He will rebuild my city and free my captives without asking for payment or reward, says the LORD Almighty.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, The labour of Egypt, and merchandise of Ethiopia and of the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall come after thee; in chains they shall come over, and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: The wealth of Egypt, Ethiopia, and the tall Sabean people will come to you. They will come in chains, bow down to you, and plead, 'Surely God is with you; there is no other God.'

verses.kjv: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.
verses.decoded: Truly, you are a God who hides yourself, O God of Israel, the Savior.

verses.kjv: They shall be ashamed, and also confounded, all of them: they shall go to confusion together that are makers of idols.
verses.decoded: All those who make idols will be ashamed and confused; they will be completely disgraced together.

verses.kjv: But Israel shall be saved in the Lord with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be ashamed nor confounded world without end.
verses.decoded: But Israel will be saved by the LORD with a salvation that lasts forever; they will never be put to shame or confused.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord that created the heavens; God himself that formed the earth and made it; he hath established it, he created it not in vain, he formed it to be inhabited: I am the Lord; and there is none else.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says—the Creator of the heavens and the earth, who made it to be lived in and not empty: I am the LORD, and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I have not spoken in secret, in a dark place of the earth: I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I the Lord speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.
verses.decoded: I have not spoken secretly or in darkness; I did not tell Jacob’s descendants to look for me in vain. I, the LORD, speak what is right and declare truth.

verses.kjv: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that set up the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.
verses.decoded: Come together and gather, you who have escaped from the nations. Those who make idols from wood and pray to gods that cannot save have no understanding.

verses.kjv: Tell ye, and bring them near; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath declared this from ancient time? who hath told it from that time? have not I the Lord? and there is no God else beside me; a just God and a Saviour; there is none beside me.
verses.decoded: Announce this and bring people close; let them discuss it together: who foretold this long ago? Who declared it from ancient times? Was it not I, the LORD? There is no other God besides me—a just God and Savior; there is none like me.

verses.kjv: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth: for I am God, and there is none else.
verses.decoded: Turn to me and be saved, all you people everywhere, because I am God and there is no other.

verses.kjv: I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.
verses.decoded: I have sworn by myself, and my word, spoken in truth, will not be broken: every knee will bow to me, and every tongue will swear allegiance.

verses.kjv: Surely, shall one say, in the Lord have I righteousness and strength: even to him shall men come; and all that are incensed against him shall be ashamed.
verses.decoded: Someone will say, 'In the LORD I have righteousness and strength.' People will come to him, and those who oppose him will be ashamed.

verses.kjv: In the Lord shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.
verses.decoded: All Israel’s descendants will be made right with the LORD and will take pride in Him.

verses.kjv: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.decoded: Bel bows down, Nebo stoops; their idols are placed on animals and cattle. Your carts are heavily loaded and are a burden to the tired animals.

verses.kjv: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.decoded: They all stoop and bow down together; they cannot carry their load and have themselves been taken captive.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.decoded: Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the survivors of Israel, whom I have carried from birth and from the womb.

verses.kjv: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.decoded: Even into your old age, I am the same; I will carry you even when your hair turns gray. I made you, I will support you, I will carry you and save you.

verses.kjv: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.decoded: Who can you compare me to or make equal to me, so that we might be alike?

verses.kjv: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.decoded: They spend gold from their bags and weigh silver on scales, hire a goldsmith who makes an idol, and then they bow down and worship it.

verses.kjv: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.decoded: They carry the idol on their shoulders, place it in its spot, and it stands there, unable to move. Someone calls to it, but it cannot answer or save them from trouble.

verses.kjv: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.decoded: Remember this and act wisely; think it over again, you who have sinned.

verses.kjv: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.decoded: Remember the things from long ago, for I am God and there is no other; I am God and there is none like me.

verses.kjv: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.decoded: I announce the outcome from the start, from ancient times what is still to come, saying, My plan will succeed and I will do everything I desire.

verses.kjv: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.decoded: I summon a fierce bird from the east, a man who carries out my plan from a distant land. I have spoken, and I will make it happen; I have planned it, and I will do it.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.decoded: Listen to me, you who are stubborn and far from what is right.

verses.kjv: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.decoded: I am bringing my righteousness close; it will not be distant, and my salvation will not delay. I will put salvation in Zion, for Israel is my glory.

verses.kjv: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.
verses.decoded: Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground. There is no throne for you, daughter of the Chaldeans, because you will no longer be called delicate or pampered.

verses.kjv: Take the millstones, and grind meal: uncover thy locks, make bare the leg, uncover the thigh, pass over the rivers.
verses.decoded: Take the millstones and grind grain; loosen your hair, bare your legs, cross the rivers.

verses.kjv: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and I will not meet thee as a man.
verses.decoded: Your nakedness will be exposed, your shame revealed. I will take revenge and will not show you mercy.

verses.kjv: As for our redeemer, the Lord of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Our Redeemer is the LORD of hosts; his name is the Holy One of Israel.

verses.kjv: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called, The lady of kingdoms.
verses.decoded: Be silent and go into darkness, daughter of the Chaldeans, because you will no longer be called the queen of kingdoms.

verses.kjv: I was wroth with my people, I have polluted mine inheritance, and given them into thine hand: thou didst shew them no mercy; upon the ancient hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.
verses.decoded: I was angry with my people and allowed you to rule over them. You showed them no mercy and harshly oppressed the old and vulnerable.

verses.kjv: And thou saidst, I shall be a lady for ever: so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end of it.
verses.decoded: You said, 'I will be queen forever,' and did not consider or remember what would happen in the end.

verses.kjv: Therefore hear now this, thou that art given to pleasures, that dwellest carelessly, that sayest in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:
verses.decoded: So listen now, you who live for pleasure and are careless, who say in your heart, 'I am the only one; I will never be a widow or lose children.'

verses.kjv: But these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood: they shall come upon thee in their perfection for the multitude of thy sorceries, and for the great abundance of thine enchantments.
verses.decoded: But suddenly, in a single day, you will lose your children and become a widow. This will happen because of your many sorceries and great number of spells.

verses.kjv: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness: thou hast said, None seeth me. Thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee; and thou hast said in thine heart, I am, and none else beside me.
verses.decoded: You trusted in your evil deeds and said, 'No one sees me.' Your wisdom and knowledge have led you astray, and you said in your heart, 'I am the only one.'

verses.kjv: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know from whence it riseth: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it off: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou shalt not know.
verses.decoded: Therefore, disaster will come upon you suddenly; you won’t know where it came from. Trouble will fall on you that you cannot escape, and destruction will come quickly without warning.

verses.kjv: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast laboured from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.
verses.decoded: Now use your magic and many spells that you have worked on since you were young; maybe they will help you or save you.

verses.kjv: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels. Let now the astrologers, the stargazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from these things that shall come upon thee.
verses.decoded: You are tired from all your plans. Let your astrologers, stargazers, and monthly fortune-tellers stand up and save you from what is coming.

verses.kjv: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: there shall not be a coal to warm at, nor fire to sit before it.
verses.decoded: But they will be like dry straw; fire will burn them up, and they won’t be able to save themselves from the flames. There will be no coal to warm by or fire to sit near.

verses.kjv: Thus shall they be unto thee with whom thou hast laboured, even thy merchants, from thy youth: they shall wander every one to his quarter; none shall save thee.
verses.decoded: This is how it will be with those you worked with, even your merchants from your youth; each will go their own way, and no one will save you.

verses.kjv: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, which are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah, which swear by the name of the Lord, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness.
verses.decoded: Listen to this, people of Jacob, called Israel, who came from Judah, who swear by the LORD's name and mention the God of Israel, but do not live honestly or righteously.

verses.kjv: For they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.decoded: They claim to be from the holy city and trust in the God of Israel; the LORD Almighty is His name.

verses.kjv: I have declared the former things from the beginning; and they went forth out of my mouth, and I shewed them; I did them suddenly, and they came to pass.
verses.decoded: I announced things before they happened; I spoke them, and they came true suddenly.

verses.kjv: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;
verses.decoded: Because I knew you were stubborn, with a neck like iron and a forehead like bronze.

verses.kjv: I have even from the beginning declared it to thee; before it came to pass I shewed it thee: lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.
verses.decoded: From the start, I told you what would happen, so you can’t say your idols made it happen or your carved or molten images commanded it.

verses.kjv: Thou hast heard, see all this; and will not ye declare it? I have shewed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, and thou didst not know them.
verses.decoded: You have heard and seen all this; won’t you tell others? I have revealed new and hidden things you didn’t know before.

verses.kjv: They are created now, and not from the beginning; even before the day when thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.
verses.decoded: These things are happening now, not from long ago; before you heard them, so you can’t say, ‘I already knew this.’

verses.kjv: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from that time that thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou wouldest deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.
verses.decoded: You did not hear or understand because your ears were closed; I knew you would be very unfaithful and sinful from birth.

verses.kjv: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.
verses.decoded: For the sake of my name and glory, I will hold back my anger and not destroy you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have refined thee, but not with silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.
verses.decoded: I have purified you, not like silver, but by putting you through difficult trials.

verses.kjv: For mine own sake, even for mine own sake, will I do it: for how should my name be polluted? and I will not give my glory unto another.
verses.decoded: I will act for my own sake, to protect my name from being dishonored; I will not share my glory with anyone else.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, O Jacob and Israel, my called; I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, Jacob and Israel, my chosen ones; I am the one; I am the first and the last.

verses.kjv: Mine hand also hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spanned the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.
verses.decoded: My hand laid the earth’s foundation, and my right hand stretched out the heavens; when I call, they come into being.

verses.kjv: All ye, assemble yourselves, and hear; which among them hath declared these things? The Lord hath loved him: he will do his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.
verses.decoded: Everyone, come together and listen; who else has announced these things? The LORD loves him and will carry out His plan against Babylon and the Chaldeans.

verses.kjv: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him: I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.
verses.decoded: I myself have spoken and called him; I have brought him here, and he will succeed in his mission.

verses.kjv: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; I have not spoken in secret from the beginning; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord God, and his Spirit, hath sent me.
verses.decoded: Come close and listen to me; I have not kept my message hidden since the beginning. From the very start, I have existed. Now, the Lord God and His Spirit have sent me.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel; I am the Lord thy God which teacheth thee to profit, which leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am the LORD your God who teaches you what is best and guides you on the right path.

verses.kjv: O that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:
verses.decoded: If only you had listened to my commands! Then your peace would have flowed like a river, and your righteousness would have been as constant as the waves of the sea.

verses.kjv: Thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the gravel thereof; his name should not have been cut off nor destroyed from before me.
verses.decoded: Your descendants would have been as numerous as the sand, and your children as countless as the gravel; their names would never have been wiped out or forgotten by me.

verses.kjv: Go ye forth of Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans, with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth; say ye, The Lord hath redeemed his servant Jacob.
verses.decoded: Leave Babylon and escape from the Chaldeans. With joyful voices, announce this message everywhere, even to the ends of the earth: The LORD has redeemed His servant Jacob.

verses.kjv: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts: he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them: he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.
verses.decoded: They did not thirst when He led them through the desert; He made water flow from the rock for them. He split the rock, and water poured out.

verses.kjv: There is no peace, saith the Lord, unto the wicked.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, there is no peace for those who do evil.

verses.kjv: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye people, from far; The Lord hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name.
verses.decoded: Listen, distant islands, and pay attention, faraway peoples. The LORD called me before I was born; He mentioned my name while I was still in my mother's womb.

verses.kjv: And he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me, and made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he hid me;
verses.decoded: God has made my words powerful like a sharp sword. He protected me closely, like a polished arrow kept safe in His quiver.

verses.kjv: And said unto me, Thou art my servant, O Israel, in whom I will be glorified.
verses.decoded: God said to me, 'You are my servant, Israel, through whom I will show my glory.'

verses.kjv: Then I said, I have laboured in vain, I have spent my strength for nought, and in vain: yet surely my judgment is with the Lord, and my work with my God.
verses.decoded: I said, 'I have worked hard for nothing; I have wasted my strength in vain.' But still, I trust that my cause is with the LORD and my reward is with my God.

verses.kjv: And now, saith the Lord that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, Though Israel be not gathered, yet shall I be glorious in the eyes of the Lord, and my God shall be my strength.
verses.decoded: Now the LORD who made me from birth says, 'I am my servant to bring Jacob back to me. Even if Israel is not gathered, I will still be honored by the LORD, and my God will give me strength.'

verses.kjv: And he said, It is a light thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.
verses.decoded: God said, 'It is not enough for you to be my servant to restore the tribes of Jacob and bring back the survivors of Israel. I will also make you a light to the nations, so you can bring my salvation to the ends of the earth.'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers, Kings shall see and arise, princes also shall worship, because of the Lord that is faithful, and the Holy One of Israel, and he shall choose thee.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD, Israel’s Redeemer and Holy One, says to the one rejected by people and hated by nations, a servant to rulers: Kings will see you and stand up; princes will worship because the LORD is faithful, the Holy One of Israel, who has chosen you.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, In an acceptable time have I heard thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee: and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to establish the earth, to cause to inherit the desolate heritages;
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'I have heard you at the right time and helped you on the day of salvation. I will protect you and make you a covenant for the people, to restore the land and give the desolate places as an inheritance.'

verses.kjv: That thou mayest say to the prisoners, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Shew yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and their pastures shall be in all high places.
verses.decoded: So you can tell prisoners, 'Come out!' and those in darkness, 'Show yourselves!' They will graze along the roads and find pasture on every high mountain.

verses.kjv: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them shall lead them, even by the springs of water shall he guide them.
verses.decoded: They will not hunger or thirst, nor will the heat or sun harm them, because the one who has mercy will guide them beside springs of water.

verses.kjv: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.
verses.decoded: I will make all my mountains into roads, and my highways will be raised up.

verses.kjv: Behold, these shall come from far: and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.
verses.decoded: Look, people will come from far away—from the north, the west, and even from the land of Sinim (possibly southern lands).

verses.kjv: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for the Lord hath comforted his people, and will have mercy upon his afflicted.
verses.decoded: Heavens, sing! Earth, rejoice! Mountains, burst into song! The LORD has comforted his people and will show mercy to those who suffer.

verses.kjv: But Zion said, The Lord hath forsaken me, and my Lord hath forgotten me.
verses.decoded: But Zion said, 'The LORD has abandoned me; my Lord has forgotten me.'

verses.kjv: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, they may forget, yet will I not forget thee.
verses.decoded: Can a mother forget her nursing baby and have no compassion on the child she bore? Even if she could forget, I will never forget you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.
verses.decoded: Look, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands; your walls are always in my sight.

verses.kjv: Thy children shall make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth of thee.
verses.decoded: Your people will quickly return; those who destroyed and devastated you will leave.

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith the Lord, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all, as with an ornament, and bind them on thee, as a bride doeth.
verses.decoded: Look around and see: they are all coming together and coming to you. As surely as I live, says the LORD, you will dress yourself with them like ornaments and wear them like a bride.

verses.kjv: For thy waste and thy desolate places, and the land of thy destruction, shall even now be too narrow by reason of the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.
verses.decoded: Your ruined and empty lands will become too small because of the many people living there, and those who destroyed you will be far away.

verses.kjv: The children which thou shalt have, after thou hast lost the other, shall say again in thine ears, The place is too strait for me: give place to me that I may dwell.
verses.decoded: The children you have after losing others will say to you, 'The space is too small for me; make room for me to live.'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou say in thine heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have lost my children, and am desolate, a captive, and removing to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where had they been?
verses.decoded: Then you will wonder in your heart, 'Who has given me these children? I was left alone, desolate, captive, wandering. Where did these come from?'

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord God, Behold, I will lift up mine hand to the Gentiles, and set up my standard to the people: and they shall bring thy sons in their arms, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: I will raise my hand to the nations and raise my banner to the peoples. They will carry your sons in their arms and hold your daughters on their shoulders.

verses.kjv: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their face toward the earth, and lick up the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am the Lord: for they shall not be ashamed that wait for me.
verses.decoded: Kings will become your foster fathers, and their queens your nursing mothers. They will bow down to you with their faces to the ground and lick the dust from your feet. Then you will know that I am the LORD, and those who hope in me will never be ashamed.

verses.kjv: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captive delivered?
verses.decoded: Can captives be taken from a strong person? Can those who are justly imprisoned be rescued?

verses.kjv: But thus saith the Lord, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered: for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.
verses.decoded: But the LORD says, even captives held by the powerful will be freed, and those taken by cruel enemies will be rescued. I will fight against those who fight you, and I will save your children.

verses.kjv: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.decoded: I will make those who oppress you suffer by their own actions; they will be overwhelmed as if drunk on their own blood. Then everyone will know that I, the LORD, am your Savior and Redeemer, the powerful One from Jacob.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Where is the certificate of divorce from your mother, whom I have sent away? Or to which of my creditors did I sell you? Look, you sold yourselves because of your sins, and your mother was sent away because of your wrongdoings.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.
verses.decoded: So why was there no one when I came? Why did no one answer when I called? Is my power too weak to save? Do I lack the strength to rescue? When I speak, I can dry up the sea and turn rivers into deserts; the fish die and rot because there is no water.

verses.kjv: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.
verses.decoded: I cover the sky with darkness and wrap it in mourning clothes.

verses.kjv: The Lord God hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD has given me the ability to speak wisely, so I can encourage those who are tired. He wakes me every morning and opens my ears to listen like a student.

verses.kjv: The Lord God hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.
verses.decoded: The Lord GOD has opened my ear, and I did not refuse or turn away.

verses.kjv: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.
verses.decoded: I allowed those who beat me to strike my back and those who pulled my hair to hurt my face; I did not hide from shame or from being spat upon.

verses.kjv: For the Lord God will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.
verses.decoded: Because the Lord GOD helps me, I will not be ashamed. I have made my face firm like flint, knowing I will not be disgraced.

verses.kjv: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.
verses.decoded: The one who declares me innocent is near. Who can argue against me? Let them come forward. Who is my opponent? Let them confront me.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord God will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.
verses.decoded: See, the Lord GOD will help me. Who can accuse me? Everyone who tries will wear out like old clothes, eaten by moths.

verses.kjv: Who is among you that feareth the Lord, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the Lord, and stay upon his God.
verses.decoded: Who among you fears the LORD and listens to his servant? If you walk in darkness without light, trust in the name of the LORD and rely on your God.

verses.kjv: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
verses.decoded: Look, all of you who start fires and surround yourselves with sparks—walk in the light you create. This is what I will give you from my hand: you will lie down in sadness.

verses.kjv: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek the Lord: look unto the rock whence ye are hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye are digged.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, you who pursue righteousness and seek the LORD: look back to the rock from which you were cut and to the pit from which you were dug.

verses.kjv: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you: for I called him alone, and blessed him, and increased him.
verses.decoded: Look to Abraham your ancestor and to Sarah who gave you birth, because I called him alone, blessed him, and made his descendants many.

verses.kjv: For the Lord shall comfort Zion: he will comfort all her waste places; and he will make her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of the Lord; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.
verses.decoded: The LORD will comfort Zion and restore all its desolate places; he will transform its wilderness into a paradise like Eden, and its desert into the LORD’s garden. There, joy, gladness, thanksgiving, and singing will be heard.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall proceed from me, and I will make my judgment to rest for a light of the people.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, my people; pay attention, my nation, because a law will come from me, and I will establish my justice as a guiding light for the people.

verses.kjv: My righteousness is near; my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the people; the isles shall wait upon me, and on mine arm shall they trust.
verses.decoded: My righteousness is close at hand; my salvation has been revealed, and my power will judge the nations. The distant islands will hope in me and trust in my strength.

verses.kjv: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath: for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment, and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.
verses.decoded: Look up to the sky and down to the earth: the heavens will disappear like smoke, the earth will wear out like clothing, and its people will die too. But my salvation will last forever, and my righteousness will never fail.

verses.kjv: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye afraid of their revilings.
verses.decoded: Listen to me, you who understand righteousness, those who have my law in their hearts: do not fear insults from others or be afraid of their insults.

verses.kjv: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool: but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation from generation to generation.
verses.decoded: People may be destroyed like clothes eaten by moths or wool eaten by worms, but my righteousness will last forever, and my salvation will continue from one generation to the next.

verses.kjv: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the Lord; awake, as in the ancient days, in the generations of old. Art thou not it that hath cut Rahab, and wounded the dragon?
verses.decoded: Wake up, wake up, put on your strength, O powerful arm of the LORD; wake up as you did long ago, in ancient times. Aren’t you the one who defeated Rahab and wounded the dragon?

verses.kjv: Art thou not it which hath dried the sea, the waters of the great deep; that hath made the depths of the sea a way for the ransomed to pass over?
verses.decoded: Aren’t you the one who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep, and made a path through the depths for the redeemed to cross?

verses.kjv: Therefore the redeemed of the Lord shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their head: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and mourning shall flee away.
verses.decoded: So the LORD’s redeemed people will come back to Zion singing; they will have eternal joy on their heads. They will be filled with gladness and joy, and sorrow and mourning will disappear.

verses.kjv: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou shouldest be afraid of a man that shall die, and of the son of man which shall be made as grass;
verses.decoded: I, yes I, am the one who comforts you. Who are you to fear a man who will die, or a human being who is like grass and will wither?

verses.kjv: And forgettest the Lord thy maker, that hath stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and hast feared continually every day because of the fury of the oppressor, as if he were ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?
verses.decoded: Have you forgotten the LORD your Creator, who stretched out the heavens and laid the earth’s foundations? Why do you live in constant fear every day of the angry oppressor, as if he could destroy you? But where is the oppressor’s anger now?

verses.kjv: The captive exile hasteneth that he may be loosed, and that he should not die in the pit, nor that his bread should fail.
verses.decoded: The prisoner hurries to be set free, so he won’t die in the pit or go hungry.

verses.kjv: But I am the Lord thy God, that divided the sea, whose waves roared: The Lord of hosts is his name.
verses.decoded: But I am the LORD your God, who divided the sea and made its waves roar. The LORD of hosts is my name.

verses.kjv: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and I have covered thee in the shadow of mine hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.
verses.decoded: I have placed my words in your mouth and protected you under my hand, so that I can create the heavens and establish the earth, and declare to Zion, 'You are my people.'

verses.kjv: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, which hast drunk at the hand of the Lord the cup of his fury; thou hast drunken the dregs of the cup of trembling, and wrung them out.
verses.decoded: Wake up, wake up, stand up, Jerusalem, who has drunk the cup of God's anger; you have drunk it to the very last drop and squeezed it dry.

verses.kjv: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand of all the sons that she hath brought up.
verses.decoded: There is no one to lead her among all the children she has given birth to; no one to take her by the hand among all the sons she has raised.

verses.kjv: These two things are come unto thee; who shall be sorry for thee? desolation, and destruction, and the famine, and the sword: by whom shall I comfort thee?
verses.decoded: These two disasters have come upon you—desolation and destruction, famine and sword; who will comfort you now?

verses.kjv: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as a wild bull in a net: they are full of the fury of the Lord, the rebuke of thy God.
verses.decoded: Your sons have collapsed and lie in the streets like a trapped wild bull; they are overwhelmed by God's anger and punishment.

verses.kjv: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:
verses.decoded: So listen now, you who are suffering and staggering, but not because of wine:

verses.kjv: Thus saith thy Lord the Lord, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thine hand the cup of trembling, even the dregs of the cup of my fury; thou shalt no more drink it again:
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD your God says, who defends his people: I have taken the cup of trembling—the last dregs of my anger—out of your hand; you will never have to drink it again.

verses.kjv: But I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee; which have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over: and thou hast laid thy body as the ground, and as the street, to them that went over.
verses.decoded: Instead, I will give that cup to your oppressors, who have told you to submit so they can trample over you; and you have allowed yourself to be like the ground and the road for those who pass by.

verses.kjv: Awake, awake; put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.
