verses.decoded: Wake up, wake up! Put on your strength, Zion; put on your beautiful clothes, Jerusalem, the holy city. From now on, no unclean or foreign people will enter you.

verses.kjv: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, and sit down, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bands of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.
verses.decoded: Shake off the dust, stand up and take your place, Jerusalem. Free yourself from the chains around your neck, captive daughter of Zion.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord, Ye have sold yourselves for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: You sold yourselves for nothing, but now you will be redeemed without paying a price.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord God, My people went down aforetime into Egypt to sojourn there; and the Assyrian oppressed them without cause.
verses.decoded: The Sovereign LORD says: My people once went to Egypt to live temporarily, but the Assyrians oppressed them unfairly.

verses.kjv: Now therefore, what have I here, saith the Lord, that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them make them to howl, saith the Lord; and my name continually every day is blasphemed.
verses.decoded: So now, what do I gain if my people are taken away for nothing? Their rulers make them suffer and cry out, and my name is insulted every day.

verses.kjv: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak: behold, it is I.
verses.decoded: But my people will come to know my name; on that day they will realize that I am the one speaking. Yes, it is I.

verses.kjv: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace; that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation; that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!
verses.decoded: How wonderful are the feet of the messenger who brings good news, who announces peace, who brings good news of happiness, who tells Zion, 'Your God rules!'

verses.kjv: Thy watchmen shall lift up the voice; with the voice together shall they sing: for they shall see eye to eye, when the Lord shall bring again Zion.
verses.decoded: Your watchmen will shout together, they will sing for joy because they will see with their own eyes when the LORD restores Zion.

verses.kjv: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem: for the Lord hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Shout for joy and sing together, ruins of Jerusalem, because the LORD has comforted His people and redeemed the city.

verses.kjv: The Lord hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth shall see the salvation of our God.
verses.decoded: The LORD has revealed His power openly to all nations, and everyone on earth will see the salvation our God brings.

verses.kjv: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; be ye clean, that bear the vessels of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Leave, leave! Come out from there, don’t touch anything unclean. Leave her midst and be pure, you who carry the LORD’s sacred things.

verses.kjv: For ye shall not go out with haste, nor go by flight: for the Lord will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rereward.
verses.decoded: You will not leave in a rush or run away; the LORD will go ahead of you, and the God of Israel will protect you from behind.

verses.kjv: Behold, my servant shall deal prudently, he shall be exalted and extolled, and be very high.
verses.decoded: Look, my servant will act wisely, be honored, lifted up, and greatly exalted.

verses.kjv: As many were astonied at thee; his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men:
verses.decoded: Many were shocked by him; his appearance was so disfigured that he looked worse than any man, his form unlike any human.

verses.kjv: So shall he sprinkle many nations; the kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they consider.
verses.decoded: He will bring blessing to many nations; kings will be speechless before him. They will see things never told to them and understand things they never heard before.

verses.kjv: Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed?
verses.decoded: Who has believed what we have heard? To whom has the power of the LORD been shown?

verses.kjv: For he shall grow up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we shall see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.
verses.decoded: He will grow up like a young plant, like a root growing in dry soil. He has no special appearance or beauty that would attract us to him.

verses.kjv: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verses.decoded: People despised and rejected him; he was a man who suffered deeply and knew pain. We turned away from him and did not value him.

verses.kjv: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows: yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.
verses.decoded: He took on our pains and carried our sorrows, but we thought he was punished and struck down by God.

verses.kjv: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities: the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.
verses.decoded: But he was hurt because of our sins and crushed because of our wrongdoings. He was punished so we could have peace, and by his wounds, we are healed.

verses.kjv: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and the Lord hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.
verses.decoded: We have all wandered away like sheep, each following our own path, but the LORD placed all our sins on him.

verses.kjv: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verses.decoded: He was treated harshly and suffered, but he did not complain. Like a lamb led to slaughter, he remained silent.

verses.kjv: He was taken from prison and from judgment: and who shall declare his generation? for he was cut off out of the land of the living: for the transgression of my people was he stricken.
verses.decoded: He was taken away by oppression and judgment. Who can tell about his descendants? He was killed and removed from the living because he was punished for the sins of my people.

verses.kjv: And he made his grave with the wicked, and with the rich in his death; because he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.
verses.decoded: He was buried with criminals and also with the wealthy, even though he had done nothing violent or deceitful.

verses.kjv: Yet it pleased the Lord to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of the Lord shall prosper in his hand.
verses.decoded: But it pleased the LORD to crush him and cause him to suffer. When he offers himself as a sacrifice for sin, he will see his descendants, live a long life, and accomplish the LORD’s purpose.

verses.kjv: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verses.decoded: He will see the results of his suffering and be satisfied. Through his understanding, my righteous servant will make many right with God by taking on their sins.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he hath poured out his soul unto death: and he was numbered with the transgressors; and he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.
verses.decoded: Therefore, I will give him a share among the great, and he will share the victory with the strong, because he gave his life to death. He was counted among sinners and took on the sins of many, and he prayed for those who sinned.

verses.kjv: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Sing, you who have been unable to have children; shout for joy, you who have never given birth! You will have more children than a wife who has a husband, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thine habitations: spare not, lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes;
verses.decoded: Make your tent larger and extend the curtains of your home; don’t hold back—lengthen your ropes and strengthen your stakes.

verses.kjv: For thou shalt break forth on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall inherit the Gentiles, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.
verses.decoded: You will spread out in all directions; your descendants will inherit the nations and rebuild deserted cities.

verses.kjv: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth, and shalt not remember the reproach of thy widowhood any more.
verses.decoded: Don’t be afraid or embarrassed; you won’t be ashamed anymore. You will forget the shame of your past and no longer remember your loneliness.

verses.kjv: For thy Maker is thine husband; the Lord of hosts is his name; and thy Redeemer the Holy One of Israel; The God of the whole earth shall he be called.
verses.decoded: Your Creator is your husband—the LORD Almighty is his name; your Redeemer is the Holy One of Israel, the God of the whole earth.

verses.kjv: For the Lord hath called thee as a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, and a wife of youth, when thou wast refused, saith thy God.
verses.decoded: The LORD calls you like a woman abandoned and grieving, like a young wife rejected, says your God.

verses.kjv: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.
verses.decoded: I have abandoned you only briefly, but with great kindness I will bring you back.

verses.kjv: In a little wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting kindness will I have mercy on thee, saith the Lord thy Redeemer.
verses.decoded: For a short time I turned away in anger, but with eternal love I will show you mercy, says the LORD your Redeemer.

verses.kjv: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me: for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah should no more go over the earth; so have I sworn that I would not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.
verses.decoded: This is like the flood in Noah’s time to me: just as I promised never to flood the earth again, I promise never to be angry with you or punish you.

verses.kjv: For the mountains shall depart, and the hills be removed; but my kindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall the covenant of my peace be removed, saith the Lord that hath mercy on thee.
verses.decoded: Mountains may move and hills disappear, but my love will never leave you, nor will my promise of peace be broken, says the LORD who shows you mercy.

verses.kjv: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will lay thy stones with fair colours, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.
verses.decoded: You who are suffering and shaken by storms without comfort, I will rebuild you with beautiful stones and lay your foundation with sapphires.

verses.kjv: And I will make thy windows of agates, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy borders of pleasant stones.
verses.decoded: I will make your windows of agate, your gates of sparkling gems, and all your walls of precious stones.

verses.kjv: And all thy children shall be taught of the Lord; and great shall be the peace of thy children.
verses.decoded: All your children will be taught by the LORD, and your children will have great peace.

verses.kjv: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression; for thou shalt not fear: and from terror; for it shall not come near thee.
verses.decoded: You will be established in righteousness; oppression will be far from you; you will not fear or be terrified because danger will not come near.

verses.kjv: Behold, they shall surely gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall for thy sake.
verses.decoded: Look, enemies will gather against you, but not with my approval; anyone who attacks you will be defeated for your sake.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire, and that bringeth forth an instrument for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.
verses.decoded: Look, I am the one who made the blacksmith who blows the fire and shapes the tools for his work; I also made the destroyer to bring ruin.

verses.kjv: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of the Lord, and their righteousness is of me, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: No weapon made to harm you will succeed, and any accusation spoken against you will be proven wrong. This is the special inheritance of God's servants, and their right standing comes from me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.
verses.decoded: Listen, everyone who is thirsty, come to the water! Even if you have no money, come and buy food and drink—wine and milk—without paying anything.

verses.kjv: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labour for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.
verses.decoded: Why do you spend money on things that don’t satisfy, and work hard for things that leave you empty? Listen carefully to me, and enjoy what truly satisfies your soul.

verses.kjv: Incline your ear, and come unto me: hear, and your soul shall live; and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.
verses.decoded: Listen closely and come to me; hear my words and your soul will live. I will make an eternal promise with you, based on the faithful love I showed to David.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the people, a leader and commander to the people.
verses.decoded: Look, I have appointed him as a witness to the nations, a leader and commander for the people.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not, and nations that knew not thee shall run unto thee because of the Lord thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.
verses.decoded: You will call on a nation you don’t know, and nations that don’t know you will come running because of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, who has honored you.

verses.kjv: Seek ye the Lord while he may be found, call ye upon him while he is near:
verses.decoded: Look for the LORD while he is still near; call on him while he is easy to find.

verses.kjv: Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts: and let him return unto the Lord, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.
verses.decoded: Let the wicked turn away from their wrong ways, and the sinful stop their evil thoughts. Come back to the LORD, who will show mercy and forgive generously.

verses.kjv: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: My thoughts are nothing like your thoughts, and my ways are far beyond your ways, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.
verses.decoded: Just as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways and thoughts higher than yours.

verses.kjv: For as the rain cometh down, and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, that it may give seed to the sower, and bread to the eater:
verses.decoded: Just as rain and snow come down from the sky and don’t return there without watering the earth and making it produce plants that provide seed for the farmer and food for people,

verses.kjv: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verses.decoded: So my word that goes out from my mouth will not return empty; it will do what I want and succeed in the purpose I sent it for.

verses.kjv: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing, and all the trees of the field shall clap their hands.
verses.decoded: You will leave with joy and be guided in peace. The mountains and hills will celebrate before you, and all the trees in the fields will clap their hands.

verses.kjv: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir tree, and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle tree: and it shall be to the Lord for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.
verses.decoded: Where there were thorns, fir trees will grow; where there were briers, myrtle trees will grow. This will be a lasting symbol honoring the LORD, a sign that will never be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, Keep ye judgment, and do justice: for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Maintain fairness and practice justice, because my salvation is about to arrive, and my righteousness will soon be shown.

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that layeth hold on it; that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person who does this and holds firmly to it—who honors the Sabbath without defiling it and refuses to do any wrong.

verses.kjv: Neither let the son of the stranger, that hath joined himself to the Lord, speak, saying, The Lord hath utterly separated me from his people: neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.
verses.decoded: Don’t let foreigners who have committed themselves to the LORD say, 'The LORD has completely excluded me from his people.' And don’t let eunuchs say, 'I am like a useless, barren tree.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord unto the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and take hold of my covenant;
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says to eunuchs who honor my Sabbaths, choose what pleases me, and hold tightly to my covenant:

verses.kjv: Even unto them will I give in mine house and within my walls a place and a name better than of sons and of daughters: I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.
verses.decoded: I will give them, within my house and walls, a special place and a name greater than that of sons and daughters. I will give them a lasting name that will never be destroyed.

verses.kjv: Also the sons of the stranger, that join themselves to the Lord, to serve him, and to love the name of the Lord, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from polluting it, and taketh hold of my covenant;
verses.decoded: Also, foreigners who commit themselves to the LORD to serve him, love his name, and become his servants—everyone who honors the Sabbath without defiling it and holds firmly to my covenant—

verses.kjv: Even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for mine house shall be called an house of prayer for all people.
verses.decoded: I will bring them to my holy mountain and make them joyful in my house of prayer. Their offerings and sacrifices will be accepted on my altar, because my house will be called a house of prayer for all nations.

verses.kjv: The Lord God which gathereth the outcasts of Israel saith, Yet will I gather others to him, beside those that are gathered unto him.
verses.decoded: The LORD God, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says, 'I will also gather others besides those already gathered to me.'

verses.kjv: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.
verses.decoded: All you wild animals of the field, come and devour; yes, all the animals of the forest.

verses.kjv: His watchmen are blind: they are all ignorant, they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; sleeping, lying down, loving to slumber.
verses.decoded: His watchmen are blind; they are all ignorant, like mute dogs that cannot bark. They lie down and sleep, loving to slumber.

verses.kjv: Yea, they are greedy dogs which can never have enough, and they are shepherds that cannot understand: they all look to their own way, every one for his gain, from his quarter.
verses.decoded: Yes, they are greedy dogs that never get full, shepherds who lack understanding. Each looks out only for their own interests, seeking gain from their own area.

verses.kjv: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to morrow shall be as this day, and much more abundant.
verses.decoded: They say, 'Come, let’s get wine and fill ourselves with strong drink; tomorrow will be just like today, even better.'

verses.kjv: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart: and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.
verses.decoded: The righteous die, but no one pays attention; the kind and godly are taken away without anyone realizing that the righteous are being spared from coming evil.

verses.kjv: He shall enter into peace: they shall rest in their beds, each one walking in his uprightness.
verses.decoded: They will enter into peace and rest in their beds, each one living in integrity.

verses.kjv: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the whore.
verses.decoded: But come here, you descendants of the sorceress, children of the adulterer and prostitute.

verses.kjv: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and draw out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,
verses.decoded: Who are you mocking? At whom are you sticking out your tongue? Aren't you children of rebellion, offspring of lies?

verses.kjv: Enflaming yourselves with idols under every green tree, slaying the children in the valleys under the clifts of the rocks?
verses.decoded: You burn yourselves with idols under every green tree and kill your children in the valleys among the rocky cliffs.

verses.kjv: Among the smooth stones of the stream is thy portion; they, they are thy lot: even to them hast thou poured a drink offering, thou hast offered a meat offering. Should I receive comfort in these?
verses.decoded: Your share is among the smooth stones of the stream; that is your lot. You have poured out drink offerings and presented food offerings to them. Should I accept comfort from these?

verses.kjv: Upon a lofty and high mountain hast thou set thy bed: even thither wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.
verses.decoded: You have set your bed on a high and lofty mountain, and there you went up to offer sacrifices.

verses.kjv: Behind the doors also and the posts hast thou set up thy remembrance: for thou hast discovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them; thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.
verses.decoded: You have set up your memorial behind doors and doorposts because you have revealed yourself to someone other than me. You have gone up, enlarged your bed, and made a pact with them. You loved their bed wherever you saw it.

verses.kjv: And thou wentest to the king with ointment, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thy messengers far off, and didst debase thyself even unto hell.
verses.decoded: You went to the king with ointment, increased your perfumes, sent your messengers far away, and humbled yourself even to the grave.

verses.kjv: Thou art wearied in the greatness of thy way; yet saidst thou not, There is no hope: thou hast found the life of thine hand; therefore thou wast not grieved.
verses.decoded: You are tired from your many ways, but you did not say, 'There is no hope.' You found life in your own efforts, so you were not discouraged.

verses.kjv: And of whom hast thou been afraid or feared, that thou hast lied, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of old, and thou fearest me not?
verses.decoded: Who were you afraid of that you lied and forgot me, not thinking about it? I have been silent for a long time, yet you do not fear me.

verses.kjv: I will declare thy righteousness, and thy works; for they shall not profit thee.
verses.decoded: I will point out your righteousness and your deeds, but they will not help you.

verses.kjv: When thou criest, let thy companies deliver thee; but the wind shall carry them all away; vanity shall take them: but he that putteth his trust in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain;
verses.decoded: When you call for help, let your allies save you, but the wind will blow them all away and emptiness will take them. But whoever trusts in me will inherit the land and possess my holy mountain.

verses.kjv: And shall say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumblingblock out of the way of my people.
verses.decoded: They will say, 'Build up, build up! Prepare the road! Remove the obstacles from my people's path.'

verses.kjv: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy; I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite ones.
verses.decoded: This is what the exalted and eternal Holy One says: I live in the high and holy place, but I am also with those who are humble and repentant, to give new life to their spirits and restore their hearts.

verses.kjv: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth: for the spirit should fail before me, and the souls which I have made.
verses.decoded: I will not argue with you forever, nor stay angry forever, because the spirit and the souls I created are fragile.

verses.kjv: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him: I hid me, and was wroth, and he went on frowardly in the way of his heart.
verses.decoded: I was angry because of his greed and punished him; I withdrew and was angry, but he continued stubbornly following his own desires.

verses.kjv: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.
verses.decoded: I have observed his behavior and will heal him; I will guide him and bring comfort to him and those who grieve with him.

verses.kjv: I create the fruit of the lips; Peace, peace to him that is far off, and to him that is near, saith the Lord; and I will heal him.
verses.decoded: I bring about the results of sincere words: peace to those far away and those nearby, says the LORD, and I will heal them.

verses.kjv: But the wicked are like the troubled sea, when it cannot rest, whose waters cast up mire and dirt.
verses.decoded: But the wicked are like a restless, stormy sea that stirs up mud and dirt, never settling down.

verses.kjv: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.
verses.decoded: My God declares that there is no peace for the wicked.

verses.kjv: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and shew my people their transgression, and the house of Jacob their sins.
verses.decoded: Shout loudly and don’t hold back; raise your voice like a trumpet to show my people their wrongdoings and the house of Jacob their sins.

verses.kjv: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways, as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God: they ask of me the ordinances of justice; they take delight in approaching to God.
verses.decoded: Yet they seek me every day and enjoy learning my ways, acting like a nation that does what is right and does not abandon God’s laws. They ask me about justice and enjoy coming near to God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find pleasure, and exact all your labours.
verses.decoded: They say, “Why have we fasted if you don’t notice? Why have we humbled ourselves if you don’t pay attention?” But on your fasting days, you enjoy yourselves and demand hard work from others.

verses.kjv: Behold, ye fast for strife and debate, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye shall not fast as ye do this day, to make your voice to be heard on high.
verses.decoded: Look, you fast only to argue and fight, and to strike with violence. You will not fast like this and expect your prayers to be heard.

verses.kjv: Is it such a fast that I have chosen? a day for a man to afflict his soul? is it to bow down his head as a bulrush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to the Lord?
verses.decoded: Is this the kind of fast I want? A day when a person humbles themselves, bowing their head like a reed and wearing sackcloth and ashes? Do you call this fasting and a day pleasing to the Lord?

verses.kjv: Is not this the fast that I have chosen? to loose the bands of wickedness, to undo the heavy burdens, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?
verses.decoded: Isn’t this the kind of fasting I want? To break the chains of injustice, remove heavy burdens, free those who are oppressed, and break every yoke of slavery?

verses.kjv: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?
verses.decoded: Isn’t it to share your food with the hungry, invite the poor and homeless into your home, clothe the naked when you see them, and not ignore your own family?

verses.kjv: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thine health shall spring forth speedily: and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of the Lord shall be thy rereward.
verses.decoded: Then your light will shine like the morning, your healing will come quickly, your righteousness will lead you, and the glory of the Lord will protect you from behind.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou call, and the Lord shall answer; thou shalt cry, and he shall say, Here I am. If thou take away from the midst of thee the yoke, the putting forth of the finger, and speaking vanity;
verses.decoded: Then you will call out, and the Lord will answer; you will cry for help, and he will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you stop blaming others, pointing fingers, and speaking falsehoods,

verses.kjv: And if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul; then shall thy light rise in obscurity, and thy darkness be as the noonday:
verses.decoded: And if you give yourself to help the hungry and satisfy the needs of the suffering, then your light will shine even in darkness, and your shadows will be like midday.

verses.kjv: And the Lord shall guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in drought, and make fat thy bones: and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.
verses.decoded: The Lord will guide you always, satisfy your soul even in dry times, strengthen your body, and you will be like a well-watered garden or a flowing spring that never runs dry.

verses.kjv: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places: thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called, The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.
verses.decoded: Those from you will rebuild ancient ruins; you will restore the foundations of many generations. You will be called the one who repairs broken walls and restores safe paths to live in.

verses.kjv: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, the holy of the Lord, honourable; and shalt honour him, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:
verses.decoded: If you stop doing your own things on the Sabbath, call it a joyful and holy day honoring the Lord, and honor God by not following your own desires or speaking your own words,

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou delight thyself in the Lord; and I will cause thee to ride upon the high places of the earth, and feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
verses.decoded: Then you will find joy in the Lord, and I will let you live in high places and provide for you from the inheritance of Jacob your ancestor. This is what the Lord has promised.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD’s power is not limited so that He cannot save, and His ears are not deaf so that He cannot hear.

verses.kjv: But your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, that he will not hear.
verses.decoded: But your sins have created a barrier between you and God, and your wrongdoings have caused Him to turn His face away so He does not listen.

verses.kjv: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue hath muttered perverseness.
verses.decoded: Your hands are stained with violence, your fingers with wrongdoing; your lips tell lies, and your tongue speaks evil.

verses.kjv: None calleth for justice, nor any pleadeth for truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.
verses.decoded: No one calls for justice or defends the truth; instead, they rely on worthless things and lie, planning evil and committing sin.

verses.kjv: They hatch cockatrice’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth, and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.
verses.decoded: They produce poisonous plans like a snake hatching eggs and spin traps like a spider’s web; anyone who falls into their schemes dies, and when disturbed, their evil turns deadly.

verses.kjv: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.
verses.decoded: Their traps will not protect them or cover their shame; their deeds are evil, and violence is in their hands.

verses.kjv: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; wasting and destruction are in their paths.
verses.decoded: They rush to do evil and quickly kill innocent people; their minds are full of wrongdoing, and destruction follows wherever they go.

verses.kjv: The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
verses.decoded: They do not understand the way of peace; there is no fairness in their actions. They have made their paths crooked, and anyone who follows them will not find peace.

verses.kjv: Therefore is judgment far from us, neither doth justice overtake us: we wait for light, but behold obscurity; for brightness, but we walk in darkness.
verses.decoded: Because of this, justice is far from us and fairness does not reach us; we hope for light but only see darkness, and though we expect brightness, we walk in gloom.

verses.kjv: We grope for the wall like the blind, and we grope as if we had no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the night; we are in desolate places as dead men.
verses.decoded: We feel our way along walls like blind people, as if we have no eyes; we stumble at midday as if it were night, wandering in empty places like the dead.

verses.kjv: We roar all like bears, and mourn sore like doves: we look for judgment, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.
verses.decoded: We cry out loudly like bears and mourn deeply like doves; we seek justice but find none, and look for salvation but it is far away.

verses.kjv: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us: for our transgressions are with us; and as for our iniquities, we know them;
verses.decoded: Our sins have increased before You, and they accuse us; we are fully aware of our wrongdoing and iniquities.

verses.kjv: In transgressing and lying against the Lord, and departing away from our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.
verses.decoded: We have rebelled and lied against the LORD, turned away from our God, spoken oppression and rebellion, and from our hearts spoken falsehood.

verses.kjv: And judgment is turned away backward, and justice standeth afar off: for truth is fallen in the street, and equity cannot enter.
verses.decoded: Justice has turned away, and fairness stands far off; truth is lost in the streets, and fairness cannot come in.

verses.kjv: Yea, truth faileth; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey: and the Lord saw it, and it displeased him that there was no judgment.
verses.decoded: Yes, truth is lacking; and those who avoid evil are considered foolish. The LORD saw this and was displeased that there was no justice.

verses.kjv: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it sustained him.
verses.decoded: He saw that no one was there to help or stand in the gap, and he was surprised that no one was interceding; so he acted with power to save, and his justice supported him.

verses.kjv: For he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and an helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on the garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a cloke.
verses.decoded: He dressed himself in righteousness like armor protecting his chest, wore salvation like a helmet on his head, put on clothes of vengeance, and wrapped himself in passionate zeal like a cloak.

verses.kjv: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
verses.decoded: He will repay people based on what they have done—anger to his enemies and punishment to those who oppose him, even to distant lands he will give what they deserve.

verses.kjv: So shall they fear the name of the Lord from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun. When the enemy shall come in like a flood, the Spirit of the Lord shall lift up a standard against him.
verses.decoded: People everywhere—from the west to the east—will respect and fear the name of the LORD. When enemies attack like a flood, the Spirit of the LORD will raise a banner to stop and defeat them.

verses.kjv: And the Redeemer shall come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: The Savior will come to Zion and to those in Jacob who turn away from their sins, declares the LORD.

verses.kjv: As for me, this is my covenant with them, saith the Lord; My spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith the Lord, from henceforth and for ever.
verses.decoded: This is my promise to them, says the LORD: My Spirit on you and the words I have given you will never leave your mouth, nor the mouths of your descendants, forever.

verses.kjv: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the Lord is risen upon thee.
verses.decoded: Get up and shine brightly, because your light has arrived, and the glory of the LORD has come upon you.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the people: but the Lord shall arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.
verses.decoded: Even though darkness covers the earth and people are in deep gloom, the LORD will rise over you, and His glory will be visible on you.

verses.kjv: And the Gentiles shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.
verses.decoded: Nations will come to your light, and kings will be drawn to your radiant dawn.

verses.kjv: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: all they gather themselves together, they come to thee: thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be nursed at thy side.
verses.decoded: Look around and see—everyone is coming together and coming to you; your sons will return from far away, and your daughters will be cared for close to you.

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt see, and flow together, and thine heart shall fear, and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee, the forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee.
verses.decoded: You will see and be overwhelmed with joy; your heart will grow strong because the wealth of the seas and the riches of the nations will come to you.

verses.kjv: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come: they shall bring gold and incense; and they shall shew forth the praises of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Caravans of camels will cover you, including those from Midian and Ephah; people from Sheba will come bringing gold and incense, proclaiming the praises of the LORD.

verses.kjv: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee: they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar, and I will glorify the house of my glory.
verses.decoded: All the flocks of Kedar will be brought to you, and the rams of Nebaioth will serve you; they will be accepted as offerings on my altar, and I will honor the place of my glory.

verses.kjv: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?
verses.decoded: Who are these that come quickly like a cloud, and like doves flying to their windows?

verses.kjv: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, unto the name of the Lord thy God, and to the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.
verses.decoded: The distant islands will wait for me, and the ships from Tarshish will come first, bringing your children from far away with silver and gold, honoring the name of the LORD your God, the Holy One of Israel, because He has honored you.

verses.kjv: And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.
verses.decoded: Foreigners will rebuild your walls, and their kings will serve you; though I punished you in anger, I have now shown you mercy in my favor.

verses.kjv: Therefore thy gates shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the forces of the Gentiles, and that their kings may be brought.
verses.decoded: Your gates will always be open, never closed day or night, so that the wealth of the nations and their kings may be brought to you.

verses.kjv: For the nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
verses.decoded: Any nation or kingdom that refuses to serve you will be destroyed; those nations will be completely ruined.

verses.kjv: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir tree, the pine tree, and the box together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
verses.decoded: The finest trees of Lebanon—the fir, pine, and boxwood—will come to beautify my sanctuary, and I will make my resting place glorious.

verses.kjv: The sons also of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee, The city of the Lord, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.
verses.decoded: Even the children of those who hurt you will come humbly to you; all who once despised you will bow down at your feet and call you 'The city of the LORD,' 'The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.'

verses.kjv: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man went through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.
verses.decoded: Though you were once abandoned and hated, with no one passing through, I will make you an everlasting pride and joy for many generations.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the Gentiles, and shalt suck the breast of kings: and thou shalt know that I the Lord am thy Saviour and thy Redeemer, the mighty One of Jacob.
verses.decoded: You will receive abundant blessings from the nations and kings, and you will recognize that I, the LORD, am your Savior and Redeemer, the powerful One of Israel.

verses.kjv: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron: I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.
verses.decoded: Instead of bronze, I will give you gold; instead of iron, silver; instead of wood, bronze; and instead of stones, iron. I will also make your leaders peaceful and your officials just.

verses.kjv: Violence shall no more be heard in thy land, wasting nor destruction within thy borders; but thou shalt call thy walls Salvation, and thy gates Praise.
verses.decoded: Violence will no longer be heard in your land, and there will be no ruin or destruction inside your borders. You will name your walls 'Salvation' and your gates 'Praise.'

verses.kjv: The sun shall be no more thy light by day; neither for brightness shall the moon give light unto thee: but the Lord shall be unto thee an everlasting light, and thy God thy glory.
verses.decoded: You will no longer rely on the sun for light during the day or the moon for brightness at night; instead, the LORD will be your eternal light and your source of glory.

verses.kjv: Thy sun shall no more go down; neither shall thy moon withdraw itself: for the Lord shall be thine everlasting light, and the days of thy mourning shall be ended.
verses.decoded: Your sun will never set, nor will your moon fade away, because the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your time of sorrow will end.

verses.kjv: Thy people also shall be all righteous: they shall inherit the land for ever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.
verses.decoded: Your people will all be righteous and will inherit the land forever. They are like a branch I have planted, the work of my hands, so that I may be honored.

verses.kjv: A little one shall become a thousand, and a small one a strong nation: I the Lord will hasten it in his time.
verses.decoded: What starts small will grow into thousands, and a tiny group will become a powerful nation. I, the LORD, will make this happen quickly at the right time.

verses.kjv: The Spirit of the Lord God is upon me; because the Lord hath anointed me to preach good tidings unto the meek; he hath sent me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives, and the opening of the prison to them that are bound;
verses.decoded: The Spirit of the Lord God is on me because the Lord has chosen me to bring good news to the humble. He has sent me to heal the brokenhearted, to announce freedom for prisoners, and to release those who are held captive.

verses.kjv: To proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord, and the day of vengeance of our God; to comfort all that mourn;
verses.decoded: I am sent to announce the Lord’s favorable year and the day when God will bring justice, and to comfort everyone who is grieving.

verses.kjv: To appoint unto them that mourn in Zion, to give unto them beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness; that they might be called trees of righteousness, the planting of the Lord, that he might be glorified.
verses.decoded: I will give those who mourn in Zion a reward instead of their sorrow—beauty instead of ashes, joy instead of sadness, and praise instead of despair—so they will be known as righteous and as God’s special people, bringing Him glory.

verses.kjv: And they shall build the old wastes, they shall raise up the former desolations, and they shall repair the waste cities, the desolations of many generations.
verses.decoded: They will rebuild the ruins of the past, restore the places long destroyed, and repair cities that have been abandoned for many years.

verses.kjv: And strangers shall stand and feed your flocks, and the sons of the alien shall be your plowmen and your vinedressers.
verses.decoded: Foreigners will help care for your livestock, and outsiders will work your fields and vineyards.

verses.kjv: But ye shall be named the Priests of the Lord: men shall call you the Ministers of our God: ye shall eat the riches of the Gentiles, and in their glory shall ye boast yourselves.
verses.decoded: You will be called priests of the Lord and ministers of God. You will enjoy the wealth of the nations and take pride in their honor.

verses.kjv: For your shame ye shall have double; and for confusion they shall rejoice in their portion: therefore in their land they shall possess the double: everlasting joy shall be unto them.
verses.decoded: Instead of shame, you will receive twice as much honor; instead of disgrace, you will rejoice. You will possess twice as much in your land, and everlasting joy will be yours.

verses.kjv: For I the Lord love judgment, I hate robbery for burnt offering; and I will direct their work in truth, and I will make an everlasting covenant with them.
verses.decoded: I, the Lord, love justice and hate dishonest sacrifices. I will guide their efforts with truth and establish an eternal agreement with them.

verses.kjv: And their seed shall be known among the Gentiles, and their offspring among the people: all that see them shall acknowledge them, that they are the seed which the Lord hath blessed.
verses.decoded: Their descendants will be recognized among the nations, and everyone who sees them will acknowledge that they are the people blessed by the Lord.

verses.kjv: I will greatly rejoice in the Lord, my soul shall be joyful in my God; for he hath clothed me with the garments of salvation, he hath covered me with the robe of righteousness, as a bridegroom decketh himself with ornaments, and as a bride adorneth herself with her jewels.
verses.decoded: I will rejoice greatly in the Lord; my soul will be joyful in God because He has dressed me in salvation and wrapped me in righteousness, like a bridegroom dressed in fine clothes and a bride adorned with jewels.

verses.kjv: For as the earth bringeth forth her bud, and as the garden causeth the things that are sown in it to spring forth; so the Lord God will cause righteousness and praise to spring forth before all the nations.
verses.decoded: Just as the earth produces new growth and a garden makes seeds sprout, the Lord will cause righteousness and praise to grow and be seen by all nations.

verses.kjv: For Zion’s sake will I not hold my peace, and for Jerusalem’s sake I will not rest, until the righteousness thereof go forth as brightness, and the salvation thereof as a lamp that burneth.
verses.decoded: I will not stay silent for the sake of Zion, nor will I rest for the sake of Jerusalem, until its justice shines brightly and its salvation burns like a lamp.

verses.kjv: And the Gentiles shall see thy righteousness, and all kings thy glory: and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.
verses.decoded: Nations will witness your justice, and all rulers will see your glory; you will be given a new name, chosen by the LORD himself.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also be a crown of glory in the hand of the Lord, and a royal diadem in the hand of thy God.
verses.decoded: You will be like a glorious crown in the LORD’s hand, a royal jewel in the hand of your God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt no more be termed Forsaken; neither shall thy land any more be termed Desolate: but thou shalt be called Hephzi-bah, and thy land Beulah: for the Lord delighteth in thee, and thy land shall be married.
verses.decoded: You will no longer be called ‘Forsaken,’ nor will your land be called ‘Desolate.’ Instead, you will be named ‘My Delight Is in Her,’ and your land ‘Married,’ because the LORD delights in you and your land will be united with Him.

verses.kjv: For as a young man marrieth a virgin, so shall thy sons marry thee: and as the bridegroom rejoiceth over the bride, so shall thy God rejoice over thee.
verses.decoded: Just as a young man marries a virgin, your people will be joined to you; and just as a bridegroom is happy with his bride, so your God will rejoice over you.

verses.kjv: I have set watchmen upon thy walls, O Jerusalem, which shall never hold their peace day nor night: ye that make mention of the Lord, keep not silence,
verses.decoded: I have placed watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem, who will never be silent day or night. Those who remember the LORD, do not keep quiet.

verses.kjv: And give him no rest, till he establish, and till he make Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
verses.decoded: Do not let them rest until they establish Jerusalem firmly and make it a praised city throughout the earth.

verses.kjv: The Lord hath sworn by his right hand, and by the arm of his strength, Surely I will no more give thy corn to be meat for thine enemies; and the sons of the stranger shall not drink thy wine, for the which thou hast laboured:
verses.decoded: The LORD has sworn by His powerful hand that He will no longer let your grain be food for your enemies, nor will foreigners drink the wine you worked hard to produce.

verses.kjv: But they that have gathered it shall eat it, and praise the Lord; and they that have brought it together shall drink it in the courts of my holiness.
verses.decoded: Instead, those who harvest it will eat and praise the LORD; those who collect it will drink it in the sacred courts of God’s presence.

verses.kjv: Go through, go through the gates; prepare ye the way of the people; cast up, cast up the highway; gather out the stones; lift up a standard for the people.
verses.decoded: Go through the gates, prepare the way for the people; build a highway, clear away the stones, and raise a banner to lead the people.

verses.kjv: Behold, the Lord hath proclaimed unto the end of the world, Say ye to the daughter of Zion, Behold, thy salvation cometh; behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
verses.decoded: The LORD has announced to the ends of the earth: Tell Jerusalem, ‘Your salvation is coming; His reward is with Him, and His work goes before Him.’

verses.kjv: And they shall call them, The holy people, The redeemed of the Lord: and thou shalt be called, Sought out, A city not forsaken.
verses.decoded: They will be called ‘The Holy People,’ ‘The Redeemed of the LORD,’ and you will be called ‘Sought After,’ ‘A City Not Abandoned.’

verses.kjv: Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah? this that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength? I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.
verses.decoded: Who is this coming from Edom, wearing clothes stained in Bozrah? He is dressed in glorious garments, moving powerfully. I speak with justice; I am mighty to save.

verses.kjv: Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?
verses.decoded: Why are your clothes red, and your garments look like someone who has been treading grapes in a winepress?

verses.kjv: I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me: for I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury; and their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.
verses.decoded: I have pressed the winepress alone; no one helped me. I will crush my enemies in my anger and fury, and their blood will stain my clothes.

verses.kjv: For the day of vengeance is in mine heart, and the year of my redeemed is come.
verses.decoded: I have planned my day of revenge, and the time to save my people has arrived.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and there was none to help; and I wondered that there was none to uphold: therefore mine own arm brought salvation unto me; and my fury, it upheld me.
verses.decoded: I looked around, but no one helped me or supported me. So I saved myself by my own strength, and my anger gave me power.

verses.kjv: And I will tread down the people in mine anger, and make them drunk in my fury, and I will bring down their strength to the earth.
verses.decoded: I will crush the nations in my anger, overwhelm them in my fury, and bring their power down to the ground.

verses.kjv: I will mention the lovingkindnesses of the Lord, and the praises of the Lord, according to all that the Lord hath bestowed on us, and the great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies, and according to the multitude of his lovingkindnesses.
verses.decoded: I will remember the Lord’s faithful love and praise Him for all the blessings He has given us, the great kindness shown to Israel because of His mercy and abundant love.

verses.kjv: For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.
verses.decoded: He said, 'They are truly my people, children who will not deceive me.' So He became their Savior.

verses.kjv: In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them: in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; and he bare them, and carried them all the days of old.
verses.decoded: When they suffered, He suffered with them. The angel of His presence saved them. Because of His love and compassion, He redeemed them and carried them throughout history.

verses.kjv: But they rebelled, and vexed his holy Spirit: therefore he was turned to be their enemy, and he fought against them.
verses.decoded: But they rebelled and angered His Holy Spirit, so He became their enemy and fought against them.

verses.kjv: Then he remembered the days of old, Moses, and his people, saying, Where is he that brought them up out of the sea with the shepherd of his flock? where is he that put his holy Spirit within him?
verses.decoded: Then He remembered the past, Moses, and His people, asking, 'Where is the one who led them out of the sea with the shepherd of His flock? Where is the one who put His Holy Spirit within him?'

verses.kjv: That led them by the right hand of Moses with his glorious arm, dividing the water before them, to make himself an everlasting name?
verses.decoded: The one who led them by Moses’ right hand with His powerful arm, splitting the waters before them to make His name known forever?

verses.kjv: That led them through the deep, as an horse in the wilderness, that they should not stumble?
verses.decoded: He led them through the deep waters like a horse running through the wilderness, so they would not fall.

verses.kjv: As a beast goeth down into the valley, the Spirit of the Lord caused him to rest: so didst thou lead thy people, to make thyself a glorious name.
verses.decoded: Just as a wild animal goes down into the valley and the Spirit of the Lord lets it rest, so you led your people to make your name glorious.

verses.kjv: Look down from heaven, and behold from the habitation of thy holiness and of thy glory: where is thy zeal and thy strength, the sounding of thy bowels and of thy mercies toward me? are they restrained?
verses.decoded: Look down from heaven, from your holy and glorious home. Where is your passion and power, your deep compassion and mercy for me? Have you held them back?

verses.kjv: Doubtless thou art our father, though Abraham be ignorant of us, and Israel acknowledge us not: thou, O Lord, art our father, our redeemer; thy name is from everlasting.
verses.decoded: Surely you are our Father, even if Abraham doesn’t know us and Israel does not recognize us. You, LORD, are our Father and Redeemer; your name has existed forever.

verses.kjv: O Lord, why hast thou made us to err from thy ways, and hardened our heart from thy fear? Return for thy servants’ sake, the tribes of thine inheritance.
verses.decoded: O LORD, why have you caused us to stray from your path and made our hearts stubborn so we don’t respect you? Please come back for the sake of your servants, the tribes you own as your inheritance.

verses.kjv: The people of thy holiness have possessed it but a little while: our adversaries have trodden down thy sanctuary.
verses.decoded: Your holy people have only held the land for a short time; our enemies have trampled your sanctuary.

verses.kjv: We are thine: thou never barest rule over them; they were not called by thy name.
verses.decoded: We belong to you; you never ruled over those people, and they did not call on your name.

verses.kjv: Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence,
verses.decoded: Oh, that you would tear open the heavens and come down, so that the mountains would melt in your presence!

verses.kjv: As when the melting fire burneth, the fire causeth the waters to boil, to make thy name known to thine adversaries, that the nations may tremble at thy presence!
verses.decoded: Like fire melting metal and causing water to boil, show your power so your enemies will know your name and the nations will fear you!

verses.kjv: When thou didst terrible things which we looked not for, thou camest down, the mountains flowed down at thy presence.
verses.decoded: You did amazing things we never expected; you came down and the mountains melted in your presence.

verses.kjv: For since the beginning of the world men have not heard, nor perceived by the ear, neither hath the eye seen, O God, beside thee, what he hath prepared for him that waiteth for him.
verses.decoded: Since the world began, no one has heard, seen, or imagined what God has prepared for those who wait for Him.

verses.kjv: Thou meetest him that rejoiceth and worketh righteousness, those that remember thee in thy ways: behold, thou art wroth; for we have sinned: in those is continuance, and we shall be saved.
verses.decoded: You meet those who are joyful and do what is right, who remember your ways; yet you are angry because we have sinned. Still, there is hope and we will be saved.

verses.kjv: But we are all as an unclean thing, and all our righteousnesses are as filthy rags; and we all do fade as a leaf; and our iniquities, like the wind, have taken us away.
verses.decoded: We are all unclean, and our best deeds are like dirty rags; we wither like leaves, and our sins sweep us away like the wind.

verses.kjv: And there is none that calleth upon thy name, that stirreth up himself to take hold of thee: for thou hast hid thy face from us, and hast consumed us, because of our iniquities.
verses.decoded: No one calls on your name or tries to reach you, because you have hidden your face and allowed us to be destroyed because of our sins.

verses.kjv: But now, O Lord, thou art our father; we are the clay, and thou our potter; and we all are the work of thy hand.
verses.decoded: But now, Lord, you are our Father; we are the clay and you are the potter. We are all the work of your hands.

verses.kjv: Be not wroth very sore, O Lord, neither remember iniquity for ever: behold, see, we beseech thee, we are all thy people.
verses.decoded: Do not be very angry, Lord, and do not remember our sins forever. Look, we ask you, we are all your people.

verses.kjv: Thy holy cities are a wilderness, Zion is a wilderness, Jerusalem a desolation.
verses.decoded: Your holy cities are like a desert; Zion is desolate, and Jerusalem is in ruins.

verses.kjv: Our holy and our beautiful house, where our fathers praised thee, is burned up with fire: and all our pleasant things are laid waste.
verses.decoded: Our holy and beautiful temple, where our ancestors praised you, has been burned with fire; all our precious things are destroyed.

verses.kjv: Wilt thou refrain thyself for these things, O Lord? wilt thou hold thy peace, and afflict us very sore?
verses.decoded: Will you hold back because of these things, Lord? Will you remain silent and afflict us severely?

verses.kjv: I AM sought of them that asked not for me; I am found of them that sought me not: I said, Behold me, behold me, unto a nation that was not called by my name.
verses.decoded: I was reached out to by those who did not ask for me; I was discovered by those who did not seek me. I said, 'Here I am, here I am,' to a nation that did not call on my name.

verses.kjv: I have spread out my hands all the day unto a rebellious people, which walketh in a way that was not good, after their own thoughts;
verses.decoded: I have reached out all day to a rebellious people who follow their own evil ways and ideas.

verses.kjv: A people that provoketh me to anger continually to my face; that sacrificeth in gardens, and burneth incense upon altars of brick;
verses.decoded: A people who constantly anger me openly; they offer sacrifices in gardens and burn incense on altars made of bricks.

verses.kjv: Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
verses.decoded: They stay among the graves and live in tombs; they eat pork and broth made from disgusting things in their pots.

verses.kjv: Which say, Stand by thyself, come not near to me; for I am holier than thou. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burneth all the day.
verses.decoded: They say, 'Keep away from me; don’t come near me, because I am holier than you.' They are like smoke in my nostrils, a fire that burns all day long.

verses.kjv: Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, even recompense into their bosom,
verses.decoded: Look, it is recorded before me: I will not stay silent but will repay them fully for what they have done.

verses.kjv: Your iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together, saith the Lord, which have burned incense upon the mountains, and blasphemed me upon the hills: therefore will I measure their former work into their bosom.
verses.decoded: Your sins and the sins of your ancestors, says the LORD, who burned incense on the mountains and insulted me on the hills—I will repay them for their past deeds.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one saith, Destroy it not; for a blessing is in it: so will I do for my servants’ sakes, that I may not destroy them all.
verses.decoded: This is what the LORD says: Like finding new wine in a grape cluster and saying, 'Don’t destroy it, there’s a blessing in it,' so I will spare some for the sake of my servants and not destroy everyone.

verses.kjv: And I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains: and mine elect shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.
verses.decoded: I will produce descendants from Jacob and an heir from Judah to inherit my mountains. My chosen ones will inherit it, and my servants will live there.

verses.kjv: And Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for the herds to lie down in, for my people that have sought me.
verses.decoded: Sharon will become a pasture for flocks, and the Valley of Achor a resting place for herds, for my people who have sought me.

verses.kjv: But ye are they that forsake the Lord, that forget my holy mountain, that prepare a table for that troop, and that furnish the drink offering unto that number.
verses.decoded: But you are the ones who abandon the LORD and forget my holy mountain; you prepare a table for the god Gad and pour out drink offerings to the god Meni.

verses.kjv: Therefore will I number you to the sword, and ye shall all bow down to the slaughter: because when I called, ye did not answer; when I spake, ye did not hear; but did evil before mine eyes, and did choose that wherein I delighted not.
verses.decoded: So I will count you among those to be killed by the sword, and you will all fall in defeat, because when I called, you did not answer; when I spoke, you did not listen; instead, you did evil in my sight and chose what I did not want.

verses.kjv: Therefore thus saith the Lord God, Behold, my servants shall eat, but ye shall be hungry: behold, my servants shall drink, but ye shall be thirsty: behold, my servants shall rejoice, but ye shall be ashamed:
verses.decoded: This is what the Lord GOD says: My servants will eat and you will be hungry; my servants will drink and you will be thirsty; my servants will rejoice and you will be ashamed.

verses.kjv: Behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but ye shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall howl for vexation of spirit.
verses.decoded: My servants will sing joyfully, but you will cry with sorrow and wail in anguish of spirit.

verses.kjv: And ye shall leave your name for a curse unto my chosen: for the Lord God shall slay thee, and call his servants by another name:
verses.decoded: You will leave your name as a curse to my chosen people, because the Lord GOD will kill you and give his servants a new name.

verses.kjv: That he who blesseth himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he that sweareth in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hid from mine eyes.
verses.decoded: Anyone who blesses themselves on earth will bless themselves by the God of truth; and anyone who swears on earth will swear by the God of truth, because past troubles are forgotten and hidden from my sight.

verses.kjv: For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.
verses.decoded: Look, I am creating new heavens and a new earth; the old things will not be remembered or even thought about.

verses.kjv: But be ye glad and rejoice for ever in that which I create: for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.
verses.decoded: So be happy and celebrate forever what I am creating, because I am making Jerusalem a place of joy and her people a source of happiness.

verses.kjv: And I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people: and the voice of weeping shall be no more heard in her, nor the voice of crying.
verses.decoded: I will take delight in Jerusalem and be joyful over my people; there will be no more sounds of weeping or crying there.

verses.kjv: There shall be no more thence an infant of days, nor an old man that hath not filled his days: for the child shall die an hundred years old; but the sinner being an hundred years old shall be accursed.
verses.decoded: There will be no more premature deaths or old people who haven’t lived a full life; children will live to be a hundred years old, but anyone who sins at that age will be cursed.

verses.kjv: And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.
verses.decoded: They will build houses and live in them; they will plant vineyards and enjoy their fruit.

verses.kjv: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.
verses.decoded: They will not build a house for someone else to live in, nor plant crops for others to eat; their lives will be as long as a tree’s, and my chosen people will enjoy the results of their labor for a long time.

verses.kjv: They shall not labour in vain, nor bring forth for trouble; for they are the seed of the blessed of the Lord, and their offspring with them.
verses.decoded: They will not work without success or give birth to children who suffer; they are the descendants of those blessed by the LORD, along with their children.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.
verses.decoded: Before they even call out, I will answer; while they are still speaking, I will listen.

verses.kjv: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the bullock: and dust shall be the serpent’s meat. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: The wolf and the lamb will eat together peacefully, the lion will eat straw like an ox, and dust will be food for the serpent. No one will harm or destroy anything on my holy mountain, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: Thus saith the Lord, The heaven is my throne, and the earth is my footstool: where is the house that ye build unto me? and where is the place of my rest?
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'Heaven is my throne and the earth is my footstool. So, where is the house you could build for me? Where is the place I could rest?'

verses.kjv: For all those things hath mine hand made, and all those things have been, saith the Lord: but to this man will I look, even to him that is poor and of a contrite spirit, and trembleth at my word.
verses.decoded: Everything was made by my hand and exists because of me, says the LORD. But I will pay attention to the person who is humble, broken in spirit, and respects my word.

verses.kjv: He that killeth an ox is as if he slew a man; he that sacrificeth a lamb, as if he cut off a dog’s neck; he that offereth an oblation, as if he offered swine’s blood; he that burneth incense, as if he blessed an idol. Yea, they have chosen their own ways, and their soul delighteth in their abominations.
verses.decoded: Killing an ox is like killing a person; sacrificing a lamb is like killing a dog; offering sacrifices is like offering pig’s blood; burning incense is like worshiping an idol. They have chosen their own sinful ways and enjoy doing what is wrong.

verses.kjv: I also will choose their delusions, and will bring their fears upon them; because when I called, none did answer; when I spake, they did not hear: but they did evil before mine eyes, and chose that in which I delighted not.
verses.decoded: I will let their foolish plans bring trouble on them because when I called, no one answered; when I spoke, they did not listen. Instead, they did evil and chose what I hate.

verses.kjv: Hear the word of the Lord, ye that tremble at his word; Your brethren that hated you, that cast you out for my name’s sake, said, Let the Lord be glorified: but he shall appear to your joy, and they shall be ashamed.
verses.decoded: Listen to the LORD’s message, you who respect Him. Your own brothers who hated and rejected you because of me said, 'Let the LORD be praised.' But the LORD will come to bring you joy, and those who rejected you will be ashamed.

verses.kjv: A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the Lord that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
verses.decoded: There is a loud noise coming from the city and the temple—the voice of the LORD giving justice to His enemies.

verses.kjv: Before she travailed, she brought forth; before her pain came, she was delivered of a man child.
verses.decoded: Before the mother went into labor, she gave birth; before the pain began, she delivered a son.

verses.kjv: Who hath heard such a thing? who hath seen such things? Shall the earth be made to bring forth in one day? or shall a nation be born at once? for as soon as Zion travailed, she brought forth her children.
verses.decoded: Has anyone ever heard or seen anything like this? Can the earth give birth in a single day? Can a nation be born all at once? But as soon as Zion went into labor, she gave birth to her people.

verses.kjv: Shall I bring to the birth, and not cause to bring forth? saith the Lord: shall I cause to bring forth, and shut the womb? saith thy God.
verses.decoded: Will I bring a woman to labor and then not let her give birth? Will I cause her to give birth and then close the womb? says your God.

verses.kjv: Rejoice ye with Jerusalem, and be glad with her, all ye that love her: rejoice for joy with her, all ye that mourn for her:
verses.decoded: Celebrate with Jerusalem and be happy with her, all who love her; share in her joy, all who mourn over her.

verses.kjv: That ye may suck, and be satisfied with the breasts of her consolations; that ye may milk out, and be delighted with the abundance of her glory.
verses.decoded: So you can be nourished and satisfied by her comforting care, and enjoy the rich blessings of her glory.

verses.kjv: For thus saith the Lord, Behold, I will extend peace to her like a river, and the glory of the Gentiles like a flowing stream: then shall ye suck, ye shall be borne upon her sides, and be dandled upon her knees.
verses.decoded: The LORD says, 'I will give her peace like a flowing river and bring the honor of the nations like a steady stream. Then you will be cared for and gently supported like a child on a mother’s lap.'

verses.kjv: As one whom his mother comforteth, so will I comfort you; and ye shall be comforted in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: Just as a mother comforts her child, I will comfort you. You will find comfort in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when ye see this, your heart shall rejoice, and your bones shall flourish like an herb: and the hand of the Lord shall be known toward his servants, and his indignation toward his enemies.
verses.decoded: When you see this, your heart will be glad and your body will be healthy like a growing plant. You will recognize the LORD’s favor on His servants and His anger against His enemies.

verses.kjv: For, behold, the Lord will come with fire, and with his chariots like a whirlwind, to render his anger with fury, and his rebuke with flames of fire.
verses.decoded: Look, the LORD will come with fire and chariots like a storm to bring His fierce anger and punish with blazing fire.

verses.kjv: For by fire and by his sword will the Lord plead with all flesh: and the slain of the Lord shall be many.
verses.decoded: The LORD will judge all people with fire and sword, and many will be killed by His judgment.

verses.kjv: They that sanctify themselves, and purify themselves in the gardens behind one tree in the midst, eating swine’s flesh, and the abomination, and the mouse, shall be consumed together, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: Those who try to make themselves holy by strange rituals, eating forbidden foods like pork and other detestable animals, will be destroyed, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For I know their works and their thoughts: it shall come, that I will gather all nations and tongues; and they shall come, and see my glory.
verses.decoded: I know what they do and think. A time will come when I will gather all nations and languages, and they will come to see my glory.

verses.kjv: And I will set a sign among them, and I will send those that escape of them unto the nations, to Tarshish, Pul, and Lud, that draw the bow, to Tubal, and Javan, to the isles afar off, that have not heard my fame, neither have seen my glory; and they shall declare my glory among the Gentiles.
verses.decoded: I will show a sign among them and send survivors to distant nations—Tarshish, Pul, Lud, Tubal, Javan, and faraway islands that have never heard of me or seen my glory. They will tell these nations about my glory.

verses.kjv: And they shall bring all your brethren for an offering unto the Lord out of all nations upon horses, and in chariots, and in litters, and upon mules, and upon swift beasts, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, saith the Lord, as the children of Israel bring an offering in a clean vessel into the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They will bring all your relatives from all nations as an offering to the LORD, traveling on horses, chariots, litters, mules, and fast animals, to my holy mountain Jerusalem, says the LORD—just like the Israelites bring offerings in pure containers to the LORD’s temple.

verses.kjv: And I will also take of them for priests and for Levites, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: I will also choose some of them to serve as priests and Levites, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.
verses.decoded: Just as I will create new heavens and a new earth that will last forever, so your descendants and your name will endure forever, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.
verses.decoded: It will happen that from one new moon to the next, and from one Sabbath to the next, all people will come to worship me, says the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.
verses.decoded: They will go out and see the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; their bodies will be eaten by worms that never die, and their fire will never be put out. Everyone will find them disgusting.
